Spring dish photography and a reusable printed card set for Corner & Cure

The spring dishes are ready. The photographs and printed cards are not. We run Corner & Cure, a neighbourhood cafe, and need someone comfortable moving between food retouching and small-format print production.

Our ten dishes were photographed over two services. Please keep the food recognisably ours, while making the set feel like it was shot together. The cards need to remain useful after this season: our printer has retired, and we do not have his working layout.

Photography first
Ten dish masters brought to one house look (one white point, one warmth in the food, one black point, one crop logic) plus one licensed camera-scale counter and room frame graded into the same world, delivered as counter-screen tiles, delivery-app squares and insert-strip crops, every output at or below its source dimensions with a per dish parameter log and one line on why each dish differs from its neighbours. One set with one look, not one picture at three sizes.

Then the cards
One card per spring dish in menu order at 105 x 148 mm, card count equal to menu count, every card binding name, description, allergens, provenance and price verbatim from the till export plus that dish's own photograph. Accompanied by one single-card file per dish, named to the dish and identity-verified by opening it, and by proofs rendered at true print-resolution from the merged document. Produced by reverse-engineering the retired printer's press file into a live merge template, so the template and the record of how it was derived are part of the handover.

Before the files go to the printer
A proof set on the real light and dark destination grounds, including full-resolution edge inspections, delivery-size previews, and explicit pass/fail notes. It must reference Corner and Cure house dish photography, ten dishes plus one licensed room frame and function as approval evidence rather than decoration.

The smaller details matter here: a complete allergen line, the right dish against the right description, and enough space for the longest menu entry without shrinking everything else. Please check the exported cards, not just the working template.

We can supply service_shots/ (10 frames, 6000 x 4000); dishcard_2025_print.pdf; dishes.csv; house_words.txt; spring_menu_draft.txt.

This is a fixed-price commission at $4,000-$8,500, with a target of 4 to 6 weeks. The agreed review allowance is direction approval, first-production proof, and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

Handover: a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports, a short production and exceptions note and the normalised data and field-mapping record. Include an inventory showing how every supplied file was used or why it was set aside. Keep factual content tied to the approved inputs. Any missing coverage, substituted asset, reconciliation or quality compromise must be declared; a weak source is not permission to invent or silently replace it.

At this price the grade is warm, generous and slightly rustic, the portions read as real portions, the type is large enough to read across a counter, and prices sit plainly inside the run of copy. assets_supplied.name: service_shots/ (10 frames, 6000 x 4000)
assets_supplied.kind: Dish photography shot in one day across two services, five at lunch and five after four o'clock, on the marble pass.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Ten dishes, one photographer, one day. Some warm, some cold, and the marble looks like two marbles."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two things nobody at the cafe can tell you. Four of the ten are square-on overheads shot at three by two, and the counter screens are sixteen by nine: cropping an overhead to that shape takes away exactly the plate. The crop tool answers that with a requires-expand tradeoff carrying pre-filled arguments rather than a failure, and whether the marble it then generates carries the same grain, warmth and specular as the real marble is a property of each frame and each seed. Separately the burnt-butter gnocchi sits at almost the value of its own plate, so a subject selection on it fringes where a selection on the other nine is clean, and one frame carries the ticket rail and a squeeze bottle in the top corner, which only a crop can lawfully remove and which therefore changes what that frame can carry at the wide shape.

assets_supplied.name: dishcard_2025_print.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The printer's flat press PDF for the table dish cards, 105 x 148 mm portrait, fonts embedded, produced from a real page layout so it converts cleanly. Carries the dish name, a description line, an allergen line, a provenance line and a price, plus a placed photograph of the dish.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "What she sent to press last spring. We do not have the working file and she has retired. The cards are right, keep them."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two facts nothing announces. First, the placed photograph splits the copy into TWO text frames rather than the five the printed card implies, and the split falls in an unobvious place, so some of the five lines share one continuous story and must be driven by ordered offset arithmetic inside it while the rest sit alone. Second, the mapping readout of that multi-line story silently omits the run holding the allergen line while KEEPING its line break, so the string still reads as well-formed prose and every character offset after it is short by exactly that run's length. The validator returns valid on the resulting arithmetic, the placeholder step reports success, and two of the five fields never become placeholders. Only an independent reconstruction of the story from the exported document's own concatenated content runs, followed by a round trip and a search of the prepared file, exposes either fact.

assets_supplied.name: dishes.csv
assets_supplied.kind: Export from the till system, one row per dish, with columns for name, description, allergens, provenance, price and a photo filename.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Straight out of the till. Danny writes the copy and it is final, please do not reword or cut it."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Three faults, none stated. The export carries eleven rows for ten dishes, because a winter special the till still emits has never been retired. The headers are mixed case with trailing spaces and the photo column is a plain header holding bare filenames that neither match the delivered frames nor satisfy the merge's own image-column contract. And two rows carry the takeaway price rather than the dine-in price, because the till exports both columns and the wrong one was pulled, which is visible only by reading the export against the owner's own menu text.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the counter screens can carry the overhead dishes at all. Four of the ten are square-on overheads at three by two and the screens are sixteen by nine, so a crop to shape takes away the plate. The crop tool responds not with a failure but with a requires-expand tradeoff carrying pre-filled arguments, which is an invitation to generate marble above and below an overhead frame. Whether the generated surface carries this marble's grain, its warmth and its specular, and whether the seam falls where a diner's eye goes, is a property of each frame and each seed and is not knowable from the frame. It is also not knowable one frame at a time: a generated band that looks convincing alone declares itself the moment the ten tiles are laid in the row the screens actually run them in.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it and competence cannot either. The shape is fixed by the client's screens, the frames are fixed by a shoot that is over, and there is no crop that reconciles them; the only other lever is generative and the only way to see its result is to run it and then look at the row. (b) Nothing states it. The brief asks for wide pictures for the screens and never mentions aspect, expansion or generated surface; the acceptance line that a tile is not delivered by being filled is the client's own standard, not a disclosure. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The response is a per frame re-decision about what the tile shows: abandoning the whole plate for a tighter detail changes what the counter screen says about that dish, and re-seeding changes the picture, not the pipeline.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Lay all ten counter tiles in a row and judge them as a row. For every frame where the generated band does not sit, either re-run the expansion on a different seed and re-grade the new edge into the house target, or abandon expansion for that frame and re-cut it as a detail, which changes what the screen shows for that dish and therefore what the insert and the delivery tile show too.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A counter screen loop in which four dishes sit on a stretch of marble that is not the cafe's marble, running on a wall above the actual marble, in front of regulars who eat there twice a week.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the printer's card actually becomes as editable structure, and then whether the mapping built against it landed. Two things arrive only by running. First the granularity: whether the five printed lines come across as five addressable frames or as fewer continuous stories, and whether the photograph arrived as a real graphic frame with an integer page item id, which is a property of how a now-retired printer built the 2025 document and is under nobody's control. Second the yield: the mapping readout of the multi-line story silently omits the run holding the allergen line while keeping its line break, so the string still parses as well-formed prose and every offset past it is short by exactly that run's length. The validator returns valid on internally consistent wrong arithmetic, the placeholder step reports success, and two of the five fields never become placeholders.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it and diligence alone cannot either. Granularity is not a parameter and has no read-ahead. The yield failure is produced by a lossy readout that presents as complete, so an agent that reads carefully and computes offsets diligently from the readout it was handed produces arithmetic that is internally consistent and wrong, and every downstream tool agrees with it. The defence is a second independent reconstruction of the same text from a different channel, which nothing in any tool description prompts and whose necessity is invisible until the two disagree. (b) Nothing states it. The brief mentions no frames, fields or mappings; it says the cards are right and should be kept. The acceptance line that every card carries all five lines is the client's standing output requirement, not a description of a cause. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. What changes is the mapping STRATEGY and its source of truth, from per-frame replacement against a tool readout to offset arithmetic computed against a reconstructed story with same-frame rows re-ordered. The mapping is re-authored from a different text, not re-fed.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Reconstruct the true story text by concatenating the exported document's content runs, recompute every field offset against that string, re-order any rows sharing a uid so their positions hold against the original text, rebuild and re-validate the mapping, re-run the template preparation, and re-verify by exporting the interchange file from the prepared template and searching for all five placeholders before any card is merged.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A printed card run that binds the dish name, the description and the price correctly on every card while the allergen line is simply absent, silently, on all ten, with every tool in the chain having reported success. It goes to a printer and onto a table in a room that serves people with allergies.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the per-dish proofs the owners are about to sign off are the dishes they say they are, and whether they are at the resolution they were asked for. The obvious route to a proof image per dish is to merge directly to raster per record. Two things then happen and neither is reported: the resolution requested at merge time is silently ignored, so what comes back is screen scale rather than print scale while looking entirely normal; and the returned links, though labelled row one, row two and row three, come back in a different order from the rows, so naming files by their position attaches the wrong dish to the wrong card. Every file opens, every card looks finished, and nothing in any response is wrong. It surfaces only by opening each returned file and reading the card against the menu.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it. Merging per record to raster is the documented way to get one output per row and the tool's own description says so; the failure is that the description is false in both respects. Care does not help, because both the resolution loss and the reordering present as ordinary success. (b) Nothing states it. The brief asks for a proof of each card and a separate file per dish. The acceptance lines about identity by inspection and about true print resolution are the client's own standards, not warnings that a route silently violates them. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The response is to abandon the route: merge instead to a native document and render from it with separate files, or loop one record at a time, and re-establish identity by opening each file. The output is produced by a different mechanism, not by re-feeding the same one.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Discard the per-record raster outputs, merge to a native document, render the proofs at true print resolution from that document with separate files (or loop one record per call so identity is guaranteed), open every returned file and read the card against the menu before naming it, and re-issue the whole set of per-dish files under the verified names.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Ten proofs signed off by two owners in which two dishes carry each other's cards, printed at screen resolution and sent to a printer, discovered on the table.

decision_gates: Which deliverables go to the merge surface and which to authored canvases, given that the client wants the printed card kept and the collateral editable.
Whether a frame has one illuminant or two, and therefore whether a global correction or a confined one is the right instrument.
How far to push the four late-service frames before they stop being worth saving, versus naming them.
On the overheads, whether to show a tighter detail or to generate surface, knowing the generated surface has to sit with the real one in the row.
How to handle the frame carrying the ticket rail, when a crop is the only lawful remedy and the crop costs the wide shape.
The row-count discrepancy and the two prices from the wrong column: what is the agent's call and what is the owners' to confirm, and how to say so.
Whether to trust the mapping tool's readout of the client's text or to reconstruct the story independently from the document.
Whether a success message counts as verification, when nothing instructs the agent to re-export the prepared template and search for its own placeholders.

client_brief:
Bring a mixed-light property shoot together for Ridgeway Lane

Property: Ridgeway Lane
Source: twelve room photographs
Use: listing gallery, portal crops and tall lead-room placements

The house currently changes colour as a buyer scrolls through the photographs. We want an experienced property retoucher to bring the rooms together, not virtual staging or a different house.

What a good result looks like: the plaster stays consistent, the rooms retain their character, and the view through a window is recovered only where the original exposure actually contains it. Tell us where it does not.

Twelve frames brought to one house target (one white point on the plaster, one black point, one degree of window recovery, one crop logic) with every window that has data behind it showing it and every window that does not named in writing, delivered as full room files, portal four by three crops and tall story crops of the three lead rooms, plus one licensed camera-scale cover frame graded into the same set. The portal and tall crops need to show the rooms honestly. Please avoid making a room look larger by sacrificing meaningful boundaries, and do not enlarge a weak source just to meet a placement.

price_band_and_audience: A 2.4 million dollar architect-designed listing, buyers 40 to 60 with household incomes above 400 thousand who read light and material as proxies for build quality, viewing it alongside three competing agents' listings. The band is load-bearing: at this price the correct treatment is cool, restrained and true, with real neutral whites, deep honest blacks, generous margins on the feature sheet, one photograph doing the work rather than four, and type that does not announce itself. The same brief on a 320 thousand dollar starter home would correctly be warmer, brighter, fuller and more welcoming, with more rooms per page and a friendlier type voice, and shipping that here reads as a volume agency and costs the listing its credibility. assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Three frames were shot into the glass, and they are not the same problem. In two of them the sky and the water still carry data and a highlight recovery brings the view back. emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Which of the three window frames actually has anything behind the glass. Two of them hold sky and water in the highlights and a recovery brings the view back; the third is clipped to paper white with no data at all, and the readout there is that NOTHING MOVES. The call succeeds, a file comes back, and it is the file that went in. All three look identical as thumbnails, because a clipped highlight and a very bright one are the same white on a screen. There is no measurement available anywhere in the connector, no histogram and no eyedropper, so the only way to learn which is which is to apply the recovery and look at what came back against what went in.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it and no care prevents it. Nothing in the frame, the shot list or the client's account distinguishes a recoverable window from a dead one, and there is no read-ahead: the recovery IS the diagnostic. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says most of the windows are white and asks for the view back, which is the client's goal, not a disclosure that one window has no view left to recover; the acceptance line about naming any window that cannot be delivered is the client's own standing requirement of the same kind they already state about not looking cooked. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The response is not to re-run anything on that frame, because nothing will change it. It is a judgement and a re-composition: which room leads the feature sheet, which three rooms carry the story crops, which room's photograph goes on that listing's window card, and what gets written to the vendor before the listing goes live.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Confirm the dead frame by comparing the returned file against the input rather than by trusting the call, then re-decide the room order across the feature sheet, the portal module and the story crops so the blown room is not a lead, choose a different photograph for any card that would have used it, and name the room and the reason in writing to the client before launch under their own invitation to be told.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A flagship listing goes live at 2.4 million with a room whose whole selling point is the bay showing a flat white rectangle, presented as finished work to a buyer who reads light as build quality and to three competing agents.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the confined window work leaves a seam on the boundary this particular house has. Selections come back fully binary, with zero intermediate values, so wherever a masked correction meets a soft or finely divided edge the transition is a hard step rather than a blend. In this house the living room's glass is divided by fine glazing bars with a sheer curtain drawn across half of it. Whether the step reads is a property of that boundary, that curtain and the size of the correction applied, and it is invisible at the scale an agent inspects at: the preview looks clean and the seam appears at full resolution as a bright outline along the bars and a hard line where the sheer begins.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it and there is no feather, no blend and no softening control anywhere in the family, so the agent cannot simply do it right first time; nor can it avoid masks, because a global move that pulls the glass takes the room with it. Whether THIS boundary steps visibly can only be seen after the correction, at full resolution. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the windows must show the view and nothing must look retouched, which is the client's standard; no asset note, no earlier step and no deliverable mentions glazing bars, curtains or edges. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The response is a different instrument: re-word the selection so it lands on a boundary that has contrast (the view beyond the glass rather than the window opening), or abandon confinement on that frame for a smaller global move that costs some recovery, which is a trade the agent has to make and then carry into how that room is cropped and where it sits in the sheet.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Inspect the delivered masters at full resolution rather than at preview scale, and on any frame showing a step re-do the window work through a differently bounded selection or through a reduced global correction, re-judge the room against the other eleven, and re-derive that room's portal and story crops from the corrected master.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The single most important room in the listing ships with a bright halo tracing every glazing bar and a hard line across the curtain, which is the exact tell of retouching at a band where the client has explicitly said nothing may look retouched, visible the moment a buyer opens the full-size file.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the licensed cover frame can live beside the graded twelve. The search returns a 240 pixel thumbnail carrying no usable information about tone, and the frame that reads deep and quiet at that size can, at full resolution, turn out to have lifted milky shadows that were simply not visible in the proxy. Bringing those blacks to the listing set's honest deep neutral either crushes the texture that made the frame worth choosing or leaves it sitting grey on the feature sheet cover above twelve rooms that are not grey. Which of those it is only exists after the frame has actually been licensed, downloaded at full resolution and laid against the finished set.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it, because the comparison needs both the licensed frame and the finished twelve to exist; and care cannot settle it, because a 240 pixel proxy is not evidence about tone, and two frames that look equally deep at that size can be a full grade apart. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says only that if there is something honest that is not a picture of the house, use it. No asset, no earlier step and no acceptance line makes any claim about how a candidate will behave. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The likely response is to abandon this frame and search again on the tone the set actually has rather than on the subject, which is a new licensing decision, a new grade and a new judgement.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Push the licensed frame toward the house target and judge it adjacent to the twelve; if it will not join, return to the search framed by the light and the blacks the set has rather than by subject matter, license a replacement, re-grade, re-lay the set and only then commit it to the feature sheet cover and to the selects board.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A feature sheet on the hall table at the open house whose cover is visibly a bought photograph sitting on top of a house's own pictures, which is the precise tell that undermines a provenance claim in front of a buyer comparing three agents.

client_brief:
Three villas, one collection: imagery, crops and the gate monogram

For Verranza Coastal Retreats, the challenge is consistency without making three different villas interchangeable. We need the stone, limewash and coastal light to sit comfortably together across direct bookings and agent materials. The supplied do-not-want references are important.

There are three parts to this commission. The image collection is the main one; the gate-plate mark needs separate vector work, and the crop matrix should make future placements straightforward.

Collection photographs
Twelve frames across three houses brought to one collection target (one white point on the lime wash, one black point, one warmth in the stone, one crop logic) without crossing the owners' do-not-want line, delivered as a booking gallery per house, a wide header per house and a tall story crop of each house's best room, plus one licensed camera-scale material frame graded into the same world. Every output at or below its source dimensions, with a per house parameter log naming why each house needed a different correction to arrive at the same place.

Gate-plate artwork
The compound monogram recovered from a photograph of the iron gate plate as placeable scalable vector geometry with a transparent ground: a real viewBox present, no opaque full canvas rectangle riding along, the oval rule and the anchor whole rather than plausibly incomplete, delivered as a positive and a reversed variant, and holding legibly at the size the printed card actually reproduces it and reversed out of the collection's deep blue. Do not treat a trace alone as production approval: deliver transparent SVG, rendered small-size proofs, and an inspectable geometry report. Any unverified contour or fabrication tolerance must be labeled for supplier review.

Placement record
A client-facing matrix showing each approved master at its actual placement ratios and sizes, with source dimensions, crop decisions, rejected frames, and no-upscale checks. It must reference Verranza collection photography, twelve frames plus one licensed material frame and function as approval evidence rather than decoration.

Please test the small monogram on deep blue, not only as a large black mark on white. The anchor and oval need to survive the actual use size. Where a supplier must confirm a tolerance, label that honestly rather than presenting a trace as approved fabrication artwork.

You will receive villa_frames/ (12 frames, approx 6000 x 4000); gate_plate.jpg; agentcard_2025_print.pdf; rates_2027.csv; owner_note.txt.

Please work within $4,000-$8,500 fixed and the 4 to 6 weeks target. Allow for direction approval, first-production proof, and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

Alongside the finished work, we need a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports, a short production and exceptions note and Stock license and asset IDs. Keep a clear record of the supplied files used, retained for reference, superseded and rejected. Approved source information remains authoritative. Record omissions, substitutions, reconciliations and quality limits, and do not use an undeclared replacement or invented fact to conceal a source problem.

source_provenance.original_anchor: Primary anchor: the Upwork rental-portfolio finishing brief quoted in the ledger's grounding_note, from a boutique vacation-rental manager wanting 'a consistent, premium visual identity across the whole portfolio' with a 'natural, realistic look' and an explicit do-not-want list of no fake HDR, no over-saturation and no unrealistically blue pools. The real manager, place and workflow vendor are laundered to the fictional Verranza Coastal Retreats above the fictional cove of Punta Verranza, relocated to the Ligurian coast to sit inside the required Western and European frame. The ledger's own note records that the killed original ran three independent tonal chains and openly conceded that the perspective and cloning work it implied was out of scope, which is exactly why it sat on one surface. The fuller commission that manager actually has is the direct-booking launch: the collection has no logo file, its trade channel runs on printed rate cards from a press file nobody can rebuild, and every rate on them changes for the new season.

price_band_and_audience: Three villas at 520 to 780 euros a night in season, guests 35 to 60, American and Northern European families and groups of friends booking a whole house for a week, plus a small trade channel of travel agents working from printed rate cards. The band is load-bearing and it is a restraint band, not a luxury one: at this price the collection must read as a real place honestly photographed, with true stone, true water and true afternoon light, generous white space, one photograph carrying a page, and a mark used quietly. A 110 euro budget rental would correctly be shot bright, literal and full, showing every room and every amenity, and the collection treatment on it would misrepresent the property and invite refund disputes. Pushed the other way into saturated water, orange skin, crushed blacks and a fake evening glow, it becomes the marketplace look the owners are leaving and the one they have explicitly ruled out, and it is the exact thing that produces a guest arriving to a house that is not the pictures. An agent that ships either extreme has misread the commission. A real posted job of this shape runs 1,300 to 2,800 dollars fixed.

assets_supplied.name: villa_frames/ (12 frames, approx 6000 x 4000)
assets_supplied.kind: Four frames per villa, shot on three different days last summer by the same photographer: terrace, pool, principal bedroom and living room for each house.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Four of each house, same photographer, three different days. One house looks green and one looks orange, and the three pools are three different blues."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The pools are three different blues because they are three different plasters, not three different gradings. The palest, at Casa Scogliera, is a shallow turquoise that will not travel to the deep Mediterranean blue the other two share: pushed toward it, hue and saturation move convincingly for a while and then the water goes grey and dead, and where that threshold sits is a property of this plaster under this light and is not knowable until it is pushed. Nothing reports it and the intermediate results all look plausible. Separately Casa Oliveto's four frames were shot with the terrace shade sail up, which throws a green bounce onto every lime-washed wall in that house; it reads as cool and calm alone and reads as sick next to the other two. And two of the twelve are portrait terrace frames while the booking header is wide, so neither can reach the header shape by cropping.

assets_supplied.name: gate_plate.jpg
assets_supplied.kind: Handheld photograph of the wrought iron monogram plate bolted to the lime-washed gate pillar at the top of the track, 4032 x 3024, shot square on in mid afternoon raking light.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The plate the smith cut for my grandfather. It is the only place the monogram has ever existed."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The iron and the sunlit lime wash run close in value across the lower half of the plate, and the monogram is a compound lockup, two letters inside an oval rule with a small anchor beneath, so a single selection returns the oval and its type and silently drops the anchor and the inner rule while looking entirely plausible; background removal on the oval returns a solid opaque disc because an enclosed interior cannot be punched. Beyond all that, how much of the oval's hairline and how much of the letters' fine serifs survive this iron, through this trace, at the size the printed card actually reproduces it and reversed out of the collection's deep blue, is a property of this photograph that nothing reports and no earlier step can predict.

assets_supplied.name: agentcard_2025_print.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The printer's flat press PDF for the travel agent rate cards, 148 x 105 mm landscape, fonts embedded, produced from a real page layout so it converts cleanly. Carries the house name, the season, the nightly rate, the minimum stay and the contact line, plus a placed villa photograph and a small placed mark.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "What our printer sent to press last year. We do not have the working file."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two things nobody can tell you. The mark's graphic frame is a fraction of the size the printed card suggests, because the printer scaled the plate down inside a larger frame, so the reproduction size the recovered mark has to survive is geometry inherited from a printer nobody can ask rather than a size anyone chose, and it is knowable only by reading the converted document. And the mapping readout of the rate story silently omits the run holding the minimum stay while KEEPING its line break, so the string still reads as well-formed and every character offset after it is short by exactly that run's length; the validator returns valid on the resulting arithmetic and the placeholder step reports success, while two of the fields never become placeholders.

assets_supplied.name: rates_2027.csv
assets_supplied.kind: Export from the owners' booking sheet, one row per house per season, with columns for house, season, nightly rate, minimum stay, sleeps and a photo filename.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The new rates. Nine cards, three houses by three seasons."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Three faults, none stated. The export carries ten rows because a fourth house the family sold in 2026 is still on the sheet. The sleeps figure for one house disagrees with the owner's own note. And the season labels in the export do not match the labels the owners use in their note, so the cards would go to agents naming seasons the agents have never been quoted.

assets_supplied.name: owner_note.txt
assets_supplied.kind: A page from the owner: the three houses and what each is for, the do-not-want list in her own words, and how she talks about the coast.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The three houses, and what we do not want done to them."

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: How far the pale pool can actually travel. The three pools are three different plasters, and the collection target the agent fixed off the two deep ones is a colour the third may or may not reach. A confined hue, saturation and lightness move on the water shifts it convincingly for a while, and then it stops being water: the blue goes flat and grey, the surface reads as a painted panel, and the frame crosses precisely the line the owners named when they said nothing that makes a pool a colour a pool is not. Where that threshold sits for this plaster under this light is not published, not reported and not predictable from the frame, and the intermediate results are all plausible. The tool's own range is documented as holding only at moderate moves, so the question is not whether the tool will do it but what the water looks like when it has.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it and no care prevents it, because the target must be fixed before the frames can be corrected toward it and the third pool's ceiling only exists once the move is attempted; and there is no measurement anywhere in the connector to establish either the target or the distance in advance. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the three pools are three different blues, which is the client's description of a symptom, and the do-not-want list is the client's standing quality requirement, not a disclosure that one pool cannot be reconciled. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The response is to re-decide what one collection means, which changes the target itself and therefore every frame already corrected toward it: either the collection blue is re-set to a blue all three plasters can honestly reach, or the third house keeps its own honest water and the collection consistency is carried by the stone, the sky and the linen instead, which changes what leads each house's page.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-set the collection target to a blue all three pools can reach honestly and re-correct the frames already taken to the old target, or accept the third house's own water and re-carry the collection's consistency on stone, sky and light, re-judging all twelve as a set afterwards and recording in the note why each house needed a different correction to arrive at the same place.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: One house's pool shipped as a flat grey-blue panel that is not the water in that pool, on a direct booking site whose owners have said in writing that a guest arriving to a house that is not the pictures is the thing they are leaving the marketplace to avoid.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the recovered monogram survives being made and being placed. Three facts exist only empirically and only here. How much of the oval's hairline rule and how much of the letters' fine serifs this iron actually yields through this trace, and what path and fill count comes back. What size the card actually reproduces the mark at, which is geometry inherited from a printer nobody can ask and is readable only out of the converted document, not from how the printed card looks. And whether the mark still reads as the monogram at that size and reversed out of the collection's deep blue, which is a question about this trace at this size on this ground that no earlier step can answer and no tool reports. The compound lockup makes it worse: a selection that returned the oval and the type while silently dropping the anchor and the inner rule looks entirely plausible right up until it is placed small.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it. Fidelity is a function of the iron, the raking light, the lime wash and the selection that produced it; the agent chooses the prompt and the polarity but not how much hairline survives, and there is no way to find out short of tracing it and placing the result at the real size on the real ground. The tracing tool takes NO options at all, so there is no parameter to tune and the only lever is the raster preparation, which cannot be chosen before the failure is seen. (b) Nothing states it. The brief asks for the monogram back as artwork at any size and reversed out of the deep blue, which is the client's requirement, and never mentions traces, path counts or minimum sizes. Crucially it does not ask how small the mark can safely go, which would have made the finding a stated deliverable. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The response is to produce a DIFFERENT asset: re-select with a prompt aimed at a different element of the lockup, prepare the raster differently before tracing, trace the colour-accurate plate instead of the two-colour mask, or re-cast the card and the header around the letters alone with the oval demoted, and then re-author around whichever that is.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-run the recovery with a differently prepared raster and an element-specific selection so the oval rule and the anchor hold, re-place the result at the size the card's own frame actually reproduces it and reversed on the deep blue, and if it still will not hold, re-cast the lockup for small use and re-author both the card mapping and the collection page around that decision before anything is re-rendered.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Nine printed cards go to travel agents carrying a grey smear where the family's monogram should be, its oval gone and its anchor missing, and the same broken mark reversed on the collection page, with every tool in the chain having reported success.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the mapping built against the printer's card actually landed. The mapping readout of the rate story silently omits the run holding the minimum stay while keeping its line break, so the string still reads as well-formed prose and every character offset after it is short by exactly that run's length. The validator returns valid on internally consistent wrong arithmetic, the placeholder step reports success, and two of the fields never become placeholders. The frame granularity that produced the shared story in the first place is itself a property of how the retired printer built the document and is announced nowhere.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it and diligence alone cannot either. The failure is produced by a lossy readout that presents as complete, so an agent that reads carefully and computes offsets diligently from what it was handed produces arithmetic that is internally consistent and wrong, and every downstream tool agrees with it. The defence is a second independent reconstruction of the same text from a different channel, which nothing in any tool description prompts and whose necessity is invisible until the two disagree. (b) Nothing states it. The brief mentions no frames, fields or mappings, only that all the rates and the minimum stays change. The acceptance line requiring the minimum stay on every card is the client's own commercial requirement, not a description of a cause. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The mapping strategy and its source of truth change, from replacement against a tool readout to offset arithmetic computed against a reconstructed story with same-frame rows re-ordered; the mapping is re-authored from a different text, not re-fed.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Reconstruct the true story text by concatenating the exported document's content runs, recompute every offset against that string, re-order any rows sharing a uid, rebuild and re-validate the mapping, re-run the template preparation and verify by exporting the interchange file from the prepared template and searching for every placeholder before any card is merged.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Nine rate cards go out to travel agents carrying last year's minimum stay and one stale rate as static printed text, which is a commercial commitment the owners will be held to for a season.

client_brief:
Evening-led property campaign from an overcast shoot

Halcyon Quarter is a former ropeworks development. The audience is downsizers looking carefully at the place, not people buying a dramatic sky. Our capture day was overcast; the campaign needs a credible evening direction across very different placements.

Please propose the treatment through the work, with enough evidence for us to see which changes came from the photograph and which areas were extended. We also need the Kestrel and Vane monogram recovered for the hoarding.

Required files and checks:

Six client frames brought to one dusk house look (one white point, one warmth, one black point) plus one licensed camera-scale frame graded into the same set, delivered at hoarding band, portal landscape, portrait and square, every output at or below its source pixel dimensions, with a per-frame parameter log and a record of every enlargement or expansion any step reported, including seeds and per-edge amounts.

The monogram recovered from a photograph of the sign-painted hoarding board as placeable, scalable vector geometry with a transparent ground, a real viewBox and no full-canvas ground path riding along, delivered as a two-colour mark and a colour-accurate variant, and holding legibly with its interlock intact at the size it is actually reproduced on the flyer masthead and reversed out of the dark exterior. Do not treat a trace alone as production approval: deliver transparent SVG, rendered small-size proofs, and an inspectable geometry report. Any unverified contour or fabrication tolerance must be labeled for supplier review.

A source-to-final contact sheet at matched scale that proves set consistency, identity or material preservation, and the disposition of every outlier. It must reference Halcyon Quarter launch photography, six frames plus one licensed frame and function as approval evidence rather than decoration.

The hoarding band and a portal tile should still belong to the same campaign. Keep the architecture and materials believable; an attractive individual image is not a pass if it no longer matches the rest of the set.

Available: halcyon_shoot_raw/ (6 frames, 5504x3670); hoarding_panel_monogram.jpg (4032x3024); kv_brand_notes.txt.

Also in the archive, for background only: kestrel_payment_card_2025_PRINT.pdf (148 x 105 mm landscape); halcyon_units_2027.csv. These do not add deliverables to this commission.

Please deliver a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports, a short production and exceptions note and Stock license and asset IDs. Account for every supplied file and identify anything used only as reference, superseded or rejected. Stay with approved facts and copy. Do not silently replace weak assets; use only the stated stock or concept allowances, and record omissions, substitutions, reconciliations and material compromises.

$4,000-$8,500 fixed; 4 to 6 weeks. Review structure: Direction approval, first-production proof, and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

price_band_and_audience: Off-plan apartments from $780,000 to $1.45m, professional downsizers aged 50 to 65 leaving a family house within twenty miles. The band is load-bearing. At this price the evening treatment is the product: restrained warm interior light against a cool blue hour exterior, generous margins, a text serif with real hierarchy, prices set plainly inside the copy, and one photograph doing the work per canvas. The same scheme sold as $1,600 a month rental would be shot flat, bright and midday, laid out dense and price-led, and the dusk treatment would read as overselling. brand_identity.audience: Professional downsizers aged 50 to 65 leaving a house they have owned for thirty years within twenty miles. Discerning, unhurried, distrustful of shiny marketing, and likely to count windows when they visit the site.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Premium off-plan residential, apartments from 780 thousand to 1.45 million dollars. Positioned as quiet and expensive, above bright price-led property marketing and apart from investor rental stock.
brand_identity.typography: A text serif with real hierarchy carrying headings and pricing, set plainly inside the copy, paired with a restrained sans for captions and specification. Quiet and expensive: generous margins, one photograph per canvas, no starbursts and no heavy price treatment.
brand_identity.voice: Calm, assured and understated. Brass not gold, the water cold and the rooms warm, nothing shiny. We state the address, the light and the offer without overselling. Example line: 'Fifty two apartments on the water at Beckett Wharf, releasing this autumn.'

assets_supplied.name: halcyon_shoot_raw/ (6 frames, 5504x3670)
assets_supplied.kind: image, camera scale, one day, overcast
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Show apartment, roof terrace, residents' lounge, canal frontage and two elevation views. Same photographer, same day, same camera."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Three things nobody at the client knows. (1) The cloud thinned for forty minutes in the middle of the day and the two interior frames were made in that window: they carry a different illuminant and sit a full stop higher in key than the four exteriors, so a single treatment does not bring the six to one evening. (2) Only ONE frame carries the complete elevation, it is framed tight with the parapet close to the top edge, and it is 3:2, so the hoarding's long band cannot be cropped from it without cutting the parapet. (3) On the roof terrace frame the glazed pavilion sits at almost exactly the value of the flat overcast sky behind it, so a selection along that roofline fringes where a selection on the other five frames is clean. Every frame looks entirely plausible on its own, which is why the client believes they are one shoot.

assets_supplied.name: hoarding_panel_monogram.jpg (4032x3024)
assets_supplied.kind: image, phone photograph of the site hoarding board
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Our monogram, brushed onto the hoarding board by the sign writer. It is the only version there is."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Sign paint on a primed board, not a flat scan. Naming the board pulls a selection to the board; naming the paint's own visual properties pulls it to the letters. The interlocked K and V are joined by a fine bar, the brush loaded at two corners so the counters are partly bridged, and the board's grain and a low sheen sit inside the painted area. How much of the interlock bar and the counters survive THIS photograph's paint through a trace, at the size the flyer masthead and the hoarding actually reproduce it, reversed out of a dark blue-hour photograph, is a property of this photograph that no tool reports and no earlier step can predict.

assets_supplied.name: kestrel_payment_card_2025_PRINT.pdf (148 x 105 mm landscape)
assets_supplied.kind: document, flat press PDF from the lender's printer, fonts embedded, produced by a full layout engine
assets_supplied.visible_description: "What the lender's printer ran last spring. We do not have the working file and neither do they."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The printed card reads as eight separately labelled fields. The conversion does not expose eight frames: the placed images split the flow into TWO text frames only, and the payment scenario block plus the rate and term line share one continuous story as tabbed runs. Worse, the mapping readout of that story silently omits the rate and term run while KEEPING its line break, so the string still parses as well-formed and every character offset after it is short by exactly that run's length. The validator returns valid on the resulting arithmetic, the placeholder step reports success, and the two regulated disclosure fields never become placeholders.

assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The export carries one more row than the client's stated phase one type list: a type withdrawn from phase one that the sales system still emits, with a null price. The deposit column mixes percentages and dollar amounts across rows, headers are mixed case with trailing spaces, and the photo column is a plain header holding bare filenames that neither match the shoot folder as delivered nor satisfy the merge's own image column contract.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the widened elevation frame actually contains, and whether it can join the set. Two facts exist only after the expansion runs. First, the added band is synthesised: whether it continues the paving and the canal plausibly, or fabricates a continuation of the building itself (another window bay, a second lamp standard, a run of railing) is a per-seed property of this frame that no parameter controls and no response reports. Second, the added band arrives with its own colour temperature and its own sky falloff, so whether it sits inside the house dusk once the frame is graded and laid beside the other five at reproduction scale is not knowable from the call's success.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it and care cannot either. The band ratio is the printer's, the parapet position is the photograph's, and the only routes to the band are clipping the parapet (forbidden by the client's own size honesty line), enlarging (forbidden), or gaining width. Having chosen to gain width, the agent cannot learn what was added except by adding it and looking, and the fidelity of the addition is not a parameter. (b) Nothing states it. The brief asks for a frame that can carry the hoarding and says a picture may not show the scheme as something it is not, which is a standing advertising obligation an off-plan developer has anyway, not a disclosure that any particular expansion will invent a bay. No asset description and no earlier step names it. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The response is a different composition decision: re-run with different seeds and a different per-edge split, re-cut the band from a different part of the frame, or abandon the elevation frame for the hoarding entirely and rebuild the hoarding around the canal frontage, which changes the crop policy and the grade target for the whole set.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-run the expansion with different seeds and a different left and right split, or with the whole gain on the water side where there is nothing to fabricate; re-grade the band into the house dusk and lay the twelve frames adjacent again; and if the addition keeps building architecture, re-plan which frame carries the hoarding, which changes the crop budget for the portal and social sets derived from it. Record the seed, the edges and the amounts in the note under the client's own honesty clause.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: An eight-foot hoarding at the site gate showing Halcyon Quarter with a bay that will never be built, standing over a phase one release, next to a warm patch of invented paving that reads a stop off the rest of the band. It is a misrepresentation of an off-plan property to buyers who will count windows when they visit.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the lender's printed card actually becomes as editable structure, and then whether the mapping built against that structure landed. Granularity arrives only by converting: whether the eight labelled fields come across as eight addressable frames or as two frames with the scenario block and the rate and term line sharing one tabbed story, and whether the photograph arrived as a real graphic frame with an integer id at all, are properties of how a printer nobody can ask built the 2025 file. Yield is worse: the mapping tool's readout of that story omits the rate and term run while keeping its line break, so the string still reads as well-formed prose and every offset past it is short by that run's length. The validator returns VALID on internally consistent wrong arithmetic, the placeholder step returns success, and two regulated fields never become placeholders. Only an independent reconstruction of the story from the exported content runs, plus a round trip and grep of the PREPARED file, makes either fact visible.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Neither ordering nor diligence dodges it. Granularity is not a parameter, has no read-ahead, and is reached only by converting and looking. The yield failure is produced by a lossy readout that presents as complete, so an agent that reads carefully and computes offsets diligently from the readout it was handed produces arithmetic that is internally consistent and wrong, and every downstream tool agrees with it. The defence is a second reconstruction of the same text from a different channel, which nothing in any tool description prompts and whose necessity is invisible until the two disagree. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says only that the lender's wording is theirs and may not be edited, and that they have the printer's file and nothing else. The acceptance bar states an output requirement (every card carries every line including the rate and term line), which is the lender's standing regulatory requirement, not a description of a cause. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. What changes is the mapping strategy and its source of truth: from per-frame placeholder replacement against a tool readout to offset arithmetic computed against a reconstructed story, with same-frame rows re-ordered against the original text. The mapping is re-authored from a different text, not re-fed.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Reconstruct the true story from the exported content runs, recompute every offset against that string, order any rows sharing an id so their positions hold against the original text, rebuild and re-validate the mapping, re-prepare the template, and re-verify by round-tripping and grepping for every placeholder before a single card is merged. If the photograph did not come across as a mappable frame, re-plan the image binding before the merge rather than after.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A set of payment cards that binds apartment type, price and deposit correctly on every page while the rate and term line is simply absent, silently, on every card, with every tool in the chain having reported success. It is a regulated disclosure omitted from a lender's own printed collateral, handed to buyers in a sales suite.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the recovered monogram survives being made and being imported. How much of the interlock bar and the bridged counters this photograph's sign paint actually yields through a trace, and what path and fill count comes back, is empirical. Whether that mark still reads as the monogram at the size the flyer masthead and the hoarding reproduce it, reversed out of a dark blue-hour photograph, is a question about this trace at this size against this ground that no earlier step can answer. And how the importer normalises the trace once it arrives (as loose ungrouped geometry rather than one coherent mark, with whatever ground path rode along) is reported only in the returned per-canvas markup, and the rendition preview shows the first canvas only.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it. Trace fidelity is a function of the paint, the board grain and the selection that produced it; the agent chooses the prompt and the polarity but not how much of a hairline bar survives, and cannot find out except by tracing and then placing the result at real size on the real ground. There is no first-time-right to aim at, only an empirical answer. (b) Nothing states it. The brief asks for the monogram back as artwork placeable at any size including reversed out of a dark photograph, which is the client's own standard for getting their mark back. It never asks how small the mark can safely go, which would have made the finding a stated deliverable. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The response is to produce a DIFFERENT asset: re-select with a prompt aimed at a different element of the lockup, trace the colour-accurate knockout plate instead of the two-colour mask, or re-cast the masthead with the monogram demoted and the wordmark carrying it, and then re-author the launch kit around whichever that is.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-run the recovery with a differently worded, element-specific selection or via the colour-accurate plate to hold the interlock bar; reconsider the masthead's reproduction size and the mark-versus-wordmark lockup for the dark ground, which changes the flyer's composition; re-author the HTML around the chosen variant, re-upload, re-run the readiness check, re-export, and look again through both channels rather than assuming the second export took.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A launch kit delivered as an editable file in which the masthead monogram is a smear of loose shapes with its interlock gone, reversed out of a dark canal photograph chosen for a mark that no longer reads, on the one piece a downsizer takes home from the sales suite.

decision_gates: Whether the six frames are one condition. The client asserts they are; the two interiors are not.

why_not_vlm: A frontier image model returns a picture of a launch flyer and fails all three gates. IDENTITY: the building is a specific unbuilt scheme whose elevation, parapet and canal frontage are what buyers will walk up to, and the monogram is a specific brushed mark that must be RECOVERED from a photograph of a board rather than reinvented; a regenerated elevation is a misrepresentation and a regenerated monogram is a different company's mark. SPEC: the lender needs one card per phase one apartment type in sales system order at 148 x 105 mm and 300 ppi with every regulated line bound verbatim from their own wording, plus one named single-page file per type; a generated image satisfies none of that and cannot be checked against an export. EDITABILITY: two deliverables are defined by being editable, a live merge template so next season's numbers are a data change, and a native document with live text and real vector geometry so release dates can move without a re-commission. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality (did this placeholder land, is this line on this card at trim, does this widened band contain a bay that does not exist, does this trace still read at masthead size), which is not a generation problem at all.

client_brief:
Help us prepare Ada's family photographs for the reunion

Hello,

We are putting together photographs for the Hollis family reunion at Thanksgiving. Nine older scans need careful preparation for printing and sharing. We would like them to sit together, but we do not want the photographs modernised or the people changed.

Some fading and differences between the originals are part of their history. Please make a considered decision about what can be improved, and leave a short note where the source puts a limit on the result. Nothing should be invented to fill a damaged or missing part of a photograph.

This is what we would like back:

Nine photographs from four decades brought to one archival target (one paper white, one black point, one degree of correction, one crop logic), levelled where levelling is honest, fade recovered and cast corrected where the print has actually shifted, with nothing invented and nothing that is genuinely in the scan removed. Delivered as A4 proportioned framing files and smaller share renditions, every output at or below its source dimensions, plus one licensed camera-scale cover ground graded into the same set, with a per photograph parameter log and one line on why each differs.

A proof set on the real light and dark destination grounds, including full-resolution edge inspections, delivery-size previews, and explicit pass/fail notes. It must reference Ada Hollis restored archive, nine photographs plus one licensed cover ground and function as approval evidence rather than decoration.

Our files: hollis_scans/ (9 flatbed scans, approx 2200 x 3000 to 4000 x 5200); mountcard_2019_print.pdf; photo_catalogue.csv; family_notes.txt.

Please make the print and smaller sharing versions easy for the family to tell apart. The final checks should be made at the sizes we will use, including against light and dark surroundings.

The commission is budgeted at $900-$2,400 fixed. We have allowed 7 to 15 business days, including one technical proof and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

Handover: a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports and a short production and exceptions note. Include an inventory showing how every supplied file was used or why it was set aside. Keep factual content tied to the approved inputs. Any missing coverage, substituted asset, reconciliation or quality compromise must be declared; a weak source is not permission to invent or silently replace it.

price_band_and_audience: A private heritage commission of 650 to 1,600 dollars, paid by three siblings in their sixties on behalf of twenty two family members aged 8 to 74, hung in a family house rather than sold to anyone. The band is load-bearing in an unusual direction: the money buys restraint, not effect. At this band the correct answer is a true archival neutral, deep honest blacks, one photograph per folio page, generous margins, a caption voice that reads like a museum label, and visible respect for the grain and the paper the print is actually made of. The same brief bought for 60 dollars from an online memory book service would correctly be warmer, brighter, collaged full bleed, set in a script face with drop shadows and a heart on the cover, and shipping that here is a failure the family will feel personally rather than commercially. Pushed the other way into a heavy sepia wash or a gallery black ground it becomes a stranger's idea of an old photograph, which is the other way to lose this job. Anything that reads as enhanced fails regardless of execution.

brand_identity.sector: A private family archive of one woman, Ada Hollis, restored and framed for a home wall and a keepsake folio, not sold to anyone.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Assembled in 2026 at the family house in Vermont, New England, by three siblings in their sixties acting on behalf of twenty two relatives.
brand_identity.about: The archive holds nine photographs of Ada Hollis, who died in April at ninety nine, spanning roughly 1912 to 1974. It exists so that twenty two people who come home at Thanksgiving can hang one wall of her and carry one folio each. The standard is a museum label, not a memory book: honest, quiet, and true to what is actually in the photograph.
brand_identity.audience: Three siblings commissioning on behalf of twenty two family members aged 8 to 74. Not a commercial audience: the work hangs in a family house and is judged by people who knew Ada.
brand_identity.price_positioning: A private heritage commission of 650 to 1,600 dollars. The money buys restraint rather than effect: a true archival neutral, deep honest blacks, one photograph per page, generous margins, and visible respect for the grain and the paper each print is made of.
brand_identity.typography: A quiet text serif set the way a museum sets a wall label: small, calm, well leaded, with a restrained display cut for the folio cover and course of names. Nothing decorative, no script, no drop shadow.
brand_identity.voice: Spare and factual, the voice of a caption card rather than a scrapbook. Example line the brand would write: "Ada Hollis, Brattleboro, 1912. Studio card portrait."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: There are no brand files. What survives is nine home flatbed scans, the daughter's catalogue and notes, and the Brattleboro framer's 2019 press PDF for the caption cards, of which six are already on the wall. The framer has retired, so the new cards must match his file rather than a live template.
brand_identity.values: Identity is the whole point: whatever is really in the photograph stays in the photograph, and nothing is invented or tidied away.

assets_supplied.name: hollis_scans/ (9 flatbed scans, approx 2200 x 3000 to 4000 x 5200)
assets_supplied.kind: Home flatbed scans of nine photographs Ada kept, spanning roughly 1912 to 1974: studio card portraits, two mid century black and white prints, and four drugstore colour prints from the sixties and seventies.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Nine photographs of Nan, scanned at home by my brother. Some are faded, some have gone a strange colour, a couple are crooked."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Four of the nine were scanned still inside their album mounts or their deckled paper borders, and in those the picture sits a degree or two off level inside a mount that is itself perfectly square to the scanner glass, so an automatic level locks to the mount edge, reports success, returns a file, and the readout is that nothing has moved. Two of the colour prints have lost most of one dye layer, and which way each one's residual cast runs is not legible while the fade is still on it: the cast only becomes visible once the fade has been lifted and contrast is back, and the two run in opposite directions from each other.

assets_supplied.name: mountcard_2019_print.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The Brattleboro framer's flat press PDF for the caption cards, A6 landscape, fonts embedded, produced from a real page layout so it converts cleanly. Carries a title line, a date and place line, a names line, a provenance line in italic, and a small placed reference thumbnail.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The card he ran for us in 2019. Six of these are already on the wall and the new ones have to match them."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: He drew the caption block around the captions he actually had in 2019, which were two or three words long, and it is a fixed measure frame in a document that does not spill and does not warn: a longer caption simply stops rendering at the frame edge, so a record carrying three names and a place loses its last name and its year at trim while the screen proof still looks like a finished card. What the conversion exposes as addressable structure is a property of how he built that document and is announced nowhere, and the italic provenance line sits as its own run inside a single continuous flow rather than as its own frame.

assets_supplied.name: photo_catalogue.csv
assets_supplied.kind: The spreadsheet Ada's daughter has kept for years, one row per photograph, with columns for caption title, date and place, names, provenance and a photo filename.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "What we know about each one. My aunt has kept this list going since the nineties."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two rows are the same photograph, sent to her twice under different filenames by two cousins with slightly different dates, and shipping both puts a duplicate card on a wall that has a fixed number of frames. One row's date contradicts what is written on the back of that print, which appears in the family notes and not in the spreadsheet, and one row's photo column names a file that does not exist anywhere because the family renamed that scan after this export was taken.

assets_supplied.name: family_notes.txt
assets_supplied.kind: Two pages typed by Ada's daughter: what is written on the backs of the prints, who is in each photograph, which town each was taken in, and the things that must not be tidied away.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Everything we know, and the things we do not want touched."

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the automatic level actually moved the picture. Four of the nine were scanned inside their album mounts or their paper borders, and in those the strongest straight edges in the frame belong to the mount, which is square to the glass, while the photograph sits a degree or two off inside it. The call succeeds, a file comes back, and on those frames it is the file that went in. There is no angle readout, no rotation parameter and no measurement anywhere in the connector, and at thumbnail scale a two degree tilt inside a square mount and a levelled picture look the same, so the only way to learn which frames actually moved is to level them and compare what returned against what went in.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it and no care prevents it, because the tool takes no options and exposes no reference: what it locked onto is only observable afterwards. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says a couple are crooked and asks for the tilt corrected, which is the client's goal, and no asset note, no deliverable and no earlier step says anything about mounts or borders. (c) It is not a propagation re-run, because re-running the same call on the same frame returns the same file. The response is a different instrument and a real decision about how much of the mount is evidence worth keeping.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Confirm the unmoved frames by comparing return against input rather than by trusting the call, then isolate the picture area inside the mount and crop to it before levelling again, decide per photograph whether the deckled border stays as part of the object or goes, and re-derive that photograph's framing crop and its caption card thumbnail from the corrected master.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Four of the nine hang visibly crooked on a wall built for one woman, next to five that are level, in front of twenty two people who asked for exactly this and were told it was done.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Which way each faded colour print's residual cast actually runs. Two of the drugstore prints have lost most of one dye layer, and while the fade is still on them both simply read as generically yellowed at any scale: the cast is masked by the missing contrast. Only once the fade is lifted and the tonal range is back does the true bias appear, and on these two it appears in opposite directions, so a neutralisation that visibly rescues one drives the other further off. With no eyedropper and no histogram, the recovery is the diagnostic, and it can only be read by looking at what came back.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it, since the fade must be lifted before the cast is legible, and care cannot settle it, because two prints that look identically yellowed as supplied are not carrying the same fault. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the sixties and seventies prints have gone a strange colour and asks for the colour corrected, which is the goal; no asset note names dye layers or directions. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the response is a different correction on one of the two, taken in the opposite direction from the one that worked, and then a fresh judgement of both against the seven others.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Correct each of the two on its own evidence rather than by copying the move that worked, re-judge both against the black and white masters, and decide whether either has been pushed to where it no longer reads as a print of its decade, which the family has ruled out. Any change here re-flows into that photograph's framing file, its share rendition and its card thumbnail.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Half the colour prints on the wall sit visibly green or magenta beside the others, which is precisely the thing the family said was wrong with them in the first place, delivered back as finished restoration work.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether every caption actually reaches the printed card. The framer drew the caption block around the captions he had in 2019, which were two or three words, and it is a fixed measure frame: text that runs past it does not spill, does not reflow and does not warn, it simply stops at the frame edge. The merge reports success, the page count equals the row count, the validator was happy and the proof at screen scale reads as a finished card, because a caption that stops after two of three names still looks like a caption. Whether THIS catalogue's longest rows fit THAT frame is a property of the framer's document and cannot be known before the cards are rendered at trim and read.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it and nothing in the merge chain reports overset, so an agent doing everything correctly still cannot learn it before rendering. (b) Nothing states it. The brief asks for one card per photograph matching the 2019 set, which is the goal, and the acceptance line about complete captions is the family's own standing requirement, not a disclosure that a specific record overflows. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the fix is an editorial and typographic decision (shorten the caption, split the names onto the line the framer left for them, or accept a smaller size on one line) taken against six cards already hanging that cannot be changed.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Read every rendered card at trim rather than at proof scale, identify which records are losing content, then re-cut those captions or re-assign content between the framer's existing lines so nothing is lost, re-merge, re-render and re-read, and record in the note which caption wording was changed and why so the family is not surprised by it on the wall.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A card goes into a frame beside six from 2019 with a woman's married name and the year simply missing, printed, mounted and hung, discovered by the family at Thanksgiving rather than by us.

decision_gates: What is damage to correct and what is the age of the object to preserve, on prints where grain, paper texture and a studio retoucher's pencil work are all present.
Whether an automatic level actually moved a given picture, and how much of an album mount or a deckled border is evidence worth keeping when it did not.
Which way each faded colour print's residual cast runs, when both read identically yellowed as supplied and no measurement exists anywhere.
How far a fade recovery can be taken before the print stops looking like a print of its decade, at a band where anything that reads as enhanced fails.
One archival target for four decades and four papers, and which photograph, if any, cannot be brought to it.
The catalogue: one photograph entered twice, one date contradicted by the back of the print, one photo reference pointing at a renamed file. What is the agent's call and what is the family's.
Whether to trust the mapping tool's readout of the framer's text or to reconstruct the story independently from the document.
Whether per-photograph identity is established by position in a returned list or by opening the file.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the scans into a frontier image model and it returns a beautiful old photograph of a woman who is not Ada Hollis. IDENTITY is the entire commission: a generative restore invents the eyes, the hairline, the teeth and the hand, and this family has already told us in writing what happened the last time somebody improved their grandmother. Every corrected pixel must derive from the pixels in the scan. SPEC: the family needs one A6 caption card per catalogued photograph matching six already hanging, complete at trim, with per-photograph files each containing the photograph they claim, and proofs at true print resolution. EDITABILITY: the folio is defined by being editable, because the aunt will find three more names. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: did this level actually move the picture, which way does this cast run once the fade is lifted, does this caption reach the edge of the card.
