client_brief:
Before-and-after renovation photographs that clients can trust

Gable & Grove needs five before-and-after pairs prepared for the website and sales materials. These are evidence of our work. The after pictures should look good, but not because the before pictures have been made deliberately worse.

Please establish a restrained correction standard for the before images, then give the finished work a consistent treatment. Matching the framing and shared materials is more useful to us than five unrelated dramatic edits.

The paired set: Five pairs where the befores are corrected only for legibility against a stated and disclosed standard and the afters are brought to one finish target across jobs shot in different light, each pair genuinely a pair in framing and in the colour of its shared materials. Delivered as web three by two and square crops from one crop logic, every output at or below its source dimensions, with any pair that cannot reach the library size at its own resolution named along with the size it can reach, plus a per-frame parameter log.

The Ridge Road pergola: The flagship finished feature lifted from its frame as a transparent master and as a plain ground plate, with a clean edge where the pale stone meets the overcast sky, verified on a contrasting ground rather than on a transparency preview, at the reproduction size the yard sign and the quote pack cover actually use. Accompanied by a statement of which isolation instrument was used and why, so the firm can have the same thing done again.

Colour check: A calibrated side-by-side approval sheet showing white point, black point, skin or material color, and crop consistency across the finished set. It must reference Before and after library, five matched pairs and function as approval evidence rather than decoration.

The pergola will be used against more than one background. We need its edges checked where stone meets sky, at the yard-sign and quote-cover sizes, with a clear distinction between a transparent master and a prepared plate.

Inputs are job_photos/ (14 frames across 5 jobs, approx 1600 x 1200 to 6000 x 4000); mark_sources/ (mark_flat.png, truck_door.jpg); projectcard_2025_print.pdf; projects.csv; brand_notes.txt.

The final package should contain a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports and a short production and exceptions note, with every source file accounted for, including references and rejected or superseded material. Use the approved information without inventing missing facts. Only the stated stock or concept exceptions permit substitution; document every omission, replacement, reconciliation and material quality compromise.

Budget: $4,000-$8,500 fixed. Target: 4 to 6 weeks. Reviews: Direction approval, first-production proof, and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: Anchor: the Upwork home services branding brief in the ledger's grounding_note, from a new home services company that had a logo mark and wanted it cleaned up and rolled out consistently across trucks, uniforms, yard signs, social and print, laundered here to the fictional Gable & Grove Home Services (no real company, person or trademark appears anywhere; the brand, the crew, the jobs and all copy are invented for this benchmark). The killed spec was fake on two counts: every deliverable was a one click operation, and it asked for a trace of a photograph of printed artwork as though that were a clean input. The fuller commission this firm genuinely has is the season kit, because a before and after library is worthless without the collateral it feeds, the project card run is a real record per page job rebuildable from the press file the retired printer left, and the mark has to survive from a shirt to a yard sign or it is not artwork, it is a picture of a logo.

real_brief_anchor: Anchor: the Upwork home services branding brief in the ledger's grounding_note, from a new home services company that had a logo mark and wanted it cleaned up and rolled out consistently across trucks, uniforms, yard signs, social and print, laundered here to the fictional Gable & Grove Home Services (no real company, person or trademark appears anywhere; the brand, the crew, the jobs and all copy are invented for this benchmark). The killed spec was fake on two counts: every deliverable was a one click operation, and it asked for a trace of a photograph of printed artwork as though that were a clean input. The fuller commission this firm genuinely has is the season kit, because a before and after library is worthless without the collateral it feeds, the project card run is a real record per page job rebuildable from the press file the retired printer left, and the mark has to survive from a shirt to a yard sign or it is not artwork, it is a picture of a logo.
price_band_and_audience: A firm charging 45,000 to 120,000 dollars a project, selling to households aged 45 to 65 with old houses and long time horizons, at a kitchen table against two other bids. The band is load-bearing and it points at restraint: at this price the afters read cool, calm and material, with real neutral stone, deep honest blacks, one photograph doing the work, generous white space in the quote pack and a mark that behaves like a maker's stamp rather than a sales badge. The same brief for an 8,000 dollar handyman outfit would correctly be brighter, warmer, more saturated, busier, with four photographs a page, a starburst price and a phone number in the biggest type on the sheet, and shipping that here loses the job on sight because it tells the buyer this firm competes on price. Pushed the other way into a black ground with gold rules it reads as a developer, which this buyer distrusts more than a flyer. A dishonestly improved before fails at any band, because it destroys the only proof the firm has. A real posted job of this shape runs 1,200 to 3,000 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.typography: A quiet display serif for the mark and headings paired with a restrained humanist sans for scope, prices and captions. Legible, unhurried, no starbursts and no oversized phone number.

assets_supplied.name: job_photos/ (14 frames across 5 jobs, approx 1600 x 1200 to 6000 x 4000)
assets_supplied.kind: Before and after captures of five completed exterior renovation and garden jobs, shot across a season on the owner's phone and the estimator's camera in whatever light the site had.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Five finished jobs, before and after. Some off my phone, some off the estimator's camera. They are a mess."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two of the fourteen are screenshots the office pulled out of a text thread rather than the original captures, so they carry a fraction of the pixels of everything else and cannot reach the library's delivery size without interpolation. On the Ridge Road job the before and the after were shot months apart from slightly different standing positions in different light, and the limestone runs to opposite sides of neutral in the two frames in a way that is not legible in either frame alone; that job's after also has a pale limestone pergola standing against a flat overcast sky of very nearly its own luminance.

assets_supplied.visible_description: "All we have of the logo. The picture file he sent us once, and a photo of our own truck."

assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The photo frame he drew is close to square, which the printed card never advertises because the photograph he happened to place in it was square, so a wide crop bound to that frame is centre cropped by the frame and quietly loses whatever sits at its edges, which on these jobs is the finished feature. The card's copy lines also arrive as one continuous flow rather than as separate frames, and the mapping readout does not report every run in it.

One row is a job whose homeowner withheld permission to publish, which is recorded in the owner's notes and nowhere in the export, and the photo column names files that do not exist yet because this engagement produces them.

acceptance_bar: The befores stay honest. Any correction applied to a before is legibility only, is disclosed, and does not flatter the site. A before that has been quietly improved fails the whole library regardless of how good the after looks.

A written note: what was applied to each frame, why the befores differ from the afters, how each mark source was handled, every job row questioned and its resolution, and every resize any tool reported.

The afters read as ONE firm's finish across five jobs shot in different light: one white point on the stone, one black point, one degree of correction, one crop logic. A job that cannot be brought to the set is named, not shipped at eighty percent.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the Ridge Road pair still reads as one site once both frames are finished and adjacent. The before and the after were shot months apart from slightly different standing positions in different light, and the limestone in the two runs to opposite sides of neutral. Neither frame looks wrong on its own, and neither looks wrong beside the other four jobs; the divergence only exists as a property of the pair, at one size, side by side, after both have been taken to the finish target. There is no eyedropper and no histogram anywhere in the connector, so it cannot be predicted from either frame and can only be seen once the pair is assembled.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it, because the comparison requires both frames finished and cropped, and care cannot prevent it: bringing each frame correctly to the set target is exactly what makes the divergence legible. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the befores must stay honest and the afters must look like the firm's finish, which are the client's goals; no asset note, no earlier step and no deliverable says anything about the stone or about how the two frames relate. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the responses available are a confined correction on the stone alone, a re-crop toward the framing the two frames actually share, or dropping the job from the library, and each is a different decision with different downstream consequences.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Judge the pair adjacent at one size rather than each frame alone, then either confine a correction to the stone (accepting that a binary selection cannot blend at the planting boundary and inspecting the result at full resolution), or re-derive both crops toward the framing the two genuinely share, or set that job aside and re-pick which pair leads the module and the quote pack. Any of the three re-flows into the social set and into which after is bound to that job's project card.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The firm's flagship pair goes on the website and into every quote pack showing limestone that is warm grey before and cool grey after, which a buyer at a kitchen table reads as a different house, and the before and after claim, which is the only proof this firm has, quietly stops being believed.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the isolation actually did to the pergola's edge where the stone meets the sky. The pale limestone stands against a flat overcast sky of very nearly its own luminance, and the tool exposes no threshold, no matte control, no confidence value and no warning: it succeeds, returns a cutout whose overall silhouette is right, and the transparency preview looks clean because a checkerboard behind a pale edge hides exactly this. Whether the detector took the rafter tails and the balustrade with the sky is a property of this frame and this boundary, and it becomes visible only when the cutout is put on a ground it contrasts with, at full resolution.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it, and the agent cannot simply do it right first time because there is no parameter to set: the same call is the only call, and what it did is observable only afterwards. (b) Nothing states it. The brief asks for the pergola pulled out cleanly, which is the goal, and the acceptance line about a clean edge is the client's own standard, not a disclosure that this edge is at risk. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the response is a different instrument entirely, a positive selection of the structure by its own visual properties then an inverted knockout or a bounded crop, and possibly a different hero if the boundary will not give.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Inspect the cutout on a contrasting ground rather than on transparency, and where the edge has been bitten, rebuild the isolation through an explicit selection of the structure and its inversion, or fall back to a solid ground knockout that keeps the edge and gives up transparency, then re-judge the hero at the size the yard sign and the quote pack actually use it and re-place it in both.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The best thing this firm has ever built goes on a yard sign, a quote pack cover and the site with its rafter tails eaten off against a deep green ground, which is instantly legible to anybody who has looked at a pergola and reads as carelessness by the firm that built it.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the recovered mark survives at real reproduction size on the firm's own deep green. The trace is clean at the size it was made, where the narrow counter in the initial is open and the hairline rule under the wordmark is a rule. What that same geometry does when it is placed at yard sign scale on a saturated dark ground, and how the importer resolves it into the document, is a different question: the counter can fill visually against the green and the hairline can drop below the weight at which it reads as a line rather than as an artefact. The trace tool takes no options at all, so nothing about this is adjustable at the point of tracing, and the only channel that reports what actually happened is the returned per canvas markup and the rendition.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it, because the ground, the scale and the trace all have to exist before the question exists, and care cannot settle it: a mark that is manifestly clean at canvas size gives no signal about a dark ground at sign size. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the mark has to work from a shirt to a yard sign and names the green, which is the client's requirement; nothing in the assets, the steps or the deliverables says anything about what the trace does to the counter or the rule. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the fix lives three steps back in the raster preparation, because the trace has no parameters, so the response is to re-prepare the plate and trace again, which is a different piece of work.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Look at the mark on its real ground at its real size rather than at authoring scale, and if the counter closes or the rule fails, go back to the raster preparation (a tighter or differently prompted plate, a different source between the emailed file and the painted door, a cleaner polarity) and trace again, then re-inject the viewBox, strip the background rectangle again, re-place it and re-export, and record the smallest reproduction the delivered artwork actually holds at.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The firm hands the artwork to a sign shop and a shirt printer as the definitive mark, and every yard sign in the Litchfield Hills carries a filled initial and a broken rule, which is worse than the situation the firm started in because it is now committed and paid for.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the photographs into a frontier image model and it returns a beautiful garden that nobody built. IDENTITY is the whole product: a before and after is a claim that THIS firm did THIS work at THIS house, and a generated after in a quote pack is not a design shortcut, it is fraud in front of a homeowner. The mark is the firm's actual mark, painted on its actual truck, and a redrawn approximation is a different company's logo handed to a sign shop. SPEC: the firm needs one A6 card per publishable job binding four named fields verbatim with the right job's photograph, per-project files each containing the job they claim, proofs at true print resolution, and delivered images that never exceed their sources. EDITABILITY: the quote pack is defined by being editable because prices move. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: does this pair still read as one site, did this knockout keep the rafter tails, does this counter stay open on green at sign size.

client_brief:
Standardise a used-car photo set without changing the cars

We photograph stock in three different bays at Meridian Motors. That is showing up in our listings: the same forecourt can look like three dealerships, and paint colours move around with the light.

We need a repeatable, neutral showroom treatment across the eighteen supplied walkaround photographs. Paint accuracy takes priority over making every panel equally bright. These are used cars, so the photographs must remain an honest record of the vehicles.

Eighteen walk around frames from three lot bays brought to one defended showroom white with one black point and honest paint rendition per vehicle, levelled where they were canted, plus one licensed camera-scale forecourt frame graded into the same world. Delivered with a per-frame parameter log stating what was applied and why that frame differs from its neighbours. This is one set with one target, not six separately pleasing pictures.

A client-facing matrix showing each approved master at its actual placement ratios and sizes, with source dimensions, crop decisions, rejected frames, and no-upscale checks. It must reference Meridian showroom photography, week's intake and function as approval evidence rather than decoration.

Please use the crop matrix to tell us what each source can genuinely support. A rejected placement with a useful explanation is preferable to a file enlarged beyond the capture. We want to use the same decision-making standard as stock turns over, not have to guess how this set was prepared.

price_band_and_audience: Certified pre-owned at 22,000 to 38,000 dollars, buyers 30 to 55 replacing an ageing family car, deciding on trust before they decide on the vehicle. The band is load bearing. At this price the whole visual argument is that this operation is orderly and has nothing to hide, so the treatment must be an even, neutral, well lit showroom white with the full vehicle in frame, honest paint colour, and legible plain information. Push it into a dark dramatic studio look with rim light and a black sweep and it becomes a 180,000 dollar exotic specialist, which reads as evasive on a nine year old crossover and invites the buyer to wonder what the shadows are hiding. Push the other way into hot saturated pictures with starbursts and a price slash and it becomes a buy here pay here lot, which is exactly the reputation this dealer is spending money to escape. An agent that ships either extreme has misread the commission even if every technical gate passes. A posted job of this shape runs 900 to 2,200 dollars fixed, usually with a standing weekly retainer attached.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the one call plain ground knockout actually found the vehicle's edge on this particular photograph. On the white Norsted against the sun bleached apron and the silver Calder against the grey block wall, the paint runs at very nearly the ground's luminance along the roofline and the shoulder, so there is no contrast for subject detection to work from there. The call returns ordinary success and a cutout that is clean, complete and entirely convincing at preview scale and against white; the bite along the roof edge only shows at full resolution against a coloured ground. Which frames behave this way is a property of each capture's own paint, sky and wall, and cannot be read off the frame beforehand.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it and no parameter controls it: the knockout has to be run before its edge can be judged, and doing it right first time would mean knowing in advance which of six vehicles has no edge contrast. (b) Nothing states it: the brief says the marketplace wants a plain ground and that it must hold on their coloured page, which is the client's standing requirement, not a disclosure that detection fails on pale paint. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the response is a different chain for those frames, selecting the bay surface by its own material properties, inverting, and filling to the house ground rather than asking for a subject.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Abandon the one call route for the affected vehicles, re-derive their plain ground primaries and transparent variants through a material named ground selection inverted and filled, re-inspect every edge at full resolution against a coloured ground rather than white, and re-cut the primaries that were already trimmed from the first cutouts.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Marketplace primaries whose roofline has been eaten, shipped on the exact deliverable the marketplace has already been rejecting, on a lot whose only sales argument is that it is careful.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: That the readout of the card's single text flow is not the text. It omits one run while keeping that run's line break, so the returned string still looks well formed and every character offset past the omission is short by the length of the dropped run. The validator then reports the mapping as valid with no warnings, and the preparation step reports that placeholders were created successfully, while two of the six fields never land. Nothing in any response distinguishes the mappings that took from the ones that were silently discarded, and the true story text exists only inside the exported document's own story runs.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it, because the readout is the only offset source the tools offer and the discrepancy is invisible in the readout itself; the mitigation of rebuilding the story from the document is a response to having seen placeholders go missing, not a step any tool asks for. (b) Nothing states it: neither the brief nor the deliverable list says anything about how the card's text is structured, and the client believes the card is six separate boxes. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the mapping is rebuilt from a different source of truth, not re-submitted unchanged.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Download and unpack the exported document, concatenate the story runs to recover the true text, recompute every offset against that string, rebuild and revalidate the mapping, prepare the template again, and re-export the document to confirm by inspection that all six placeholders are present before any record is merged.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A week's window cards printed and hung in six car windows with the mileage and the certification line missing or carrying last season's static text, on the one deliverable a walk up buyer reads before speaking to anyone.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the per record proof set actually corresponds to the roster the way the response says it does. The merge returns proofs labelled by row position, and the labels are not the order the files come back in, so a proof named for row one can be the last vehicle in the roster. There is no error, no warning, and the page count is correct. With two silver Calders of the same shape in the same intake, the mismatch survives a visual check entirely, and the only way to learn it is to read the merged values on each rendered card against the roster.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it: the tool's own description promises one output per row and the labels assert an order, so a competent agent following the documentation walks straight in, and the discrepancy exists only in the returned artefacts. (b) Nothing states it: the brief asks to see proofs before printing, which is a client wanting to check a price, not a disclosure that identity is unreliable. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the fix is a different delivery route with identity guaranteed per call, not the same merge repeated.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Stop naming any per record file by its position in the response, re-derive the proof set either by merging to a native document and rendering separate files or by looping the merge one record at a time so identity is guaranteed per call, name each file from the roster on download, and re-read each rendered card against its stock number, price and mileage before the run is called checkable.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A manager approving six proofs in which the two silver Calders have swapped, so one car is hung with the other's price and mileage in its window, which at this band is not a design error but a misrepresented vehicle.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns pictures of used cars. IDENTITY: each listing is a specific vehicle a buyer will walk around in person, so a generated car is a different car and the listing becomes a misrepresentation; the two silver Calders in this intake are the point, not an edge case. SPEC: the marketplace enforces a published tile size and a hard rule that the first image carries no added graphic of any kind, and a generated image satisfies neither and cannot be checked for either. client_brief:
OSTRA tasting-menu images: dark, precise and still appetising

OSTRA is a 22-seat tasting counter. We have thirteen plate photographs from two services, and we need them to feel like the same room and the same menu. Dark should not mean muddy; glaze and food texture still need to read.

There are two different uses for the photographs. The house set needs atmosphere. The competitor-listing tiles need clean isolation and an honest plate outline. Please solve both from the supplied captures and show the relationship in the comparison sheet.

House treatment
Thirteen plates from two services and two pass lighting settings brought to one defended low light target with one temperature, one shadow depth and gloss that still reads as light, levelled where they were canted, plus one licensed camera-scale interior frame graded into the same darkness. Delivered with a per plate parameter log stating what was applied and why that plate needed something its neighbours did not, and naming any frame that could not join the set. This is one set with one target, not thirteen separately pleasing pictures.

Listing tiles
Per dish square tiles derived from the same masters but graded and cut for a white card in a competitor grid: the plate free of the slate with an edge that holds against white, judged in that context rather than on the room's black page. Every output at or below its source pixel dimensions with the returned tradeoff record for each, and no plate edge invented to reach an aspect. Where a quiet maker's mark is set in a tile corner it is the recovered vector mark rather than a shrunk raster logo, and it must still read on the white card at that small size.

Review sheet
A source-to-final contact sheet at matched scale that proves set consistency, identity or material preservation, and the disposition of every outlier. It must reference OSTRA house plate photography, one set across two services and function as approval evidence rather than decoration.

Files provided: ostra_service_one/ (7 plates, 5472 x 3648); ostra_service_two/ (6 plates); ostra_menu_card_autumn.pdf; ostra_room_note.txt; ostra_house_mark_plate.jpg (single frame); ostra_reference_darksite.png.

Also in the archive, for background only: ostra_covers.csv. These do not add deliverables to this commission.

Do not manufacture a cleaner plate shape to make the isolation easier. If a frame cannot join the house set, explain why and identify it clearly.

Please deliver a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports, a short production and exceptions note and Stock license and asset IDs. Account for every supplied file and identify anything used only as reference, superseded or rejected. Stay with approved facts and copy. Do not silently replace weak assets; use only the stated stock or concept allowances, and record omissions, substitutions, reconciliations and material compromises.

Fee range: $4,000-$8,500 fixed
Delivery target: 4 to 6 weeks
Included reviews: Direction approval, first-production proof, and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

price_band_and_audience: A 135 dollar seasonal tasting counter, guests 30 to 55 booking six weeks ahead for an occasion. The band is load bearing and it dictates a specific grammar: a near black ground, one plate per frame, generous emptiness, restrained saturation, and speculars on sauce and glass that still read as light rather than as blown white or flattened grey. That restraint is what a guest is paying for and what makes a six week wait feel reasonable. Grade the same plates bright, warm, saturated and crowded, with two dishes per frame and a garnish filling every corner, and the room reads as a 14 dollar plate at a busy bistro, which at this cheque size does not read as friendly, it reads as a mistake the guest is about to make. Push the other way into near monochrome art photography with the food unreadable and it becomes a gallery rather than a dinner, and a guest cannot tell what they are booking. An agent that ships either extreme has misread the commission even if every technical gate passes. A posted job of this shape runs 1,400 to 3,000 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.typography: A quiet editorial serif for course titles and guest names paired with a minimal sans for detail lines, set light on a near black ground. Spare and considered, neither bistro chalkboard nor hotel gilt.

A dark mode site reference screengrab was supplied as mood only, and course titles come spelled as the kitchen spells them.

assets_supplied.kind: Handheld photograph of OSTRA's house mark as it survives in the room: the wordmark and a small incised oyster shell device blind engraved into a subdued brass plate mounted at the end of the pass, shot at a raking angle under the room's single tungsten source so the engraving reads as relief rather than as ink.

It is a compound lockup, so a selection naming the whole mark returns the wordmark and silently drops the small oyster device, and the hairline serifs and the fine incised shell lines hold at full canvas but close into solid strokes at the height the mark actually reproduces at the top of the near black page and foil sized on the menu card.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: That on two of the second service frames the highlight move does nothing at all. The gloss on those speculars was already clipped in the capture, so there is no information left in that range to recover: the call returns ordinary success, the parameters are accepted, and the result is visually identical to the input in exactly the region the whole low light grammar depends on. The readout is that nothing moved. Whether a given specular still holds detail is a property of that individual exposure and is not visible from the frame at preview scale, nor stated by any tool, nor distinguishable from a highlight move that simply had a small effect.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it and no parameter prevents it, because the only way to learn whether a range still carries information is to move it and look; doing it right first time would mean knowing which two of thirteen exposures were clipped before touching them. (b) Nothing states it: the brief asks that gloss still look like gloss, which is the room's art direction, not a disclosure that two captures are already blown. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the answer is a different treatment for those frames, bringing the whole exposure down so the specular sits back inside the range and lifting the darks to hold the plate, or conceding the frame and naming it.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-plan those two plates from the master rather than from the corrected file, re-expose them so the specular re-enters the range and rebuild the shadow end underneath, re-judge them against the other eleven in a strip, and if the frame still cannot join the set say so in the note rather than shipping it at eighty percent and letting it define the hero.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A hero plate and a course tile whose sauce is a flat white shape and whose glassware has no edge, published as the first thing a guest sees on a dark page at a cheque size where gloss is most of the promise.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: That the card's text frame does not spill, it stops. The frame was set to last season's shorter course titles, and the records carrying a hyphenated double surname together with a dietary variant line run past its depth. There is no overflow, no error and no warning: the page exports, the page count still equals the row count, and the record is simply cut off at the frame edge with the pairing block missing. Which records do it depends on the interaction between this season's course titles and this particular book of covers, and the effect is invisible in every response and in the page count, appearing only on the rendered page of the specific records that overrun.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it: the frame's real depth is a property of the printer's original document and the overrun is a property of tonight's data, so it exists only once the two are merged and rendered. (b) Nothing states it: the brief says the card carries the guest, the date, the courses and the pairing, and the acceptance requirement that every record be complete at trim is the client's standing demand, not a warning that a frame truncates. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the response changes the template or the copy fitting rules, not the merge arguments.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Identify which records overrun by reading the rendered pages of the longest and most awkward records rather than the first few, then change the thing that actually fits: the frame's measure or depth in the template, or the course line breaking, or the treatment of the dietary variant, re-prepare, re-merge and re-render, and re-read those same worst case records plus the two with an empty pairing cell.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Forty cards printed and laid at forty seats, of which several are missing the guest's pairing flight or half their surname, on the one object every guest touches at a hundred and thirty five dollars a head.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the recovered mark is still the mark at the height it actually reproduces. The trace comes back looking correct: the wordmark is there, the oyster device is there, the counters and the incised shell lines are open, and at full canvas on a light page it is a faithful recovery. But the mark sits small at the top of the near black entry screen and foil sized at the head of the menu card, and at that height on a near black ground the hairline serifs and the fine shell lines fill in and the small counters close into solid strokes. image_vectorize takes no options at all, so nothing about the trace call can be tuned; the only evidence is placing the artwork at its real reproduction size on the near black ground and looking, and the near black ground is exactly where it is least forgiving.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it, because the answer depends on the trace, the reproduction height and the near black ground being present together, and the first two are produced by the agent while the third is a property of the room's own site. (b) Nothing states it: the brief asks for a mark that still reads as the room's, and the acceptance line that every serif hold at reproduction height is the room's own art direction, not a warning. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the response is a different raster preparation feeding the same optionless tracer, a differently worded selection, a fill and flatten plate instead of a binary mask, or a bounds crop that changes what the tracer sees, since the tracer itself carries no lever.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-prepare the raster on a different route, re-trace, re-inject the viewBox and strip the opaque ground path again, then re-place the mark at reproduction height on the near black ground and re-judge. Once a safe minimum height is actually known, raise the wordmark on the entry screens to respect it even though the supplied dark site reference's own retina shrunk apparent scale would set it smaller, which sends the placement back through the Express authoring step rather than leaving it where the reference implied.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The first thing a guest sees on the near black page is the room's name reduced to a row of solid blobs with the oyster device gone, and the same mark foil sized on the one object every guest touches at the seat, discovered on the glass and on the card rather than in the file.

decision_gates: Whether the reference card is evidence about its folder or only about the moment it was shot in, and what to grade to when the later half of that folder sits under a different pass setting.
Which of two low light directions to commit to, a cooler near monochrome or a warmer candlelit one, argued against a 135 dollar occasion counter rather than against one attractive frame.
How far to protect a specular per plate, given that the move that saves gloss on a glazed reduction flattens the rim on a dark rimmed dish.

How to reach a wider screen aspect without inventing plate or slate, which means a tighter crop or a different frame rather than a generated edge.
Whether thirteen files across two folders are thirteen dishes, and how to say so when one dish appears twice.
Which fields of the menu card can be mapped to frames of their own and which have to be reached inside a single flow, decided from the document's real inventory rather than from the printed card.
Which records to actually read in a forty record run, given that page count matching row count is not evidence about any page.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns beautiful pictures of food. IDENTITY: these are this kitchen's real plates, plated the way this chef plates them, and a guest who booked six weeks ahead on a generated dish is being sold something the pass cannot serve; the dish that appears twice under two platings is precisely the kind of fact a regenerated set erases. SPEC: the delivery platforms need square tiles that survive a white card in a competitor grid, the entry screens need exact canvases, and none of that is satisfiable or checkable from a generated frame. EDITABILITY: the menu card has to exist as a template the room re-runs every afternoon against a new book of covers, and the collateral has to be editable because the season changes, neither of which a flat render is. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: did this highlight move do anything at all, did this record print complete at trim, did the darkness survive the import. And the house mark is a specific mark cut into the room's own brass plate that has to be RECOVERED as vector paths rather than reinvented: a regenerated wordmark is a different room's name in a different hand, the site header and the menu card need closed paths that still read at a stated small height on a near black ground, and whether the serifs hold at reproduction size is exactly the kind of thing a flat generated logo can neither satisfy nor be checked for.

client_brief:
Colour-consistent apparel images and clean retailer cutouts

Our Northgrove range is affordable premium basics. Customers choose between colours and fabrics, so a polished set that changes either of those is not useful to us.

This commission covers the supplied six-style range and seven colour treatments. The photographs come from two shoots. Please bring them together before deriving the retailer versions, preserving weave, seams and the way the garments actually fold.

Photography and colour work: Six styles from two halves of a shoot brought to one studio look, and the seven colourways built out of the cloth on the carrier styles so that weave, fold shadow and seam shading survive the move, delivered at the product page and feed crops composed for the sizes each is actually used at, every output at or below its source dimensions, with a per style and per colourway parameter log and every resize or edge extension any tool reported. One coherent range, not seven separately optimised pictures and not one picture at four sizes.

Retailer plates and transparency: Each delivered style as a plate on the site's off white ground and as a transparent file at the marketplace feed's stated pixel dimensions, with genuine partial alpha at the edges and an edge that holds on the off white and on the club navy, judged on those grounds rather than on white. Where a style cannot be cut cleanly, it is named and its feed placement is carried by the plate route instead.

Check the finished edges on both off-white and club navy. Where the source cannot produce a convincing transparent cut, give us a usable plate and name the limitation. Do not hide it in a file that looks fine only on white.

Working assets: northgrove_styles/ (6 garment frames, 4200px long edge); northgrove_mark.png; northgrove_placements.txt; northgrove_copy.txt.

Also in the archive, for background only: northgrove_colourcard.pdf; northgrove_colourways.csv. These do not add deliverables to this commission.

Please keep the relationship between the original, colour treatment and exported file clear in the handover. That matters when we are comparing the range, not just approving one hero image.

Please work within $900-$2,400 fixed and the 7 to 15 business days target. Allow for one technical proof and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

Handover: a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports and a short production and exceptions note. price_band_and_audience: Elevated basics at 32 to 60 dollars, bought online by women and men aged 22 to 38 who are choosing on a phone and comparing against both a 9 dollar fast fashion tee and a 140 dollar heritage one. The band is load-bearing on almost every decision in the job. At 9 dollars an obvious flat tint over a garment shape is tolerated because nobody expects the picture to be the product. At 32 to 60 the whole proposition is that the cloth is better than it looks in the price, so a colourway that reads as a filter destroys the one thing the brand is selling and drives a return that costs more than the margin. It also sets the treatment: soft daylight, visible weave, real fold shadow, a neutral ground, no glossy retouch and no fashion editorial grade. A luxury treatment (deep contrast, cool shadow, hard rim light) misprices the capsule upward and reads as dishonest when the parcel arrives; a marketplace treatment (blown white, crushed shadow, oversaturated colour) misprices it downward. The mill cards are a trade document read by a dye house and by wholesale buyers, so they are plain, accurate and unstyled. The ledger records the base concept at 350 to 800 dollars; this fuller commission, with the merge run and the editable canvases, runs 1,200 to 2,400 dollars fixed.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: How this particular cloth behaves when a colourway is dialled into it. The base garment's mid tones, its fold shadows and its seam shading do not carry the same hue as each other, so one masked move that makes a colourway look convincingly dyed in the flat of the chest can push the fold shadows somewhere else entirely, and the tile still looks completely plausible on its own. Compounding it, the two halves of the shoot left the base hue itself different between styles even after the frames were brought to one look, so a parameter set tuned on one carrier style lands somewhere else on the other. Nothing reports any of this. The adjustment succeeds, the file comes back, and the divergence only exists across the family and across the style pair.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it and care cannot pre empt it, because the behaviour is a property of this weave, this dye and this light, and there is no readout of any kind for colour in this toolset. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the colourways must look dyed rather than filtered, which is the client naming her standing requirement exactly as she would to a designer, and the spreadsheet lists colourway names, not how far each one sits from the cloth she actually made. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the response is a different class of move (a desaturate and darken instead of a hue rotation, or a separate selection for the fold shadows so they can be moved on their own terms), a separate parameter set per carrier style, and possibly a written declaration that one colourway cannot be produced faithfully from this cloth, which changes what the mill card run carries.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re dial the affected colourways on a different kind of move rather than pushing the same one harder, split the fabric mask where the fold shadows need their own treatment, run a separate parameter set for the second carrier style, and lay the family out again rather than assuming the second attempt took. If a colourway still will not come out of this cloth, decide what to do instead, say so in writing, and reconcile the merge run and the launch canvases against that decision.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A capsule brand ships a product page where the deep colourways look like a coloured film over a photograph of a jumper, the exact thing its 32 to 60 dollar positioning cannot survive, and pays return shipping on every order where the parcel does not match the tile.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the transparent feed files actually hold on the grounds they get used on. The oatmeal marl crew sits at almost the same value as the warm grey paper it was shot on, and the knockout resolves that either by cutting hard into the shoulder seam and the ribbed cuff or by leaving a soft rim of captured paper around them. Which of the two a given style gets is a property of that frame's light and that garment's own value, not of the route chosen or the care taken, and both are completely invisible on white and on the site's own off white. The operation reports success in both cases and the returned file looks correct at normal viewing size, which is why nobody catches it until the file is sitting on a marketplace listing or on the club navy in the lookbook header.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it. The transparent version has to be made regardless of order, no metadata reports edge quality, selection masks come back with no intermediate values at all so there is no feather to inspect, and the defect only exists relative to the ground the file is composited on. (b) Nothing states it. The brief names the three grounds the pictures have to survive, which is the client describing where her files go, not a statement that any style will fail on any of them, and no asset note names a style. (c) It is not a propagation re run. The fix is a different operation on a different principle, naming the paper and inverting rather than asking for the garment, plus a decision about whether a style whose cuff will not cut cleanly carries the feed placement at all.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re cut the affected styles by naming the ground material and inverting rather than by asking for the garment, re composite on both grounds and inspect the cuff and shoulder again rather than assuming the second route worked, and inspect the styles that were not flagged at the same closeness, since the reason to look was found on one style and the rest have not been established as clean. If a style will not cut cleanly at all, move its feed placement to the plate route and say so.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The marketplace listing that drives half the season's volume carries a garment with a pale halo traced round its cuffs, and the lookbook header on club navy shows the same halo at banner size in front of the club's own supporters.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the mill's card actually became when it was converted, and whether the fields landed. The card's specification block is one continuous flow on the printed page, so the converted document's frame granularity bears no relation to the visual blocks anyone can see on the card, and the readout the mapping tool returns for that frame silently drops one run out of the middle of the story while keeping its line break, so the string still reads as well formed and every offset past the omission is short by exactly that run's length. The validator returns valid with zero warnings on those offsets, the placeholder step reports completed successfully, and the merge then produces cards that are missing two fields entirely while looking like finished cards.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it and care cannot pre empt it, because both the frame granularity and the dropped run are properties of this specific PDF and are only discoverable by converting it and reading the document's own story back out. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the mill wants its own card and hands over the PDF, which is the client supplying a template, not a disclosure about its internal structure, and no asset note or earlier step names a frame or a field. (c) It is not a propagation re run. The response is to recompute every offset from the document's true story text, restructure the mapping around the frames that actually exist rather than the blocks the card appears to show, re prepare the template and verify placeholder presence independently, which is a different method rather than the same call on changed input.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Round trip the prepared template and read its story back out rather than trusting either the readout or the success message, recompute all offsets from the reconstructed string, rebuild the mapping against the real frame inventory, re prepare, and confirm each expected placeholder is present before merging again. Then re merge and read an actual card, because a template that validates is not a card that carries its fields.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A dye house receives fourteen colour approval cards with the fabric composition and the dye lot reference missing, approves lots against cards that do not identify them, and the capsule is cut in the wrong shade of one colourway before anyone notices.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns pictures of garments that are not these garments. IDENTITY is the commission: these are six specific pieces the brand has actually cut and will actually ship, and a customer who receives a different fit, a different rib or a different weave than the tile promised returns it. A regenerated colourway is a guess about a dye lot the mill is about to run. SPEC: the marketplace feed wants genuine transparency at stated pixel dimensions, the product page wants crops composed at the sizes they are used at, the mill wants exactly one card per row of its own spreadsheet with that row's fabric, code and dye lot on it and that row's swatch in the window, and nothing may exceed its source resolution. A generated image satisfies none of that and a generated card is a fabricated trade document. EDITABILITY: one deliverable is defined by being editable, three canvases in one document the brand changes every season, with live text and real vector geometry. And the middle of the job is verification against material reality: does this cloth take this colourway, does this cuff cut cleanly on the ground it will sit on, did these fields actually land on the merged card. None of that is a generation problem.

client_brief:
Lip-oil shade concepts for a launch that has one physical sample

Important before you quote: Lumora has one physical lip-oil sample, not seven approved production shades. This is concept-colour work. Every result must say CONCEPT COLOR - SAMPLE APPROVAL REQUIRED.

We need a coherent seven-shade presentation built from fifteen phone photographs taken under three lighting conditions. Keep the bottle hardware and real skin believable while making the proposed shade differences legible.

The commission includes:

Fifteen phone frames from three lighting situations brought to one clean daylight look, and six additional shades built out of the single physical sample so that the highlight down the glass, the shadow inside the bottle and the shadow under it all move with the shade, with the gold collar and cap identical throughout, paired with an on lip detail per shade that matches its own bottle tile on real skin. Every output and comparison sheet must state CONCEPT COLOR - SAMPLE APPROVAL REQUIRED. The work may show relative direction only and must not claim production-accurate product or on-lip color.

Each shade delivered as a transparent file at the retailer feed's stated pixel dimensions, with genuine partial alpha and a clean edge on both the glass and the polished gold hardware, judged on the retailer's own ground rather than on white, and as a plate on the product page ground produced without a jpeg step anywhere in the chain. Every output and comparison sheet must state CONCEPT COLOR - SAMPLE APPROVAL REQUIRED. The work may show relative direction only and must not claim production-accurate product or on-lip color.

Shade card, PDP module, launch canvas and announcement as one editable document plus its source: Choose and adapt an Adobe Express template for these supporting pieces, using the supplied brand, approved copy and imagery. Select the strongest fit, replace the template content and correct its background as needed. Supply the editable design link and the requested export, in addition to the commissioned custom production work.

Please keep the concept status visible in the retailer files as well as the presentation. The glass and gold edges need checking on their destination backgrounds, without a JPEG intermediate that destroys transparency.

We are supplying lumora_bottle_session/ (11 frames, 4032px long edge); lumora_onlip_frames/ (4 frames, 4032px long edge); lumora_carton_flat.jpg; lumora_shade_list.txt; lumora_placements.txt; lumora_shadecard_template.pdf; lumora_shadecard_merge.csv.

Our decision is about whether these are useful sample-approval concepts, not whether a digital recolour can certify a manufactured shade. Please leave the editable supporting designs and clear source-to-output notes.

The final package should contain a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports and a short production and exceptions note, with every source file accounted for, including references and rejected or superseded material. Use the approved information without inventing missing facts. Only the stated stock or concept exceptions permit substitution; document every omission, replacement, reconciliation and material quality compromise.

The band is load-bearing throughout. At 6 dollars the shade grid can be a flat swatch chart because nobody expects the picture to be the product. At 38 dollars the customer is buying reassurance and the imagery goes editorial, low key and styled. At 24 dollars the whole proposition is that it looks more expensive than it is while still looking honest, so the treatment is bright, clean and daylight neutral, with real glass, a real shadow under the bottle and hardware that looks like metal rather than like a gold coloured shape. That decides the grade, the ground, the crop and the type: a moody prestige treatment misprices the range upward and reads as a lie when the parcel arrives, while a blown out drugstore treatment kills the one advantage the brand has. The on lip detail carries the same rule, because a sheer oil pushed until it reads as a lipstick is the fastest possible route to a wrong shade return. The ledger records the base concept at 300 to 700 dollars; this fuller commission, with the on lip range, the retailer feed files and the editable canvases, runs 900 to 1,800 dollars fixed.

assets_supplied.name: lumora_bottle_session/ (11 frames, 4032px long edge)
assets_supplied.kind: image
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The one physical sample, Amber Hour, shot on a phone over an afternoon. Five on the white sweep, three on a marble tile, three held in hand." Clear glass bottle, translucent amber oil, gold anodised cap and brushed gold collar.
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two things nobody at the brand can see. First, the sweep frames were lit from behind and the marble frames from the front, so in the backlit frames a specular ladder runs down the glass shoulder at almost exactly the oil's own value: a mask asked for the oil takes that ladder with it there and leaves it behind in the front lit frames, so one masked move lifts the highlight into a coloured smear on some frames and leaves a dead grey highlight on others, and both look plausible at grid size. Second, the gold collar and the cap both carry a warm reflection of the amber oil, so even a mask that holds only the oil leaves the hardware quietly belonging to the old shade, and any global temperature move shifts the gold itself.

assets_supplied.name: lumora_onlip_frames/ (4 frames, 4032px long edge)
assets_supplied.kind: image
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Four on lip frames from the same afternoon, one model, the same single shade." Close crops of the mouth and lower face with the oil freshly applied.
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: A sheer oil over skin is a different optical object from the same oil in glass: the model's own warm lip tone reads straight through the film, so a shade move that lands correctly in the bottle lands somewhere else entirely on the mouth, and the ring light's reflection sits across the lower lip exactly where the colour reads, so any move that touches it either colours the reflection or flattens it. Which shades survive the transfer to skin is a property of this model's lip tone and this light, and nothing in the frames announces it.

assets_supplied.kind: image

assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Shot under a shop fluorescent with the carton's gloss varnish throwing a bloom across the printed panel, so the colours in this picture are neither the carton's real ink nor the oil's real colour, and treating it as a colour reference sends the whole shade family off in one direction at once.

assets_supplied.kind: document
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The little printed shade card the boutiques want by each tester. This is the card our retailer's printer already runs, one per shade." A single small portrait card: a bottle picture at the top, a round colour swatch dot beside the shade name, the shade name large, the finish line under it, the twenty four dollar price, and the ingredient line and tagline along the bottom.
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The card reads as tidy separate fields with a colour swatch well beside the name, but it is not set that way. The shade name, the finish line and the price are one continuous text story in a single frame, so the offset each field sits at has to be reconstructed from the story text rather than read off the mapping, and the sample was built for the one physical shade so that story leads with the baked word Amber Hour. The round swatch dot that reads like a colour chip well is a decorative spot colour vector group, not a picture frame, so the only real graphic frame on the card is the bottle well. And the card is trim only at 55 by 85 mm: a PDF converted into InDesign through convert_pdf_to_indd carries no bleed box at all, because the connector sets the bleed box equal to the trim box, so no press ready with bleed card can be produced from this template however the bottle is placed, and the honest deliverable is the card at trim with the bleed shortfall reported.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: How the mask behaves on this particular glass. In the backlit sweep frames a specular ladder runs down the bottle's shoulder at almost exactly the oil's own value, so a selection aimed at the oil takes it with it; in the front lit marble frames the same wording leaves it behind. The consequence only exists after the shade move is applied: on one set of frames the highlight picks up the new shade and turns into a coloured smear where a real oil would keep a near neutral specular, and on the other the highlight stays where the old amber left it and reads dead against the new shade. Both come back reported as success, both look entirely plausible at full size, and the difference only shows at the size the product page grid actually renders the tile. Selection masks return with no intermediate values at all, so there is nothing about the mask itself to inspect that would predict it.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it and care cannot pre empt it: which wording captures the specular is a property of this bottle, this oil's density and the direction the light came from in each frame, there is no measurement of any kind available, and the mask carries no edge information to read. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the highlight and the internal shadow have to move the way real oil would, which is the client naming her standing requirement exactly as she would to a retoucher, not a disclosure that any frame will misbehave or which ones. No asset note names a frame. (c) It is not a propagation re run. The response is a second selection aimed at the specular itself so it can be held back or moved on its own terms, or a partial opacity fill through a separate mask instead of an adjustment, or dropping the backlit frames from the grid entirely, which changes which frame carries which shade.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Split the mask so the specular is treated on its own terms rather than pushing the same adjustment harder, or move the shade with a partial opacity fill through a second selection, then re place the tiles at grid size and look again rather than assuming the second route took. Inspect the shades that were not flagged at the same size, since the reason to look was found on one tile and the rest have not been established as clean. If a frame will not behave, move the shade it was carrying to a frame that will and re compose that tile's crop.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The product page shade grid, which is the entire buying decision at this price, shows several shades whose highlights are stained the colour of the oil and others whose highlights are grey, so the range reads as retouched rather than photographed and every shade in it loses credibility at once.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the shade decisions that are right in glass are right on skin. A sheer oil over a mouth is a different optical object from the same oil in a bottle: the model's own warm lip tone reads straight through the film, so a move that lands a shade correctly in glass lands somewhere else on the lip, and the ring light's reflection sits across the lower lip exactly where the colour is read, so a move that touches it either tints the reflection or flattens the lip into something opaque. How far each shade travels between the two is a property of this model's lip tone and this light. Nothing reports it, the on lip frame comes back looking like a perfectly plausible lip, and the mismatch only exists when the on lip detail is placed beside its own bottle tile, which is exactly how the product page shows them.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it: the comparison needs both the bottle tile and the on lip frame to exist, and a plausible lip is not evidence that the shade matches its bottle. (b) Nothing states it. The brief asks for an on lip detail per shade because that is what customers look at, which is the client describing a placement, not a claim about optics, and the honest list she asks for is explicitly bounded to which shades the sample bottle can produce. No asset note and no acceptance line names the transfer to skin. (c) It is not a propagation re run. The fix is a different class of move on skin than in glass, a separate parameter set per shade for the on lip frames, or a decision that a shade's on lip detail is carried by a different one of the four frames, none of which is the same operation on changed input.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Dial a separate set of parameters for skin rather than reusing the glass ones, aim a selection at the film on the lip rather than at the lip, hold the ring light reflection out of the move, then place each pair together again and judge the pair rather than the lip. Where a shade will not transfer at all, decide which of the four on lip frames carries it and re compose that detail crop around it.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Under every shade in the grid sits an on lip picture in a visibly different colour from the bottle above it, which is the single fastest route to a wrong shade return and to a review saying the swatches are fake.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether a licensed frame can sit under this range at all. Stock search returns a small CDN thumbnail, and the frame's true white balance, its true neutral and how hard its own light falls only exist once it has been licensed, downloaded at full resolution and brought toward the range's look. Two candidates that look equally bright and equally simple at thumbnail size can be a full grade apart at full resolution, and the specific risk at this band is not that a frame is bad but that it is too good: a professionally lit still life surface sits under a phone shot bottle and immediately announces that the bottle was placed on it, which is only visible with the licensed frame and the finished tiles laid out together.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it, because the comparison needs both the licensed frame and the finished range to exist, and it cannot be settled by care, because a 240 pixel thumbnail carries no information about light. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says only that there is nothing shot in a room and that a surface can be bought if it is needed, which is an invitation carrying no claim about how a candidate will behave. (c) It is not a propagation re run. The likely response is to abandon the frame and search again on different terms, which is a new licensing decision, a new grade and a new judgement, or to give up on a bought surface and extend one of the marble frames at its edges instead, which changes the launch canvas's composition and the type that sits on it.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Push the licensed frame further toward the range's light, or, if it will not join, return to Stock with a search framed by the light the range actually has rather than by the subject matter, license a replacement and re grade it, then lay the range out again and judge the whole set rather than checking the new frame alone. If nothing joins, extend one of the brand's own marble frames at its edges and re compose the launch canvas around the room that produces.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The tall launch canvas that carries the whole drop reads as a stock photograph with a product cut out dropped onto it, which at 24 dollars reads as a brand that could not afford to photograph its own product, in the exact placement chosen to say the opposite.

Which of the fifteen frames can carry a shade tile at all, and which lighting situation the range's one look is built from.
Whether to word a selection at the product or at the oil, knowing the two return completely different masks and only one of them can carry a shade.
Which class of move each shade needs, and whether the specular needs a selection of its own rather than riding along with the oil.
Whether a shade that will not come out of the sample is pushed harder, produced a different way, or declared unproducible in writing.
Whether the gold hardware is corrected by mask or left alone, given that every global move touches it first.
Whether the on lip frames get their own parameter set per shade, and which of the four frames carries which shade.
Knockout route per frame rather than per range, given glass and polished gold, and on which ground the edges are judged.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns a bottle that is not this bottle. IDENTITY is the commission: this is one physical sample the brand has actually tooled, with a specific glass profile, a specific brushed collar and a specific anodised cap, and a customer who receives a bottle that does not match the tile returns it and says so publicly. A regenerated shade is a guess about a fill the brand has not made yet. SPEC: the retailer feed wants genuine transparency at stated pixel dimensions with a clean edge on glass and polished metal, the product page wants a grid tile and a hero composed at the sizes they are used at, every on lip detail has to correspond to a real application of a real oil on a real mouth, and nothing may exceed its source resolution, which on phone frames is a hard ceiling. EDITABILITY: one deliverable is defined by being editable, four canvases in one document the brand changes every drop, with live text and a shade grid that is a real table rather than a picture of one. And the middle of the job is verification against material reality: does this mask take the specular with it, does this shade survive the move from glass to skin, does this licensed surface sit under a phone shot bottle. None of that is a generation problem, and the honest list of what the sample cannot produce is professional advice a render cannot give. And the retailer's shade cards are a genuine one record per page run: seven cards, page count equal to the shade count, each bound to that shade's own picture and printed with that shade's own name, where a card that prints the wrong shade's bottle is a physical wrong shade lie a customer holds in the shop, which is a merge and a verification problem against a printer's own file, not a generation one.

primary_craft_problem: Create a coherent, truthful image system from inconsistent source photography and prove it at the actual delivery sizes. The lead output is Kilnmore house photography, range and glaze surfaces.
client_one_liner: Our glazes photograph differently in every shot, the marketplace has bounced our primary pictures three times, and the only clean copy of our mark left is the tissue we wrap orders in.
client_brief:
A coherent ceramics range, with the glaze differences left intact

We sell the surface as much as the form at Kilnmore. Fourteen pieces and their glaze details need to become one usable product image library, but the work should not flatten the glazes into the same colour or texture.

The two shoots do not currently sit together. Please establish the common scale and light, then prepare the marketplace and transparent versions from those corrected masters. The glaze macro for each treatment must remain meaningful.

Range masters
Fourteen range masters brought across two sessions to one house target (one white point, one black point, one height in frame) with every glaze reading as the glaze the copy names, plus a separately targeted family of glaze surface close ups, one per glaze in the range with none standing in for two, plus one licensed camera-scale table frame graded into the same world. Per frame parameter log including a line on why each frame differs from its neighbours.

Product tiles and cutouts
Fourteen square marketplace primaries at intake size on a plain ground with nothing else in the frame, piece optically centred with clear air at every edge, plus fourteen genuinely transparent variants placed on the studio's warm grey for the store pages, both cut from the same graded master so the two never drift apart. Do not treat a trace alone as production approval: deliver transparent SVG, rendered small-size proofs, and an inspectable geometry report. Any unverified contour or fabrication tolerance must be labeled for supplier review.

Where each image can be used
A client-facing matrix showing each approved master at its actual placement ratios and sizes, with source dimensions, crop decisions, rejected frames, and no-upscale checks. It must reference Kilnmore house photography, range and glaze surfaces and function as approval evidence rather than decoration.

Our supplied material is kilnmore_range_captures/ (14 frames, 6000 x 4000); kilnmore_glaze_macros/ (8 frames); kilnmore_tissue_wrap.jpg; kilnmore_range.csv; kilnmore_notes.txt.

Also in the archive, for background only: kilnmore_shelf_card.pdf. These do not add deliverables to this commission.

We will look at the whole range together and at the difficult edges individually. Tell us when the source cannot meet a placement instead of quietly enlarging it or substituting another piece.

The commission is budgeted at $4,000-$8,500 fixed. We have allowed 4 to 6 weeks, including direction approval, first-production proof, and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

Alongside the finished work, we need a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports and a short production and exceptions note. Keep a clear record of the supplied files used, retained for reference, superseded and rejected. Approved source information remains authoritative. Record omissions, substitutions, reconciliations and quality limits, and do not use an undeclared replacement or invented fact to conceal a source problem.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: Primary anchor: the Upwork 'Graphic designer, advertising creatives' open call quoted in the ledger, in which a direct to consumer homeware brand asks for high performing static creatives, promotional graphics and multiple creative variations for testing, worked from existing brand guidelines, with clean, modern, conversion focused visuals and an ongoing collaboration. The real post names no client and attaches no images, so the line is laundered to the coined fictional matte-ceramic homeware label Kilnmore, and no real marketplace, network, ad product or trademark appears anywhere. Co-anchor one: the Freelancer.com post in which a small shop wanted a product photographer for ten to fifteen catalog shots plus a logo. Neither literal ask is connector work (it cannot operate a camera and it cannot draw a mark from nothing), so the commission is honestly re-cast as the post-production half a product photographer actually does at the desk: the client sends its own captures and a photographed printed mark, and the freelancer returns a matched set plus a recovered, placeable mark. Co-anchor two: the Freelancer.com brief from a vendor that already had product descriptions and a clean image set and needed the specification bearing retail material an intake team approves. The ledger's own repositioning note applies: a multi product grid catalogue is not producible, because a merge emits one record per page, so that anchor lands here as the per piece shelf card the stockists stand beside the work, built from the flat press card the studio's printer already prints.

price_band_and_audience: Considered handmade stoneware at thirty eight to ninety five dollars per piece, buyer thirty to fifty five, buying craft and buying a specific glaze. The band is load-bearing in an unusually literal way: at this price the glaze IS the product, so colour fidelity outranks punch, and the correct treatment is a quiet, neutral, slightly cool-to-warm-honest house look with generous air, one white point across the range, and no saturation lift that would make a celadon read greener than the piece in the buyer's hand. The same fourteen pieces at a six dollar mass-import band would correctly be graded punchy, warm and saturated and cropped tight to fill the tile, because there the picture is selling a category rather than a specific glaze, and a wrong hue is nobody's problem. Ship that treatment here and every returns email the studio already gets doubles. Push the other way into near-black grounds, deep shadow and styling props and it becomes a two hundred dollar gallery ceramics house, which misprices a thirty eight dollar mug and also breaks the marketplace's plain ground rule outright. An agent that ships either extreme has misread the commission even with every technical gate green. A posted job of this shape runs 900 to 2,200 dollars fixed.

assets_supplied.name: kilnmore_range_captures/ (14 frames, 6000 x 4000)

assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Four pieces are the bone and oatmeal glazes, whose glazed shoulder and rim sit within a hair of the pale sweep in value, so the one-call knockout hands back a cutout that looks complete and clean at preview scale while having quietly bitten the rim, and the bite is invisible against a plain near-white ground and obvious against the studio's own warm grey. assets_supplied.name: kilnmore_glaze_macros/ (8 frames)

assets_supplied.visible_description: "The surface shots for the product pages. Shot on the bench, not the sweep."
