emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether a vertical can be cut from these particular frames at all without either losing the subject or building pixels. On the horizontal frames the subject sits high and hard against one edge on several of them, and where it sits is a property of how each moment was actually shot, not something readable as a problem from the frame. The crop tool answers a vertical request either by emitting a tradeoff that says the crop needs the frame extended first, or by quietly interpolating up to a two times cap and reporting it only as an upscale factor and a tradeoff entry, with a plausible looking result at a plausible size in both cases. Which frames fall into which is only visible after the crop is asked for.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it, because the answer depends on the subject's position in each frame against the destination ratio, and there is no read-ahead and no parameter that prevents the interpolation. Cropping before grading would trade away crop choice for nothing, since the tradeoff still fires. (b) Nothing states it: the brief asks for the vertical for stories and the acceptance bar's no-enlargement line is a standing trade requirement, not a disclosure that the tool enlarges. (c) It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is a different route decided per frame: recompose the crop off centre so the subject survives at native scale, drop that frame from the vertical set and use another moment, or extend the short axis with the one sanctioned generative call and then re-judge whether the built edge carries the look, which the grading pass never touched.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Read the tradeoff record and the detection reading on every vertical rather than the response, re-plan the crop per frame, and for any frame extended rather than cropped, bring the extended master back through the look pass from the start, because the built pixels were never graded, then re-cut and re-inspect the seam at post scale.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A story set that is soft where every other post is sharp, or verticals that quietly show a shoulder and a wall where the piece used to be, on the format that carries a nine day drop announcement.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether a licensed frame actually sits with the graded month once the two are finally next to each other. Before licensing, the only readout is a 240 pixel thumbnail on a public CDN, which is enough to judge composition and subject and nothing like enough to judge the light, the warmth or how far the frame is from the look the month has just been brought to. The full resolution frame, and therefore its true colour, only exists after the license call, which is a purchase and not a preview. Whether the frame can be brought to the look without being pushed somewhere that makes it read as bought is only answerable with both sitting side by side.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering does not dodge it. Licensing earlier only moves the same purchase earlier, because the graded set has to exist before the comparison means anything, and doing it right first time would mean choosing correctly from a thumbnail that does not carry the information. The orientation filter is dead and long queries return nothing, so the candidate set cannot be narrowed on the qualities that matter either. (b) Nothing states it: the brief never mentions sourced imagery at all, and the client believes she shot the whole month. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the response is either a second license against a different candidate, which is a fresh cost decision, or a decision to run the partner page and the grid without a bought frame and rebalance the rhythm around what she actually has.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Place the downloaded frames beside the graded tiles at grid scale, judge them as a set rather than alone, and where a frame does not sit, either license a different candidate and repeat the comparison, or drop it and re-plan the nine-tile rhythm and the partner page around the real month, which changes which frames carry which canvases.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A grid whose one bought frame is the only thing anyone notices, on an account whose entire proposition is that it is a real person in a real studio, and a partner page built on a texture that contradicts the look it is meant to be selling.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the recovered motifs survive at the size they actually reproduce. Traced from a photographed sketchbook page they look clean and complete at full canvas, which is the only scale at which anyone has yet seen them. These are monoline brush drawings whose strokes are a few pixels wide at page scale and whose enclosed counters, the gap inside the mug handle and the opening under the kiln arch, are narrower still, so at the size a motif actually sits on a tile the counters can close, thin strokes can merge and the drawing becomes a blob that still reads as clean artwork in any inspection at canvas size. On her warm ground rather than on white it goes further, because the contrast that was carrying the thin strokes is no longer there. Nothing in any tool response reports it.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it. Reproduction size and the real ground colour do not exist until the canvases are composed, and judging a trace at full canvas is the natural and wrong thing to do at every earlier point. There is no parameter on the trace to tune, since it takes no options at all, so it cannot simply be done better the first time. (b) Nothing states it: the brief says she wants the drawings as proper artwork she can put anywhere at any size, which is her goal, not a warning that they fail small, and the acceptance bar sets a standard rather than disclosing an outcome. (c) It is not a propagation re-run, because the fix is upstream and different: re-prepare the raster so each motif carries more pixels per stroke before tracing, which means a tighter bounds crop per motif rather than one crop of the page, or change the placement, giving the motif more room and less ground contrast to fight, and then re-judge it there.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Look at each motif at its actual placed size on the actual ground rather than at canvas size, re-crop and re-trace the ones that close, clean the viewBox and the opaque ground path again on every new trace, re-check that all three are present rather than two, re-author the HTML around whatever placement size survives, and re-export and re-audit the canvases from the returned markup.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Three hand-drawn marks delivered as artwork she can use anywhere, which turn into dark smudges on every tile and on every label at exactly the size she uses them, on the one deliverable that was supposed to be recognisably her own hand.

Whether to spend three calls per motif on separate ink-level selections or one call on the page, and how to word each selection so it takes the ink and not the paper.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the month into a frontier image model and it returns attractive pictures of pottery. IDENTITY: this is her studio, her hands, her market Saturday and her own three inked drawings, and a regenerated frame is a different maker's month; the motifs specifically have to be RECOVERED from her sketchbook rather than reinvented, because a redrawn mug is somebody else's mark. Her glazes are the product, so a generated or drifted colour is a misrepresented 38 to 90 dollar object. SPEC: the deliverable is three post ratios cut from these specific captures with no interpolated pixels, plus a nine-tile grid that has to work as a set, none of which a generated image satisfies or can be checked for; and the piece cards are a one-record-per-page run whose page count must equal the catalogue and whose every card must bind that piece's own price, glaze and picture, which no generated sheet produces or can be verified against. EDITABILITY: the drop set is defined by being editable, because her dates always move and a retainer client cannot re-commission each time. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: can a vertical be cut from this frame at all, does this bought frame sit beside the month, do these counters stay open at the size the motif actually prints.

client_brief:
Give a small harbour hotel a distinct look without losing room accuracy

Nordhaven occupies a harbour warehouse with fourteen rooms. We want a distinctive image treatment for the brand, while keeping one room hero true to colour so guests can see what they are booking.

The photographs cover two visits. Please solve their differences before applying the signature tone and grain. The carafe, robe and key fob also need careful isolation for use on our black ground.

Booked scope
The property shoot brought from two separate visits onto one base and then carried to a single committed tone with one tint hue, one strength and one grain across the whole set, plus the one true-colour room hero for the booking page held deliberately out of the treatment, every output at or below its source dimensions, with per-frame applied settings, every resize or edge extension any tool reported, and any frame that could not be brought into the set named along with what happened to the placement it was carrying. Delivered at the placement crops composed for the size each is used at, which are part of this one set rather than separate deliverables.

The carafe, the robe and the key fob as genuinely transparent artwork whose edges hold on the near-black ground the booking page uses, judged on that ground rather than on white, with no edge bitten away where object and ground share value and no enclosed interior left filled with captured material. Each delivered both transparent and composited on the house ground, with the route used per object stated, and any object that cannot be cut cleanly named with what to do instead.

The true-colour exception is intentional, not a missed edit. Make it obvious in the file naming and notes. On the isolated objects, open spaces must actually be open; we do not want a dark backdrop patch mistaken for transparency.

Please work within $900-$2,400 fixed and the 7 to 15 business days target. Allow for one technical proof and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

We supply nordhaven_property_shoot/ (16 frames, 4,200 to 5,000px long edge); nordhaven_amenity_objects/ (3 frames, 4,600px); nordhaven_brand_notes.txt.

Also in the archive, for background only: nordhaven_room_card_2025.pdf; nordhaven_rooms.csv. These do not add deliverables to this commission.

Handover: a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports and a short production and exceptions note. Include an inventory showing how every supplied file was used or why it was set aside. Keep factual content tied to the approved inputs. Any missing coverage, substituted asset, reconciliation or quality compromise must be declared; a weak source is not permission to invent or silently replace it.

price_band_and_audience: Design-led micro-hotel, six hundred dollars a night, sold direct to design-literate 30 to 45 urban travellers who choose a property on aesthetic and book it because it looks like nowhere else. The band is load-bearing on nearly every decision in the job. At this level a committed, restrained, near-monochromatic signature is the product: the guest is buying atmosphere and a point of view, so the treatment has to be strong enough to survive being seen three pictures at a time in someone's feed. Run the same commission for a one hundred and twenty dollar highway property and every choice inverts: that booker needs bright, literal, reassuring colour and a clear picture of the bed, and this moody tint would actively lose them. The band also decides where the tone stops. The one true-colour room hero exists because a guest paying this much wants to see the actual linen, and an agent that tints it for consistency has followed the pattern and broken the commission. The same restraint governs the collateral: air, one photograph doing the work, type that does not shout, rates set quietly rather than as offers. Cheerful, saturated, discount-shaped design at this price reads as a property pretending to be something it is not. The ledger records the base treatment at 400 to 900 dollars; this full launch commission, with the cut-outs, the editable canvases and the fourteen-record card run, sits at 1,400 to 2,600 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.brand_assets_status: We work from a short brand note that fixes the near-black ground, the placements and the delivered sizes. There is no full guideline system yet, and the room list changes each season.

assets_supplied.name: nordhaven_property_shoot/ (16 frames, 4,200 to 5,000px long edge)
assets_supplied.kind: image
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Amenity and detail shots plus the rooms, from two visits, one in autumn and one in winter. They do not match." Bath and bedside details, the breakfast counter, the stair, the harbour window, plus one full-frame room.
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two things nobody in the hotel can see. First, two of the detail frames separate their subject from their ground almost entirely by hue rather than by value (a moss-green wool throw lying on an oak-grey bench, a terracotta cup on a rust-red tray), so any single tone ramp collapses both of them into one flat field, while each still looks plausible on its own at thumbnail size. Second, the winter visit was shot after the blinds were replaced, so those six frames sit a step darker in the shadows than the autumn ones and plug solid once a tint is committed on top of an uncorrected base.

assets_supplied.name: nordhaven_amenity_objects/ (3 frames, 4,600px)
assets_supplied.kind: image
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The carafe, the folded robe and the brass key fob, shot on our own surfaces so they would look at home." One object per frame, styled on the hotel's plaster and oak.
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The unglazed carafe is photographed against the hotel's own limewashed plaster and its shadow side sits at almost exactly the plaster's value, so an automatic knockout succeeds, returns a clean-looking file, and quietly bites the lip and the shoulder away on that side. The key fob is the opposite problem: its plate carries an enclosed cut-out letterform that a background removal cannot punch at all, so that route returns the hole filled with captured oak while reporting success.

assets_supplied.name: nordhaven_room_card_2025.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: document
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Last year's room directory card, the file the printer used." A real press PDF of a single-sided card carrying the room name, the floor and bed line, the view line and the nightly rate, printed and font-embedded.
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two things the printed page does not reveal. The card's copy was set around the shortest room name the hotel had last year, so the name frame has very little slack at the merged type size, and InDesign does not spill an over-long merged record, it simply stops rendering it at the frame edge with no warning anywhere. And the four visual blocks on the printed card do not correspond to four converted frames: the conversion's real granularity is a property of how the PDF was drawn, not of how the card looks.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the committed tone actually does to this particular set. A single tone ramp maps every colour in a frame onto one hue, so any frame whose subject is told apart from its ground by hue rather than by value loses that separation completely. Two of these detail frames are exactly that case (a moss-green throw on an oak-grey bench, a terracotta cup on a rust-red tray) and both collapse into one flat field. Nothing in either photograph announces it: they look like ordinary detail shots, they look correct in colour, the tint operation reports success, and each tinted file still reads as plausibly moody on its own at thumbnail size. The collapse only exists as a comparison against the rest of the set at reproduction size. The strength that carries the other frames is also the strength that kills these two, so there is no single setting that resolves it.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it and care cannot pre-empt it: which frames depend on hue for separation is a property of what was in the room that day, and it cannot be read off a colour preview, since in colour both frames separate perfectly well. (b) Nothing states it. The brief asks for one tone across every amenity and detail shot and names the single true-colour exception it already knows about; it says nothing about any frame failing, and no asset note or earlier step identifies these two. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the response is to go back before the tint and build luminance separation that was never there, by lifting or dropping one side under a mask, or to accept that these two frames are not treatable and change which frames carry which pages.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Return to the corrected base for those frames and separate subject from ground by value under a mask before re-committing the tone, then re-tint and look at the set again rather than assuming the second attempt took. Check the frames that were not flagged at the same reproduction size, since the reason to look was found on two frames and the rest have not been established as clean. If a frame will not separate without looking manipulated, drop it and re-plan the lookbook around the frames that survive.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The lookbook opens on two grey mush frames in the middle of a set that is supposed to be the property's entire point of difference, and they go out on the social canvases as well, in front of exactly the design-literate booker the direct-booking channel was built to reach.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the cut-outs hold where they are actually used. The carafe is unglazed and was styled against the hotel's own limewashed plaster, so on its shadow side the object and the ground sit at effectively the same value. The knockout succeeds, returns a clean-looking transparent file, and has quietly taken the lip and part of the shoulder with it. On white and on any pale layout that missing edge is invisible, because what is gone was pale anyway; on the near-black booking ground it reads as a bite out of the silhouette. Which of the three objects does this, and how far the bite runs, is a property of the styling in that one photograph rather than of the route chosen or the care taken, and no tool reports edge quality at all.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it: the cut-outs have to be made regardless of sequence, there is no metadata that describes an edge, and the defect does not exist in the returned file in isolation, only in relation to the ground it is composited on. (b) Nothing states it. The client says every version they tried looks fine until it goes on the dark, which is a client describing the symptom that made them hire somebody, not a statement of which object, why, or that the cause is a shared value on one side. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the fix is a different operation on a different principle, selecting the plaster as a material and inverting rather than asking for the object, and it carries a further decision about whether the object needs restyling advice back to the client rather than a cut.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-cut the affected object by naming the ground material and inverting rather than by asking for the subject, re-composite on the near-black ground and inspect the same edge again rather than assuming the second route worked, and inspect the other two objects at the same magnification, since one object having been caught is not evidence about the others. If an edge cannot be recovered, say so and propose the object be reshot on a ground that separates, rather than shipping a bitten silhouette.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The booking page, the one page the entire launch exists to convert on, carries a carafe with a chunk missing from its side, which is the precise defect the client hired someone to fix, handed back as fixed.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the fourteen merged cards are actually complete at trim. Last season's card was set around the shortest room name the hotel had, and three rooms were renamed this season with longer names and longer view lines. A merged record that exceeds its frame does not spill, does not wrap onto the card and does not raise anything: it simply stops rendering at the frame edge, so the card comes back looking like a properly composed card that happens to name a room slightly differently. Every automatic signal passes: the merge reports success, the page count equals the row count, the pages are in the printer's order and each card carries the correct room photograph. The frame's true capacity at the merged type size is not published anywhere and cannot be computed from the printed card, so the only way to know is to merge and look at all fourteen.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it and care cannot pre-empt it: capacity depends on the frame geometry the conversion produced and the type size the template carries, neither of which is knowable before the merge exists, and comparing string lengths against last year's copy gives no threshold. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the room list changes and hands over a spreadsheet with the new rates and views, which is a client describing their content, not disclosing that three records overrun. No asset note in the client's hands names the rooms and no acceptance line explains the cause. (c) It is not a propagation re-run: the response is a decision the client has to be involved in, shorten the copy, move the long field to a frame that can hold it, or change the type treatment on the card, and each of those changes the mapping and the design rather than repeating an operation on changed input.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Identify which records are cut, decide with the copy in hand whether the fix is an editorial shortening, a re-mapping so the long field lands in a frame with slack, or a type change on the card, then rebuild the mapping, re-confirm the placeholders in the round-tripped document, re-merge and look at all fourteen again rather than only the three that were caught.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Fourteen room cards go to the printer and sit on the desks of a hotel that charges six hundred a night with three of them naming the room half way through a word, discovered by guests rather than by anyone at the hotel.

decision_gates: Which single frame is the true-colour exception, and holding it out of the treatment when the headline ask is consistency.
How far the tone is pushed, given that at this band restraint is the design and the same strength that carries most frames destroys the ones that separate by hue.
Whether both visits are brought onto one base before the style is committed, or the style is committed on top of two different bases.
Where a global correction stops working and the move has to be masked to a named material rather than to the object sitting on it.
Whether a frame that collapses under the tone is rescued by building value separation or dropped from the set, and which page then carries which picture.
Knockout route per object rather than per batch, given that one of the three cannot be knocked out by background removal at all.
On which ground the cut-out edges are judged, when both failure modes are invisible on white.
Whether to extend a frame at its edges or accept a tighter crop, knowing extended material has to match the tone that was already committed.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns pictures of a hotel that does not exist. IDENTITY is the commission: these are sixteen frames of one specific building, one specific carafe and one specific brass fob, and the entire direct-booking proposition is that the guest is seeing this property rather than a generic mood. A regenerated interior is a misrepresentation on a booking page, which is a legal problem and not only a craft one. SPEC: the deliverables are defined by surfaces and numbers a generation cannot satisfy, genuine partial-alpha transparency that survives on a named near-black ground, crops composed at named delivered sizes with no output larger than its source, and fourteen cards at one record per page in the printer's order carrying the correct room's photograph. EDITABILITY: the lookbook set exists as a deliverable because the client edits it themselves as the room list changes, so it has to arrive as a native document with live text and real photographs, not as a flat picture of a layout. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: does this frame still separate once the tone is committed, does this edge hold on the ground it will actually sit on, does this record still fit its frame at trim. None of that is a generation problem, and none of it can be checked by looking at a render.

client_brief:
Foundry photographs for architects: one dark treatment, visible material

The furnace and rooflight give us two very different versions of Ironline Forge. We need an experienced retoucher to bring them together for architectural audiences and the expo.

This is the scope:

The shop-floor frames brought from two lighting conditions onto one base and then carried to a single committed dark tone with one hue, one strength and one grain across the set, straightened where the floor line rolled, every output at or below its source dimensions, with per-frame applied settings, every resize, downscale or edge extension any tool reported, and any frame that could not be brought into the set named along with what happened to the placement it was carrying. Delivered at the panel, story and social crops composed for the placement each serves, which are part of this one set rather than separate deliverables.

A calibrated side-by-side approval sheet showing white point, black point, skin or material color, and crop consistency across the finished set. It must reference Ironline Forge editorial image set and function as approval evidence rather than decoration.

The final treatment should be dark and controlled, with a consistent hue and grain. Please establish a neutral baseline first and keep enough floor detail for the space to remain believable. The panel, story and social crops are practical uses of that same set, not excuses to create three unrelated looks.

Source pack: ironline_floor_frames/ (14 frames, 4,000 to 4,600px long edge); ironline_maker_mark_casting.jpg; ironline_story_copy.txt.

Also in the archive, for background only: ironline_spec_card_2025.pdf; ironline_castings.csv. These do not add deliverables to this commission.

Please show the continuity sheet at a useful comparison scale and call out photographs that cannot reach the shared target. We need to understand any extension or resize before those images are placed in exhibition artwork.

The final package should contain a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports and a short production and exceptions note, with every source file accounted for, including references and rejected or superseded material. Use the approved information without inventing missing facts. Only the stated stock or concept exceptions permit substitution; document every omission, replacement, reconciliation and material quality compromise.

$1,800-$4,500 fixed; 2 to 4 weeks. Review structure: One direction checkpoint and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

price_band_and_audience: Heritage foundry selling bespoke architectural iron and bronze at five thousand to sixty thousand dollars a piece, to specifiers, architects and developers aged roughly 40 to 65 who are buying craft, permanence and the confidence that the piece will still be there in eighty years. The band is load-bearing throughout. At this level a committed dark single-tone editorial treatment is right because it sells process and provenance rather than product features: the buyer wants to believe there are people and heat behind the piece. Run the same job for a commodity fastener supplier and every choice inverts: that catalogue needs bright, literal, evenly lit product shots on white, and this treatment would read as pretension and misprice the offer badly. The band also governs the mark. A maker's mark struck into iron is proof of origin at this price, so it has to be recovered faithfully rather than tidied into a fashionable monoline, and it has to hold at the smallest place it appears, because a specifier reading a spec card is exactly the person the mark is meant to reassure. The collateral follows: generous type, plenty of black, numbers set plainly and honestly, nothing that reads as promotional. Bright, energetic, offer-shaped design here would tell an architect this is a supplier rather than a workshop. The ledger records the base concept at 900 to 1,800 dollars; this full trade-fair commission, with the mark recovery, the editable panels and the twelve-record card run, sits at 2,200 to 4,000 dollars fixed.

assets_supplied.name: ironline_floor_frames/ (14 frames, 4,000 to 4,600px long edge)
assets_supplied.kind: image
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Two afternoons on the shop floor." The pour, hand-finishing a bronze balustrade section, castings cooling on the sand, the pattern racks, the roller door and the yard.
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Five of the fourteen are lit only by the furnace, so their entire tonal range is compressed into a narrow band of orange and, once mapped onto a single tone ramp, the castings stop separating from the sand floor around them. Separately, three of the handheld frames carry a slight roll in the shop-floor line that reads as level in a full frame and becomes obvious the moment a tall panel crop is struck from them.

assets_supplied.name: ironline_maker_mark_casting.jpg
assets_supplied.kind: image
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The bracket with our maker's mark struck into it. That is the only place it exists." A 4,200px frame of a sand-cast iron bracket photographed on the bench, the mark struck into the face inside a raised border ring.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What a mark struck into raw sand-cast iron actually yields as artwork, and whether it survives the two placements the client named. The mark has no ink and no colour of its own: it exists only as the difference between a struck impression and the pitted face around it, and that face carries the same grey inside the letterforms' enclosed counters and inside the border ring as it does outside them. The trace comes back reading convincingly at full canvas, which is the only size anyone would look at it by default, and at the size it reproduces on a spec card the counters have closed solid and the border ring has merged into the letterforms, and reversed on the dark panel ground it loses its remaining edge entirely. Nothing reports any of this. The tracing step takes no options at all, so there is no parameter to have set correctly; the only lever is the raster preparation, and which preparation is needed cannot be chosen until the failure has been seen at real size on the real ground.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it and care cannot pre-empt it. The trace's fidelity is a function of this casting's surface texture, this photograph's light and the selection that produced it. There is no measurement, no preview at delivered size and no parameter on the trace, so an agent that words the selection well and gets the polarity right still cannot know how much of the mark survives without tracing it and putting it on a spec card. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the mark is struck into the iron and that it has to work small and reversed out of the dark, which is a client naming their hardest placements and their standing requirement exactly as they would to a designer, and asking for a note about where it holds is a request for professional advice rather than a disclosure that the answer is known. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The response is to go back and make a different asset: re-prepare the raster so the impression carries a usable edge before tracing, aim the selection at a different property of the photograph, or accept that the traced mark is a large-format asset and build a different small-size lockup from it, after which the panel, the story page and the cards are re-composed around a mark of a different weight and minimum size.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-prepare the raster to strengthen the struck edge before tracing rather than trying to repair the trace, re-select on wording aimed at what actually distinguishes the impression in this frame, re-trace, strip the ground path and inject a viewBox again, then re-place at spec-card size and reversed on the dark ground rather than assuming the second attempt took. If it still will not hold small, decide and state what carries that placement instead, and re-author the canvases and the card around the mark's real minimum size.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Twelve spec cards go into the hands of specifiers with the foundry's hundred-year-old maker's mark reproduced as a solid grey blob, and the stand panel carries a mark that has disappeared into its own background, in front of the exact audience the mark exists to reassure.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What last year's card actually becomes as a merge template. Two things are unknowable until the conversion has run and the document has been opened. First, the four cleanly separated blocks on the printed card do not tell you how many text frames the conversion produces, and if they collapse into one continuous story then per-frame mapping does not exist and every field has to be placed by character offset inside a single story, which is a completely different mapping strategy. Second, the mapping readout's account of that story omits one run (the reference line) while keeping the line break that followed it, so the string it reports still looks well formed and every offset after that point is short by that run's length. The validator returns VALID on those wrong offsets with no warnings, and the prepare step reports that the placeholders were created successfully, while some of them silently never landed. Nothing in any tool response distinguishes a template with six live fields from one with four.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it. Frame granularity is a property of how the PDF was drawn and is not under the agent's control or knowable from the printed page, and whether the readout's story matches the document's story can only be established by comparing them, which is running the operation. Doing it carefully does not help, because the readout is the artefact that is wrong. (b) Nothing states it. The brief simply says here is last year's print file and the spreadsheet, which is a client handing over what they have. No asset note in the client's hands, no acceptance line and no earlier step names the omitted run or the frame count. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The response is to abandon the mapping strategy and rebuild it on a different basis, offsets computed from the document's own story rather than from the readout, or per-frame replacement if the frames turn out to exist, which is a different mapping rather than the same one re-submitted.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Download and unpack the round-tripped document, reconstruct the story by concatenating its content runs, recompute every offset against that string, rebuild the mapping with the corrected positions in the order the tool requires, prepare the template again and then re-export and search for each placeholder by name rather than trusting the success message. If the frames turned out to be fewer than the printed card suggests, redesign which field goes where before any of that.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Twelve leave-behind cards are printed for a trade fair with the casting reference and the lead time silently absent from every one of them, which is the only information a specifier actually needs in order to call, and every tool in the chain reported success.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether a licensed installation frame can sit with the foundry's own photography under this treatment. Stock search returns a small CDN thumbnail, and the frame's true tonal range, its true black point and how much detail survives in its shadows only exist after it is licensed, downloaded at full resolution and carried under the committed tone. Because everything here maps onto a single hue ramp, colour is not what decides: a candidate joins or fails on luminance structure, and two frames that look equally dark and equally moody at 240 pixels can be a full stop apart once tinted, with one of them turning to a flat black field beside a set built on furnace light and hard speculars. The result is only visible with the licensed frame and the finished set laid out together.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot avoid it. The comparison needs both the licensed frame and the tinted set to exist, so it cannot be moved earlier, and it cannot be settled by care because a thumbnail carries no information about tonal range. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says only that they have no wide installation shot and to buy one if the panel needs it, which is an invitation carrying no claim about how a candidate will behave. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The likely response is to abandon the frame and search again on different terms, which is a new licensing decision, a new grade and a new judgement, or to resolve it instead by extending one of the foundry's own frames at its edges and accepting a different panel, which changes the panel's composition and the type that sits on it.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Push the licensed frame further under the tone, or, if it will not join, return to Stock with a search framed by the tonal structure the set actually has rather than by the subject matter, license a replacement and re-tint it, then lay the whole set out again and judge it as fifteen rather than checking the new frame on its own. If nothing joins, extend one of the foundry's own frames at its edges instead and re-compose the panel around the height that produces.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The tall panel at a trade fair stand, the largest thing the foundry will put in front of an architect all year, carries a bought photograph that visibly does not belong to the set beside it.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns a foundry that does not exist and a mark that is not theirs. IDENTITY is the entire commission: the maker's mark is a specific impression cut into a specific die by a specific person's grandfather, struck into every piece the firm sells, and a regenerated version of it is another workshop's mark being passed off as proof of origin to specifiers buying on provenance. The photographs are of this building and these castings, and an architect will stand in front of the panel at the fair. SPEC: the deliverables are defined by numbers and surfaces a generation cannot satisfy, a mark that must be placeable scalable geometry with a real viewBox and no opaque ground path, a stand panel at true physical dimensions produced without inventing a pixel, and twelve cards at one record per page carrying the correct casting's photograph with every mapped field present. EDITABILITY: the panel set exists as a deliverable because the foundry changes it before the next fair, so it has to arrive as a native document with live text and real vector geometry rather than a flat picture of a layout. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: does this trace still read at the size a spec card reproduces it, does this template actually contain the fields the tools said it does, does this licensed frame join the set once both are tinted. None of that is a generation problem, and the honest note about where the mark will not hold is professional advice a render cannot give.

client_brief:
Watch campaign treatment plus colour-accurate dealer product files

Two kinds of files are needed for Lunara Chronometry, and they must not be confused. The campaign can carry our tonal treatment; the dealer needs clean product files, including a dial-finish reference that stays true to colour.

Five watch references appear across nine campaign captures. Two photographers and different polariser settings have left the set inconsistent. Please reconcile that before applying a common grain and hue recipe.

CAMPAIGN
Nine campaign frames brought to one house target across two photographers and two polarizer states, then carried through one committed single tone treatment at one hue, one strength and one grain character, plus one licensed wrist frame graded and treated into the same world. Delivered with a recipe stated once and a per-frame parameter log that says why each frame differs from its neighbours, and with any frame that could not be brought to the set named rather than shipped.

DEALER
Five square store tiles at the store's tile size on a clean white ground with the watch optically centred and clear air at every edge, plus five dealer variants carrying genuine transparency everywhere the watch is not, including inside every enclosed gap in a bracelet, plus the one true colour dial finish frame held out of the treatment. Every output at or below its source pixel dimensions with the returned tradeoff record transcribed. One set with one cut logic, not one picture at several sizes.

Bracelet gaps are part of the cutout, not background to leave behind. The small retailer files should be optically centred and convincing at their actual use size.

You will be working from lunara_campaign/ (9 frames, 8256 x 5504); lunara_pdp/ (5 frames, one per reference, 8256 x 5504); lunara_details/ (6 macro frames); lunara_certificate_2025.pdf; lunara_register.csv (24 rows); lunara_notes.txt.

First, the killed original read that post as a video job and then asked for an already vertical 1080x1920 clip to be reframed to vertical, which is a no operation that would also have enlarged pixels; the whole video and audio family is additionally unretrievable in a headless run, so the honest fuller commission for that same client sits on stills, where 'multiple formats and variations' is a real mixed canvas set plus store and dealer variants. Second, the original persona and naming sat outside the benchmark's Western frame, so the house, its founder and its dealers are all Western. What survives from the real post is the actual ask: one recognisable look carried across every format a small direct to consumer brand needs at once, from one body of existing photography, delivered so the client can keep editing it after the freelancer leaves.

price_band_and_audience: Independent mechanical watches at 4,000 to 12,000 dollars, buyer 35 to 60, collector literate, buying on presence, finish and the credibility of a named regulator. The band is load bearing. At this price a committed single tone campaign with real grain reads as confidence: the brand is not selling a colour, it is selling a form and a hand. Run the same treatment on an 80 dollar fashion watch line and it reads as pretension, because that buyer wants literal bright colour on white and a legible price message. Run the fashion treatment here, bright saturated colour on white with tight benefit copy, and the pieces look like accessories and the four thousand dollar floor becomes unarguable. The store half inverts the same logic on purpose, which is why the true colour dial frame is carved out by name: a collector who cannot judge a sunburst finish from the page will not buy. A posted commission of this shape runs 1,600 to 3,200 dollars fixed.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether there is anything under the light on the sapphire to bring back at all. On four campaign frames the softbox specular is fully clipped across part of the dial, so a highlight recovery confined to a crystal selection returns a successful call whose result is, in the region that matters, identical to the input. The readout is that nothing moves: no error, no warning, no tradeoff entry, just a new file that looks like the old one. Which of the four are clipped through and which merely look bright is a property of each exposure and cannot be read off the frame by eye at preview scale.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No ordering avoids it, because the question is whether the pixels carry information and the only instrument that answers it is the correction itself. Nothing in the brief or the deliverable list says the glare is unrecoverable; the client asks for the dial to read, which is a goal, not a disclosure. The response is not the same call again but a different route: confine a darkening or a controlled tint to the crystal so the glare reads as deliberate sheen, or accept that this frame cannot carry the dial and re plan which reference the campaign leads with.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re examine each of the four frames after the correction rather than trusting the response, re route the ones that did not move onto a masked treatment that shapes the glare rather than recovering it, and re open the campaign frame selection where a reference has no frame in which its dial reads. The signature commitment in the next step then has to be judged against the revised set rather than the intended one.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A campaign where the hero frames of two references still have an unreadable dial, shipped as though corrected, on a line whose entire argument is a hand finished dial.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the transparent variants are transparent where the watch is not. Three references sit on bracelets whose link gaps are fully enclosed by the case and the folded clasp, and a one call knockout cannot punch an enclosed interior: it returns an alpha in which every gap is filled with captured sweep. On the white store ground that is pale grey on white and invisible at any scale. It becomes visible only when the cutouts land on a coloured panel at print resolution on the certificate proofs, where every link gap reads as a pale blob inside the bracelet.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering cannot dodge it because the defect is created by the only cheap route to a cutout and is concealed by the very ground the store requires, so a competent agent inspecting the store tiles sees a correct result. Nothing in the brief describes the bracelets or the gaps, and the dealer panel colours sit in a notes file as brand information rather than as a warning. The response is a different chain entirely, selecting the sweep by its own material properties, inverting, and filling or cropping from that, which is three calls per reference instead of one.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re derive the transparent variants for the bracelet references through the material selection route, re check the result against a coloured ground rather than against white, re bind the corrected pictures into the certificate run and re render the proofs, and re read the store tiles to confirm the white ground versions were not quietly rebuilt with a different edge.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Two dealers publishing product panels in which every watch on a bracelet has grey rectangles inside the bracelet, and twenty four certificates printed with the same defect at press resolution, all of which passed inspection on white.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the licensed wrist frame survives the signature treatment. Search returns a small thumbnail and nothing else, and the frame's real tonality only exists after the full resolution download. The specific risk in a single tone commission is that separation carried by hue collapses: a cuff and a skin tone, or a strap and a sleeve, that are plainly distinct in colour can sit at nearly the same value and become one undifferentiated mass once the tint is applied. Nothing in the search result, the thumbnail or the tint call reports this; the tinted file is returned successfully and reads as an intentional soft frame until it is set beside the treated campaign set.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: There is no ordering that reveals it earlier, because the information does not exist until the frame is licensed, downloaded and run through the committed recipe. Nothing states it: the brief asks only for a wrist shot the house does not have. The response is a decision rather than a re run, either license a different frame chosen for value separation rather than for colour, or introduce the separation before the tint with a confined darkening on one region, each of which changes what the campaign canvases can do with the frame.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re open the Stock selection against value separation rather than against subject appeal, or build a confined tonal separation into the frame before the tint and judge it again beside the set, then revisit which canvas the lifestyle frame carries, since a frame that only works small cannot lead the wide canvas.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A campaign set whose one human frame reads as a grey smear beside nine crisp product frames, or worse, is quietly dropped, leaving the house with no lifestyle image at all after paying for one.

decision_gates: Whether nine frames from two photographers can become one set, and how far to push the two polarized frames before they stop being worth saving.
Grade first and tint after, versus tinting straight from the source, when a single tone treatment hides disagreement without removing it.
How to word the crystal selection so it takes the material rather than the object it belongs to, and whether to confine a correction or shape the glare deliberately.
The signature itself: which hue, what strength, how much grain, judged as one recipe against a collector band rather than against the most flattering hero.
Which frame is held out in true colour, and how visibly it is excluded, since accuracy and the signature are in direct tension on that one page.

Knockout route per reference: the one call route for a coherent strap piece versus a material named sweep selection inverted and filled for a bracelet with enclosed gaps and for a mirror polished case that carries the sweep in its flank.
Whether to trust a confident looking crop on sparse macro art or to spend the extra calls on an explicit selection.
How to report the register when a serial appears twice with different calibers and one reference has no usable picture, without quietly choosing for the client.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns handsome pictures of watches. IDENTITY: these are five specific references with their actual dials, hands, engraving and bracelet construction, and twenty four specific serials with a named regulator's initials and timing results; a regenerated watch is a different company's product and a regenerated certificate is a forgery of the house's own document. SPEC: the store needs square tiles at an exact size with air at every edge and no interpolated pixels, the dealers need genuine transparency inside a bracelet, and the certificate run needs exactly one page per register row in register order with the right picture on the right serial, none of which a generated image satisfies or can even be checked for. EDITABILITY: the campaign set is defined by being editable, because the featured reference will move and an eight person house cannot re commission four canvases every season. And the middle of this engagement is verification against material reality: did anything move under that glare, is this cutout transparent where the bracelet has holes, did every field actually land on the card.

Apexguard's bench, driveway and dusk photographs need a shared dark treatment. We also need the existing sticker/window mark recovered, not redesigned.

Eighteen frames brought to one dark house target across a bench, a daylight driveway and two dusk captures, with the dusk corrections confined so the paint holds while the concrete is neutralised, plus one licensed installer bay atmosphere frame graded into the same world, plus the wide banner built from the single frame carrying the whole flank with any built region disclosed. Per frame parameter log with a stated reason wherever a frame differs from its neighbours, and any frame that could not be brought to the set named rather than shipped.

Square 2000 x 2000 px product tiles on plain white with the part optically centred and clear air at every edge, plus transparent variants, with the cut edge holding along the machined flanks at full resolution against both white and the house dark ground. Scoped to the six SKUs that actually have a genuine isolatable bench part frame (V-PPF-104, V-PPF-105, V-PPF-107, U-TNT-204, U-TNT-208 and F-HW-301); the other twelve SKUs resolve to driveway or lifestyle car frames with no machined part to isolate, or to a mismatched stand-in (F-HW-302 points at a heat gun while its own tension roller has no bench frame), and are carried in the SKU reconciliation rather than forced onto white. Every output at or below its source pixel dimensions with the returned tradeoff record transcribed per file. One set with one cut logic, not one part at several sizes.

The master mark recovered from the two objects it survives on, delivered as placeable scalable artwork with a transparent ground, a real viewBox present and no opaque full canvas rectangle riding underneath, in a single colour form and a colour-accurate variant, holding at label size and at thumbnail sticker size on the house dark ground as well as reversed on light. Do not treat a trace alone as production approval: deliver transparent SVG, rendered small-size proofs, and an inspectable geometry report. Any unverified contour or fabrication tolerance must be labeled for supplier review.

The F-HW-302 mismatch needs to remain visible in the handover: a heat gun is not a photograph of the missing roller. Please protect actual paint colour while adjusting the surroundings, and disclose any constructed banner regions.

price_band_and_audience: Aftermarket film, tint and hardware at 250 to 1,200 dollars a line item, bought by independent installers aged 25 to 45 who resell to enthusiast end customers and who judge a supplier on whether the packaging looks like it belongs in a shop they are proud of. The band is load bearing in both directions. A dark, restrained, high contrast system with one accent reads as a supplier who is confident about margin, which is exactly what lets an installer justify the price to a customer standing at the counter. A 30 dollar universal accessory brand would correctly ship bright product on white with the price and the fitment shouting, and that treatment here makes the 1,200 dollar line item look overpriced. Push the other way into black on black minimalism with no fitment information and the installer cannot find the SKU on the shelf, which is a real operational failure, not a taste failure. The client's own exclusions, no mascots, no vintage badges, no heavy gradients, are the guard rails against the tuner register that would drop the brand a band. emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the recovered mark survives at the size it is actually printed. Both source objects were traced from photographs, and the tracing tool takes no options at all, so the only lever is the raster preparation. A trace that is clean, complete and correct at full canvas can close its tightest counters once it is set at label size, and the closure is worse on the house dark ground than on white because a filled counter and a solid stroke become one shape. Whether it happens, and to which letterforms, depends on this object's ink spread, this photograph's contrast and this trace's path simplification, none of which are reported anywhere.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Nothing avoids it by ordering, because the artwork must exist before it can be set at reproduction size, and the tracing tool exposes no threshold, no colour count and no simplification control that could be set correctly in advance. Nothing in the brief states it: the client says only that the mark will sit small and on a dark ground, which is a requirement rather than a disclosure. The response is not the same call again but a different upstream route, re preparing the raster with a tighter ink level selection, switching to the other surviving object, or reversing the mark so it is knocked out light on the dark ground, which changes which counters have to survive at all.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re run the recovery from the alternate object or with a differently prepared raster, re inject the viewBox and re strip the ground path, re judge at both real sizes on the real ground rather than at full canvas, and then re derive the three sub brand states from whichever mark was actually accepted.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A rebrand shipped on boxes, labels and thumbnail stickers where the master mark is a dark blob on a dark ground at every size the customer actually sees it, with the only version that reads being the one in the presentation.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether every fitment line actually fits. The label's fitment block is a fixed measure frame, and the printed sample carries the shortest fitment string in the range, so the printed page is actively misleading about the frame's real measure. On the longer records the merged text does not overset visibly and raises nothing: it simply stops rendering at the frame edge, mid word, while the run still returns one page per row with no error, no warning and no overset flag. The truncation point is a property of the converted frame's bounds, which the printed label does not disclose.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No ordering avoids it because the frame's real measure only exists after the conversion and only bites once real data is flowed into it, and the record range spans twenty two to a hundred and ninety characters, so the failure appears only on records that are not at either end of the file. Nothing states it: the client says the run should sit in the same footprint because the stock is bought, which is a constraint, not a warning. The response is a decision about the data and the mapping, moving the fitment field to a frame with real measure, splitting it, or applying the abbreviation the client's own approved wording permits, not merging the same mapping again.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Read every proof rather than the first and the last, identify which records truncate, re decide where the fitment field lives or how it is written, rebuild the mapping against the reconstructed story text, re confirm the placeholders in the round tripped document, then re merge and re render and read the proofs again.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Eighteen labels printed on stock the client has already bought, on which the SKUs with the longest fitment lines, which are exactly the ones an installer most needs to check, stop mid sentence at the edge of the block.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the width the banner needs can be built at all on this frame. The only capture carrying the whole flank is near square, so the banner cannot be cropped from it and the short axis has to be extended, which is the one generative operation available. What the extension actually produces is invisible until it is run and looked at: it may continue the body line into a shape the car does not have, invent a second arch or a reflection of a sky the shot does not contain, and it builds those pixels from a neighbourhood whose black point and warmth may not match the graded set once the two sit side by side at banner width. The call returns success and a plausible image either way.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering does not dodge it, because expanding before grading and expanding after grading both leave the same question open, namely whether the invented content is truthful to this vehicle, and no parameter controls that. Nothing states it: the brief says only that this is the one good shot of a finished car. The response is a decision rather than a re run, either accept the built width, reduce the banner ambition to what the frame genuinely carries, or re plan the banner around a different frame that has width but not the flank, each of which changes the trade show piece.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Inspect the built region beside the graded set at banner width rather than at preview scale, decide whether to keep, retreat to a narrower banner, or rebuild the piece around a different frame, then re compose the trade show canvas around whichever survives and re state in the note that a region of that image was built rather than photographed.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A trade show banner two metres wide in which the client's own customer's car has an extra arch or a seam of different black at the join, presented to installers as the flagship example of the client's work.

decision_gates: How to re read a posted identity brief when the identity cannot be drawn: what recovery, type and placement can honestly deliver, and what has to be said plainly to the client instead.
Which of the two surviving objects to recover the mark from, given one is distorted by a curved substrate and the other was already compromised by print at size.
How to word the ink level selection so it takes the mark rather than the glass, the reflected sky or the box lid, and which polarity to trace.
Whether the two colour trace or the colour accurate plate is the deliverable, judged at reproduction size on the house dark ground rather than at full canvas.
Whether to reverse the mark on the dark ground, which changes entirely which counters have to survive.
How to reach three sub brand states from one mark when the hue range available is moderate, and when to move value instead of hue.
Cut route per part: the cheap route for a part that separates from the bench versus a material named bench selection inverted and filled for an anodized part whose flank shares value with the ground.
Whether to build width on the banner frame at all, and whether what gets built is truthful to that car or has to be abandoned for a narrower banner.

Twenty product masters brought to one honest target across two rigs and two days, one white point, one black point, one warmth, with the indigo dye and the reactive glaze reading as the material reads rather than as the founder's phone picture reads, plus the licensed room-set frames graded into the same world. The engagement is built to the posted-job archetype the ledger records for this slot, which is a standing category on both marketplaces: a small homeware maker whose product photography was shot honestly but not consistently, whose colour-driven return rate is the actual business problem, and who needs the season's catalogue rebuilt when the design file has gone with a studio that closed. The two halves that make it a real commission rather than an exercise are both in that archetype too. First, the printed catalogue is a genuine variable-data run at volume, one product to a page across thirty two records, which is exactly the InDesign merge case the rebuild guidance reserves for record-per-page work, and the client has only the press PDF the printer kept, which is the flagship posted shape (flat artwork plus a spreadsheet, no native file). Second, the sale campaign deliberately contradicts the catalogue, which is what a homeware brand actually buys in autumn. The REBUILD verdict applies because the concept as the ledger held it sat on a single imaging surface and its deliverable list amounted to one photograph in two treatments, which the rework guidance rejects outright. Everything named is invented: Thornmere Home, the Providence workshop, the fourteen stockists, the spring catalogue and the autumn SKU list.

price_band_and_audience: Mid-premium homeware at forty five to a hundred and eighty dollars, buyer thirty to fifty, design literate and buying to keep. The band is load-bearing in both directions. At this price the catalogue must be quietly warm, generous with white, and honest about glaze and dye, because the customer is buying material and the return rate is the whole commercial argument. Push it into the near-black grounds, hard raking light and extreme sparseness of a six hundred dollar collectible ceramics house and a hundred dollar mug looks mispriced and the honesty claim dies with it. Push the other way into the saturated, prop-crowded, tightly filled tiles of a ten dollar discount homeware range and the range reads as an import, and a separate campaign treatment would never have been commissioned at all. The campaign half carries the same test: a restrained single tone reads as a considered seasonal break at this band, while a loud multicolour promotional look reads as clearance. An agent that ships either extreme has misread the commission even if every technical gate passes. A posted job of this shape runs 1,800 to 3,800 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.tagline: Made by hand, kept for years.
brand_identity.sector: Mid-premium homeware: glazed stoneware and woven textiles
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded in Providence, Rhode Island. A two-person workshop selling direct to consumer and wholesale into fourteen independent stores across the Northeast.
brand_identity.about: Thornmere Home makes glazed stoneware and woven textiles in a small Providence workshop, around thirty-two products a season priced from forty-five to a hundred and eighty dollars. The work is honest material: real glaze, real dye, thrown and woven by people who sign for it. Ceramics are shot standing, textiles draped, and the range is meant to read as one quiet, warm family rather than a catalogue of individual objects. The season turns on autumn, when the palette deepens and the catalogue goes back to the printer, one product to a page.
brand_identity.audience: Buyers roughly thirty to fifty who nest and furnish slowly. Design literate, buying to keep rather than to chase a trend. Neither farmhouse cliche nor design-gallery cool, just people who want warm, made things in the house.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Mid-premium. Generous with white space, warm and truthful about material, never the austere near-black of collectible ceramics and never the crowded, saturated look of discount homeware.
brand_identity.typography: A humanist serif for product names and section headers, paired with a quiet grotesque for prices, dimensions and care lines. Restrained sizes, generous leading, plenty of air.
brand_identity.voice: Plain and warm. Short sentences about material and making, not about lifestyle. The maker writes the care lines and they stay in the maker's own words, unreworded.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: No brand guidelines were ever written down. The autumn catalogue was built by an outside studio that has since closed and kept the working layout file, so only the printer's press PDF of the spring catalogue survives. The catalogue has to be rebuilt from that press PDF and the season's spreadsheet.
brand_identity.values: Truth to material, longevity over trend, and steady support of the independent stores that carry the range.

assets_supplied.name: thornmere_autumn_shoot/ (14 frames, 4992 x 3328)
assets_supplied.kind: In-studio product photography shot over two days on one pale seamless, ceramics standing, textiles draped over a form.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "All of it in one studio over two days, same sweep, same corner. Ceramics standing, textiles draped."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Four of the fourteen are styled as a pair or a stack, two separate masses with a band of sweep between them, and the one-call knockout needs a single coherent blob: it returns a clean, complete looking cutout of the larger mass and silently discards the other at full success. Two of the ceramic forms are pierced pitchers whose handle loops enclose sweep the same tool cannot punch, and against the catalogue's own white ground neither failure shows at all.

assets_supplied.name: thornmere_textile_flatlays/ (6 frames, 4992 x 3328)
assets_supplied.kind: Woven throws and table runners shot flat on a later day under a different rig.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The throws and the runners, shot flat. Different day, but the same sweep."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The indigo throw sat under a warmer source than its five neighbours and its dye reads violet, so the warmth move that brings the other five together pushes that one further out and it needs a correction confined to the cloth. Naming the object in a selection pulls the mask onto the whole flatlay including the sweep, and only naming the dye's own colour and weave takes the cloth itself.

assets_supplied.name: thornmere_spring_catalog_press.pdf (24 pages)
assets_supplied.kind: The printer's press PDF of last season's catalogue, one product to a page, with placed product photography and a caption stack under each.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "What the printer still has on file. Our old studio has the InDesign and will not answer our emails."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The per-product caption reads on the printed page as a stack of separate lines, but the granularity the conversion actually exposes as editable frames is not predictable from the printed page and is not under anyone's control. The readout of a block's own text silently omits one run while keeping its line break, so the string still looks well formed, every offset computed past it lands short, and the validator passes it without a warning.

assets_supplied.name: thornmere_autumn_skus.csv (32 rows)
assets_supplied.kind: Plain CSV: SKU, product name, dimensions, materials, care line, price, and a picture filename column.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Everything the catalogue needs. The care lines came from our maker so please do not reword them."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Three SKUs point at a filename that is one of the styled pair frames, so those three products have no solo photograph anywhere in the package and nothing in the sheet says so. The care lines run from four words to two full sentences, and a fixed frame does not spill when the long ones arrive, it simply stops rendering.

assets_supplied.name: thornmere_colour_note_phone.jpg
assets_supplied.kind: A phone photograph of the indigo throw lying on the founder's kitchen table, sent by message as the colour reference.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "This is what the indigo actually looks like in real life. Match to this."

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the one-call knockout has actually returned the whole photograph. Four of the fourteen product frames are styled as a pair or a stack, two separate masses with sweep between them, and the tool's subject detection needs one coherent blob: on those frames it returns a clean, complete looking cutout of the larger mass and silently discards the other, at full success with no warning. Two of the ceramic forms are pierced pitchers whose handle loop encloses sweep, and an enclosed interior cannot be punched at all, so the loop comes back filled with captured ground while the outer edge looks immaculate. Both failures are invisible against the store's white ground, which is the ground the agent is most likely to be inspecting on, and appear only against the wholesale partner's colour. Which frames carry which failure is a property of how each shot was styled and how each form is built, and cannot be read off the response.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering does not dodge it, because the knockout is what produces the evidence and no parameter controls either behaviour. Nothing states it: the client describes ceramics standing and textiles draped and never says which frames hold two objects, and the acceptance line about transparency being genuine everywhere is the wholesale partner's standing requirement rather than a disclosure. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is a different chain per frame, a material-named selection inverted and filled, or per-element selections composited, rather than the same call again.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-plan the knockout route for the affected frames, re-derive their white-ground plates and transparent variants through selection and fill rather than through the one-call route, re-inspect every cutout against a colour rather than against white, and carry the finding into the SKU reconciliation because a discarded mass may be the only photograph a product has.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Transparent variants that show half a styled pair and a handle loop full of studio sweep on the wholesale partner's own coloured pages, on a range whose entire pitch is that the picture tells the truth.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the placeholders that were reported as created are actually in the document. The mapping tool's readout of a frame's text can omit an entire run while keeping that run's line break, so the string it hands back still looks well formed and correctly punctuated. Every offset computed from it past the omission is short by exactly the length of the dropped run. The validator then passes the mapping as valid with zero warnings, and the placeholder step reports completion. The document that comes out has some placeholders and not others, and nothing in any response says which. The only channel that tells the truth is exporting the IDML again and reading the story runs, and the discrepancy is invisible until that is done.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No ordering avoids it, because the readout is the only text the mapping tool offers and there is no flag that reveals the omission; doing it right first time presumes already knowing that the readout and the document disagree, which no tool docstring, no error and no validator result discloses. Nothing states it, since the brief only says the printer has the press PDF. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is to derive the offsets from a completely different source, the document's own content runs, and rebuild the mapping from those.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Rebuild the mapping object from offsets computed against the reconstructed story text, re-run the placeholder preparation, round-trip the IDML again and confirm every expected field is present before any merge is attempted, then re-merge and re-render.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A thirty two page catalogue delivered to a printer in which the price and the care line are simply absent from every page, having been reported as valid and successfully created at every step of the way.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: How the importer normalises the thing the campaign look is actually built on. A single tone, grainy, moody set needs something that lifts the product off the ground and holds the type against it, and the natural authoring constructions for that are a soft blurred scrim behind the type or a layered shadow under the product. The importer discards a blur filter outright and truncates a layered shadow to its first layer, both at full success with no warning of any kind, and the document's own rendition returns the first artboard only, so the tall and square canvases can be checked through no other channel than the returned per-canvas markup. Whether what survives still reads as moody, or as flat type sitting on a grey smear, is only visible after the export.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No ordering avoids it, because the drop happens at import and the import is the last step. Doing it right first time presumes knowing which of several equally plausible constructions survives, which nothing reports and no checklist enumerates. Nothing states it: the brief asks for one colour, grainy and moody, and the acceptance line about the atmosphere surviving onto all three canvases is the client's own art direction. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is a different upstream asset or a different construction, moving the atmosphere into the raster where the importer cannot touch it, or reducing it to the single layer that survives and re-judging whether it still reads.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-cast the atmosphere into the campaign masters themselves or down to the surviving single layer, re-author the HTML around whichever it is, re-upload, re-run the readiness check, re-export, and audit all three canvases from the returned markup rather than from the first artboard.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A campaign delivered as an editable file in which the two canvases nobody looked at are flat, the type is sitting unsupported on the photography, and the export reported success throughout.

Which frames need a correction confined to the material and which can take a whole-frame move, and how to word a selection so it takes the dye rather than the flatlay.
Knockout route per frame: the one-call route for coherent single forms versus a material-named selection inverted and filled for the styled pairs and the pierced handles.
Which ground to inspect a cutout against, given that the store's white hides exactly the failures the wholesale partner's colour exposes.
What can honestly be promised about the catalogue's field mapping before the conversion has been opened and read.
How to represent the three SKUs that have no solo photograph, given that inventing one is not available and shipping a pair frame as a single product is dishonest.
The campaign recipe: how far the single tone and the grain can go before the range stops being the same brand, and how the same recipe reads at three very different canvas scales.
