why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns pictures of pottery. IDENTITY: these are this maker's actual thirty two products with their actual glazes and dyes, and the entire commercial argument is that the picture matches the parcel, so a regenerated jug is a different company's product and a regenerated indigo is the return the client is trying to stop. SPEC: the catalogue is a press-ready document of exactly thirty two pages in the spreadsheet's record order with the maker's own uneditable care lines intact at trim, rebuilt from the printer's file, and no generated image is a document or can be checked for record count. EDITABILITY: the campaign is defined by being editable, because the dates move and the founders explicitly cannot re-commission, and the merge template is defined by being live so next season is a data swap rather than a rebuild. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: did this knockout return the whole photograph, did this placeholder actually land in the story, did the atmosphere survive the import onto the canvases nobody can preview.

client_one_liner: We own two studio pictures of a can and not one photograph of a person, a table or a summer afternoon, and the summer site has to be live before the season.
client_brief:
Build a believable soda image set around two imperfect packshots

Fennhollow has two packshots that have already been pushed too far in retouching, and no lifestyle shoot. We need a product retoucher with a good eye for licensing compatible photography and for knowing when to stop correcting a damaged source.

We want warm daylight that feels like one afternoon, not a stock image beside an unrelated can. The green labels need to remain our green.

One warm daylight family reading as taken on the same afternoon: the licensed lifestyle frames at genuine camera-scale, the two inherited packshots brought to the same target despite arriving crushed to paper white, and the house green holding on the label through every correction. Per picture parameter log including which licensed frames were rejected and why, and any place where the frame's own capture limited what could be recovered.

The cans knocked out for the sign up spot and the banner: genuinely transparent, complete, with the base rim intact where the previous freelancer's retouching destroyed its separation from the ground, plus house-ground variants. Judged on the destination's own colour rather than on white. Every output at or below its source pixel dimensions with the returned tradeoff record for each.

Please distinguish what you could restore in the packshots from what remains limited by the supplied files. The cans' base and rim need to hold on the house ground as well as in the transparent masters.

We will provide fennhollow_packshots/ (2 frames, 5472 x 3648 JPEG); fennhollow_stock_shortlist.png; fennhollow_site_specs.txt; fennhollow_copy.txt; fennhollow_shelftalker_press.pdf.

Also in the archive, for background only: fennhollow_brand_note.pdf; fennhollow_stockists.csv. These do not add deliverables to this commission.

The final package should contain a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports, a short production and exceptions note and Stock license and asset IDs, with every source file accounted for, including references and rejected or superseded material. Use the approved information without inventing missing facts. Only the stated stock or concept exceptions permit substitution; document every omission, replacement, reconciliation and material quality compromise.

price_band_and_audience: Craft botanical soda at three dollars fifty a can, buyer twenty five to forty, shopping the natural grocer aisle and reading the ingredient panel. The band is load-bearing. In the better-for-you craft band the imagery has to be sun lit, natural and restrained, with real daylight, ordinary tables and unstyled hands, because the customer is paying a premium for the claim that this is closer to a real thing. A mass-market ninety nine cent soda would correctly be shot hyper-saturated, high gloss, hard-lit and tightly packed with product, and shipping that treatment here reads as artificial and destroys the botanical claim the whole price rests on. Push the other way into the near-monochrome sparseness and negative space of a twelve dollar apothecary tonic and a three dollar can looks mispriced and the natural grocer shopper does not recognise it as a drink. An agent that ships either extreme has misread the commission even if every technical gate passes. A posted job of this shape runs 900 to 2,200 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.tagline: Botanicals from the valley, nothing else.
brand_identity.sector: Craft botanical soda, better-for-you premium CPG
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded in the Hudson Valley, New York. Two founders working with a co-packer, three flavours, sold in upstate natural grocers and by direct-to-consumer subscription.
brand_identity.about: Fennhollow Botanical Soda makes three botanical sodas in the Hudson Valley: elderflower and lime, rhubarb and bitters, and spruce tip. Three dollars fifty a can, sold across upstate natural grocers and by subscription, produced through a co-packer whose cleared nutrition claim cannot be reworded. Two founders run everything and neither is a photographer. The whole brand lives on summer: sun lit, warm, natural, a little restrained. The spruce tip flavour steps to the front in August, so the summer campaign has to be built to be revisited as the season shifts.
brand_identity.audience: Twenty-five to forty, shopping the natural grocer aisle and reading the ingredient panel. Paying a premium for the promise that this is closer to a real thing than a mass soda.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Craft better-for-you at three fifty a can. Warmer and more human than a twelve-dollar apothecary tonic, and far more restrained and natural than a hyper-saturated ninety-nine-cent soda.
brand_identity.typography: A warm humanist sans across the family, legible over photography, paired with a friendly display cut for the flavour names. Natural and restrained, not wellness-minimal and not soda-aisle shout.
brand_identity.voice: Plain, warm, a little rural. Names the botanicals and the valley, not a lifestyle. The co-packer's cleared claim line stays exactly as written.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: No written brand guidelines have ever existed and the founders asked for the first one to be created. Their brand note points to a printed swatch card that was never sent with the package, so the house green survives only as the printed label on the two studio can shots the brand owns. There is no lifestyle photography of any kind.
brand_identity.values: Real ingredients over additives, provable and legal image provenance the co-packer can be shown, and a cohesive look the next hire can build on rather than start from nothing.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether a licensed frame actually sits with the graded set. Everything supplied about the candidates is a 240 pixel content-delivery thumbnail, which is a re-encode small enough that light direction, cast and the real behaviour of a scene's colour are not present in it. A frame whose thumbnail reads as even warm daylight can turn out at full size to be carrying a heavy foliage bounce that lays green over skin, cloth and tabletop alike, and reconciling that to the warm daylight target takes exactly the moves that also pull the house green off the label. Whether any particular licensed frame can be brought to the set at all only exists as a fact once it has been licensed, downloaded at full resolution, graded and put next to the two packshots.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No ordering avoids it, because the full resolution file is only obtainable by licensing and the thumbnail is the only thing that exists beforehand. Doing it right first time presumes being able to read a cast off a 240 pixel re-encode, which is not a skill any tool provides and not information the search response carries. Nothing states it: the founders supply their six as a preference, and the acceptance line about one afternoon is their art direction rather than a disclosure. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is a fresh search, a different licence and a different frame, not the same chain again.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-search with different short queries, license and pull replacement candidates at full resolution, re-grade the family around whichever frames can actually reach the target, re-cut every destination that depended on a rejected frame, and record in the manifest which frames were licensed and rejected and why.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A summer family in which the hero is quietly green under the warmth, the cans in it no longer match the cans in the sign up spot, and the one colour the brand actually owns is different on two adjacent pieces of the same page.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the sky in the chosen lifestyle frame will actually do. A summer outdoor frame commonly arrives with the bright band already at the top of its range from the original capture, and the natural response is highlight recovery. What comes back is a successful call and a picture that is, where it matters, identical: the readout is that nothing moves, because there is nothing left in that band to move. There is no warning, no error and no diagnostic that distinguishes this from a correction that simply was not strong enough, so the obvious next reaction is to push the same control further and get the same nothing while dragging the rest of the frame down with it. Whether this frame is recoverable, or whether the bright band has to be composed around instead, is only knowable by making the call and looking.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No ordering avoids it, because the frame has to be graded before anything can be said about it and no parameter reports headroom. Doing it right first time presumes knowing in advance which of the licensed candidates lost that band at capture, which nothing in the search response, the thumbnail or the file discloses. Nothing states it: the brief asks for sun lit and warm. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is a compositional decision, re-framing every crop so the dead band falls outside it, or replacing the frame, rather than repeating the same call.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Stop pushing the control, re-plan the crops for every destination so the unrecoverable band sits outside the frame, which collides directly with the home page band's ratio and may force a different expansion side or a different frame entirely, then re-grade and re-cut and record the limitation in the recipe.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A hero band and two section headers carrying a flat white void where the summer sky should be, with the rest of the frame dragged dull by repeated attempts to fix it, on a brand whose entire premium rests on looking like real daylight.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: How the importer normalises the device that makes the section headers read as one family with the hero. Two narrow headers sitting over photography with type on them need the brand colour carried across the picture, and the natural authoring construction for that is a colour layer set to blend with the image beneath it. The importer discards the blend entirely and renders the element as a plain opaque shape, which means the colour layer stops sitting in the photograph and starts sitting on top of it, covering it, at full success with no warning of any kind. The document's own rendition returns the first artboard only, so the home page band looks correct in the only picture available and the section headers, the sign up spot and the social canvases can be checked through no channel other than the returned per-canvas markup.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No ordering avoids it, because the normalisation happens at import and the import is the last step. Doing it right first time presumes knowing which of several equally standard constructions survives, which nothing reports and no checklist enumerates. Nothing states it: the brief asks for one cohesive family and the acceptance line about the colour surviving onto every canvas is the client's requirement, not a warning. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is a different construction, carrying the colour in the raster itself, or rebuilding the header as a solid panel beside the photograph rather than over it, and then re-composing each canvas around whichever it is.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Move the colour treatment upstream into the graded rasters or re-cast the headers so the colour and the photograph do not overlap, re-author the HTML around that decision, re-upload, re-run the readiness check, re-export, and audit every canvas from the returned markup rather than from the first artboard.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A site family delivered as an editable file in which the two section headers and the sign up spot are flat blocks of green with the photography completely hidden underneath them, on canvases nobody looked at, with the export having reported success throughout.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns pictures of a soda can in the sun. IDENTITY: this is a real can with a real printed label and a co-packer-cleared claim line that cannot be reworded, and a regenerated can is a different company's product with a different green on it. LEGALITY: the client's explicit requirement is photography they can prove the provenance of to their co-packer, with anything machine generated excluded by name, which is the exact opposite of what a generated image gives them and is not something a generated image can be given. SPEC: the destinations are a fixed list of pixel sizes and one of them cannot be reached by cropping at all, plus a transparent cutout complete to the base rim, none of which a generated picture satisfies or can be checked for. EDITABILITY: the family is defined by being editable, because the featured flavour changes in August and the founders explicitly cannot re-commission. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: does this licensed frame actually sit with the set at full size, is there anything left in that sky to recover, did the colour survive the import onto the canvases nobody can preview. MERGE: the grocer run is one printed card per store bound to that store's own name, town, price and featured-flavour can with page count equal to row count, which a generated picture neither produces nor can be checked for, and the stores leading with the flavour that has no photograph have to be handled honestly rather than filled with a can that does not exist.

client_brief:
A calm launch image system for a reformer studio with a limited shoot

Verda is a reformer studio, and the launch should feel calm, approachable and grounded in the room we actually have. Our two room photographs are dusky. We need them prepared alongside suitable licensed movement imagery, not replaced by a fictional studio.

Please build the image treatment and six-instructor portrait set before adapting the supporting launch layouts. The oak and daylight should connect the pieces.

Two studio frames and the licensed frames brought to one calm daylight target (one white point, one black point, one warmth in the oak, one crop logic) without crossing the owners' stated do not want line, delivered as one wide hero and 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 placements. Every output at or below its source dimensions, accompanied by a source and licensing manifest carrying every asset id with generative tech candidates excluded, and a parameter log naming why the studio's room and the licensed photography needed different corrections to reach the same place.

Six self submitted portraits brought to one pass treatment: subject aware crops that never enlarge, and each instructor knocked onto the studio's solid ground so the set reads as one sitting rather than six phones. Edge quality holds where subject and wall share luminance, and any portrait that could not reach the pass's reproduction scale is named in the note as a client conversation rather than silently interpolated. The same prepared portraits are the ones bound into the printed pass run and reused on the social canvases.

Launch page and mixed canvas social set as one editable document plus its source: Choose and adapt an Adobe Express template for these supporting pieces, using the supplied brand, approved copy and imagery. Select the strongest fit, replace the template content and correct its background as needed. Supply the editable design link and the requested export, in addition to the commissioned custom production work.

There is no generative imagery in this commission. Record the licensed image IDs and tell us where a source is too small for the planned placement. The staff portraits must remain usable as a consistent set, with problem edges or undersized submissions identified.

Included in the pack: studio_frames/ (2 frames, approx 4032 x 3024); verda_logo_web.png (600 x 600); instructor_photos/ (6 self submitted portraits, 1100 to 4000 px); passcard_2025_print.pdf; roster_2027.csv; owner_note.txt.

Please work within $1,800-$4,500 fixed and the 2 to 4 weeks target. Allow for one direction checkpoint and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

Alongside the finished work, we need a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports, a short production and exceptions note and Stock license and asset IDs. Keep a clear record of the supplied files used, retained for reference, superseded and rejected. Approved source information remains authoritative. Record omissions, substitutions, reconciliations and quality limits, and do not use an undeclared replacement or invented fact to conceal a source problem.

It is anchored instead to the recurring shape that Upwork and Freelancer.com carry continuously in the small studio and wellness category: an owner opening or relaunching a space, with a logo file inherited from a departed designer, one or two phone photographs of their own room, no shoot budget, and a request to 'source some stock that fits our vibe and make our photos match it'. The same owner who cannot afford a shoot also has a wordmark that exists only as a small web export, a printed founding member pass her printer ran last year from a file she does not hold, six instructors who sent their own portraits, and an opening date that has already moved once. price_band_and_audience: Intro pack 180 dollars, membership 220 dollars a month, clients 28 to 48, mostly women in professional work who audition three studios before committing to one. The band is load bearing and it is a restraint band. At 220 a month the buyer is paying for calm, attention and space, so the campaign has to read as soft daylight, generous air, one body in one room, muted sage and oak, and type that is quiet. Push it down toward a 39 dollar high volume gym and the correct treatment inverts: bright, saturated, crowded, many bodies, heavy condensed type, price on the hero. Push it up into wellness luxury and it becomes near monochrome, editorial, almost empty, which at 220 a month reads as pretension and prices the studio out of its own neighbourhood. brand_identity.sector: Boutique reformer pilates studio
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2022, first studio run for four years; opening a second location on Calloway Row in a North American city. Owner led by Marit and Dana, with six instructors. Small, independent, growing to two rooms.
brand_identity.about: Verda is a boutique reformer pilates studio built on calm. One body, one room, generous air, and unhurried attention. Marit and Dana have run a single studio for four years and are now opening a second on Calloway Row. The studio is deliberately the opposite of a chain gym: no crowding, no shouting, no gloss of the everyday. What clients pay for is space, focus and a considered environment they return to.
brand_identity.audience: Considered buyers, mostly women in professional work, aged 28 to 48. They typically audition three studios before committing to one, and they are paying for calm, attention and space rather than volume or intensity.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Premium neighborhood, not luxury. Intro pack 180 dollars, membership 220 a month. Positioned above a high volume budget gym and below wellness luxury: the tone is soft daylight and quiet confidence, never pretension and never a discount.
brand_identity.typography: Quiet and editorial. A light, humanist serif for headlines paired with a restrained sans for body and labels. Generous spacing, small type, nothing condensed, bold or promotional.
brand_identity.voice: Plain, warm and unhurried. Speaks to one person rather than a crowd. Confident without hype, and honest about what the room actually is.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: No brand guidelines were ever written. The wordmark was drawn by a designer who has since left, and the only surviving file is a small low resolution web export she handed over. There is no master artwork, no color specification and no font list on record, so the freelancer inherits the studio look from this brief and from the room itself.
brand_identity.values: Calm, attention, generous space, and honesty about the room a client will actually walk into.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the front window in the wide composing studio frame has anything left in it. The recovery move runs, reports success, and returns an image in which the readout is that nothing has moved: the window is clipped in every channel, so there is no detail under it to lift and the tool has nothing to do. Every later move toward the calm daylight target then pushes the rest of the room while that rectangle stays flat white, and it gets worse rather than better as the room around it comes down to a daylight value. There is no histogram, no eyedropper and no measurement anywhere in the connector, so whether a phone exposure at dusk held the window is unknowable until the attempt is made and the result is looked at.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it and no care prevents it, because the only channel that reports on this exposure is the attempt itself, and the frame that composes best wide is the frame with the window in it. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says the two pictures were taken on phones on a late afternoon, which is the owners' account of when they were taken, and asks for calm daylight, which is the requirement. Neither is a disclosure that a channel is clipped. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the answer changes what the campaign's lead picture is a picture of.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re frame that studio master so the window falls outside the wide hero, which changes what the room's wide picture is about and therefore the crop logic for the whole set, or demote it and let a licensed frame lead, which changes how much of the campaign is the studio's own room and forces the calm daylight target to be re fixed off licensed photography rather than off the client's room, with every frame already corrected toward the old target re corrected afterwards.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The launch page ships with a flat white rectangle where the studio's daylight window should be, on the single picture a considered buyer looks at while deciding between three studios, and the effect grows more obvious the more correctly the rest of the room is graded.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the licensed frame can actually join this room. The search surface returns a 240 px thumbnail plus true dimensions and nothing else about the light, so a frame that reads on the thumbnail as soft north light can turn out at full resolution to be lit by a large warm practical off frame, laying an amber ramp across the far wall and a warm cast into the skin. Brought toward the calm daylight target globally, the skin goes cold before the wall gives up its amber; confined to the wall, the wall's new neutral changes what the sage reformer beside it reads as. Whether the frame joins at all only becomes a question at the moment it is downloaded at full resolution and laid beside the graded studio frames, which is the first time the two have ever been adjacent.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot produce that adjacency earlier, because it requires both the licence and the grade, and the pre licence readout is a 240 px proxy with no colour information worth trusting. (b) Nothing states it: the brief asks for frames chosen the way a designer chooses and for everything to look like one afternoon, which is the requirement rather than the finding. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the response is to license a different asset, which is a new shortlist, a new defence and a different lead picture.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Return to the search with what the failure taught about which lights can honestly join this room, license a replacement, grade it toward the target, re judge the whole set adjacent, and if no candidate joins, re fix the target on what the studio's own room can honestly be and re correct the licensed frames toward that instead, recording in the note why the studio frames and the licensed frames needed different corrections to arrive at the same place.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The campaign's most prominent photograph carries warm practical light and warm skin against a cool sage room, which is exactly the different brand from the campaign photography that the owners said in writing would waste the money.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the printer's press card actually converts to. The printed pass plainly shows a portrait and the studio mark as two placed pictures and four separate blocks of copy, so the obvious plan binds a per row portrait to one graphic frame and the mark to the other and maps four fields to four frames. The converted document exposes one graphic frame and one continuous text story, because the mark was flattened into the background artwork before the file went to press and the copy was set as a single flow. Frame granularity is a property of how a retired printer built the document, it is announced nowhere, and the printed card is actively misleading about it. Any mapping row aimed at the second graphic frame is silently filtered out for naming an id that does not exist, the validator returns valid on what remains, and the preparation step reports success.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it, because the inventory does not exist until the conversion has run, and the only visible evidence beforehand is the printed page, which contradicts it. (b) Nothing states it: the brief says only that the printer holds the file that went to press. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the mapping strategy changes from per frame binding to offset arithmetic inside one story with same uid rows ordered so their positions hold, the mark can no longer be swapped per card and has to be carried some other way, and the portrait's aspect is now set by the single surviving graphic frame rather than by the two the plan assumed, which sends the portrait preparation back to the imaging surface.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Recompute every copy offset against the story text reconstructed from the exported document, re author the mapping inside one flow with same uid rows in descending position order, re prepare the six portraits to the aspect the surviving graphic frame actually has, decide and state how the recovered mark reaches the pass given that the old one is baked into the background, and verify by exporting the interchange file from the prepared template and searching for every placeholder before any pass is merged.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The founding member passes print with each instructor's portrait squeezed to the wrong shape in the only frame that exists, two copy fields never replaced so every pass carries last year's class name and price, and the studio mark stuck at whatever the printer flattened in a year ago.

Whether the wide composing studio frame can carry the wide hero at all once the window is worked, and what leads the campaign if it cannot.

Selection prompt wording on the logo export: naming the plate takes the white square, naming the letterforms' own visual properties takes the ink, and background removal on an enclosed counter is the wrong instrument entirely.
Whether the recovered wordmark came back with open counters or came back filled and plausible, which only shows when it is placed small on the pass.
How the portrait below pass scale is handled, given that nothing can enlarge it and the client expects six passes.
Whether to trust the printed card's apparent structure or the converted document's real frame inventory, and whether a success message counts as verification.

Coastal destination imagery for the quieter season

Cape Marren's campaign runs October to April. We need a welcoming coastal image set, but not sunshine or sea conditions that misrepresent that season. Six members have contributed photographs; suitable licensed coastal imagery can fill the declared context role.

The work is an image system with its own object preparations, not a commission to generate a new destination.

Destination masters and crops: Six member submitted frames and the licensed coastal frames brought to one warm shoulder season target (one warmth, one black point, one crop logic) without promising a season the coast cannot deliver and without collapsing the horizon on the overcast mornings, delivered as one wide web banner and 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 placements. Every output at or below its source dimensions, accompanied by a source and licensing manifest carrying every asset id with generative tech candidates excluded, and an applied settings log naming the shared target and the per member correction that reached it.

Member objects: Six signature objects, one per member, isolated onto one campaign ground as a set: the creel's weave, the lamp's railing and the basket's mouth genuinely open rather than filled and plausible, and the knife's edge holding where blade and ground share a material. The instrument chosen per object is recorded, and the same cutouts are the ones bound per row into the printed trail card run and reused on the social canvases, so a member's object is identical everywhere it appears.

Please keep horizons and weather credible, and inspect the awkward openings in the creel, lamp and basket. Those details will matter when the objects are reused against a different background.

Assets and reference material: member_photos/ (6 frames, 1400 to 5200 px, mixed provenance); member_objects/ (6 object photographs, approx 3000 px); trailcard_2025_print.pdf; members_2027.csv; alliance_mark.svg.

No generative frames or enlarged substitutes. We need a clear rights record and an explanation of any photograph that cannot support its intended use.

Account for every supplied file and identify anything used only as reference, superseded or rejected. Stay with approved facts and copy. The band is load bearing in both directions. At this spend the campaign has to promise a real place in real weather: warm low sun, wool, wet stone, a lit window at four in the afternoon, quiet compositions with one or two people, and type that reads as editorial rather than promotional. brand_identity.sector: Regional destination marketing, an alliance of independent coastal member businesses
brand_identity.founded_place_size: A visitor alliance of twenty two independent member businesses along the Cape Marren coast on the North American Atlantic seaboard. Coordinated by Nell on behalf of the members. Small, member funded, regional in reach.
brand_identity.about: Cape Marren Coast Alliance markets a stretch of independent coast to shoulder season visitors. Summer sells itself; the work is October to April, when a harbour seafood room, a cider barn, a point light, a bookshop, a bakery and an oyster landing either make a living or do not. The campaign has to feel like that season honestly: warm low sun, weather, wool, wet stone, a lit window at four in the afternoon, quiet compositions with one or two people. Members have to see themselves in it, because members who cannot see themselves do not renew.
brand_identity.audience: Travellers aged 30 to 60, driving from within four hours, mostly couples and pairs of friends rather than families. They spend 200 to 600 dollars per party across a two or three night shoulder season weekend on rooms, meals, cider and a walk.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Mid range and real. Positioned above a peak summer holiday treatment (which would oversell blue water and hard sun) and below a 1,500 dollar luxury coastal weekend (which would go near monochrome and strand the bakery and the cider barn). Editorial rather than promotional, and never promising a season the coast cannot deliver in November.
brand_identity.typography: Editorial, not promotional. A quiet serif for headlines with a plain sans for captions, trail numbers and opening months. Restrained weights, comfortable spacing, nothing that reads as a sale.
brand_identity.voice: Grounded and truthful. Warm about the place without overselling it, and specific about what a visitor will actually find when they arrive out of season.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: No written brand guidelines exist. The only brand file on hand is the alliance mark left by the previous agency, supplied as a single vector file with nothing else: no color system, no type list and no usage notes. Members submit their own photographs and object shots, and the campaign look is set by this brief rather than by any existing kit.
brand_identity.values: Honesty about the season, keeping every member visible, and supporting the independent businesses that fund the alliance.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the shared warm target does to the members who were shot on a flat overcast morning. On those frames the sea and the sky sit within a hair of each other in value, so the warm move that gives the licensed frames their late October light lifts the whole flat field at once: the water takes the warmth with the sky, the two surfaces converge rather than separate, and the horizon stops existing. The frame does not look broken at contact scale, it looks soft and slightly hazy, and it is only at placement scale beside the licensed frames that the coast turns out to have no edge. Where that convergence happens is a property of that particular morning's light on that particular water, there is no measurement anywhere in the connector to establish how close the two values started, and the intermediate results are all plausible.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it: the target has to be fixed before any member frame can be corrected toward it, and the convergence only exists once the move has been made and the result is looked at beside the rest of the set. (b) Nothing states it: the brief says the members sent whatever they had and asks for one campaign, which is the client's account and the client's requirement. The acceptance line about a readable horizon is the board's standing quality bar, not a disclosure of cause. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the response re decides what one campaign means, which changes the target itself and therefore every frame already corrected toward it, and it changes which members can carry which placements.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Either re set the target to a warmth all six member mornings can honestly take, and re correct the frames already brought to the old target, or hold the target and give the overcast members a confined treatment that warms the sky and the land while leaving the water where it is, then re judge the whole set adjacent to confirm they still read as one campaign. If neither holds, the campaign's consistency has to be carried by crop logic, type and the object cutouts instead, which changes what leads the page and what each member's placement is.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Three member businesses appear in a paid shoulder season campaign in frames where the sea and the sky have merged into one warm grey field with no horizon, on a campaign whose entire promise is that the coast in November is worth the drive, and those three members are among the ones whose renewals pay for the work.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the mapping built against the old printer's card actually landed. The readout of the card's copy silently omits the run carrying the opening months while keeping its line break, so the string still reads as well formed prose and every character offset after it is short by exactly that run's length. The validator returns valid on internally consistent wrong arithmetic with no warnings at all, the preparation step reports that placeholder creation completed successfully, and two of the fields never become placeholders. Nothing anywhere in the chain disagrees with the wrong number.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it and diligence alone cannot either, because the failure is produced by a lossy readout that presents as complete: an agent that reads carefully and computes offsets faithfully from what it was handed produces arithmetic that is internally consistent and wrong, and every downstream tool agrees. The only defence is a second independent reconstruction of the same text from a different channel, which nothing in any tool description prompts and whose necessity is invisible until the two disagree. (b) Nothing states it: the brief mentions no frames, fields or mappings, only that the opening months are different this year. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the source of truth changes, from a tool readout to offset arithmetic computed against a reconstructed story with same uid rows re ordered, and the mapping is re authored from a different text rather than re fed.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Reconstruct the true story text by concatenating the exported document's content runs, recompute every offset against that string, re order any rows sharing a uid into descending position order, rebuild and re validate the mapping, re run the template preparation and verify by exporting the interchange file from the prepared template and searching for every placeholder before any card is merged.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Every member's trail card goes into every member's window carrying last year's opening months as static printed text, in a campaign whose entire subject is when the coast is open, and the board finds out from visitors who drove up and found the door locked.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: How the importer normalises the campaign page's treatment of type over photography. The warm wash that lets white type hold over a November harbour frame, and the soft stacked shadow under the opening months band, are both authored constructs whose fate is decided entirely inside the importer: the blend collapses to a plain opaque shape that covers the photograph beneath it, and only the first shadow layer survives, so the band loses the separation it was designed around. Every one of these drops returns success with no warning of any kind. The document's rendition shows the first artboard only, so on canvases two through five the returned per canvas markup is the only channel through which any of it is observable, and the page looks entirely correct in the source that was authored.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) No ordering avoids it, because the normalisation is a property of the importer applied to this particular construct, and there is no dry run: the export is the only readout. (b) Nothing states it: the brief asks for a campaign page and social set the board can edit and says nothing about how anything is built. (c) It is not a propagation re run: the technique that carries white type over photography changes, which changes which crop of which frame can hold the type, which sends the agent back to the imaging surface for a differently framed or differently graded master before the page can be re authored at all.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re author the treatment with constructs the importer keeps rather than the ones it drops, resolve the type over photography problem in the photograph instead of in the overlay by choosing or re deriving a frame with a quiet corner at the size the type needs, re inline the new master, re run the readiness check and re export, then audit every canvas from the returned markup rather than from the rendition.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns a beautiful autumn coast that does not exist. IDENTITY: the campaign's entire commercial function is that six specific member businesses see themselves in it and renew, and the visitor drives to a real cape expecting the sea, the light and the hours the campaign showed. A generated coastline is a place nobody can visit and a member business that is not in the campaign is a member that does not fund the next one. LICENSING: the gap filling photography runs in paid placement and has to be genuinely licensed, provenance clear and free of generative tech candidates. SPEC: the print run needs one 105 x 148 mm card per current member binding opening months verbatim, per member files each containing the card they claim, each carrying that member's own object, and proofs at true print resolution. EDITABILITY: the launch set is defined by being editable, because the members change their opening months monthly and the board cannot come back each time. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality: whether this water and this sky can take the campaign's warmth and stay two things, whether a placeholder was ever created, whether the page the board was handed is the page that was designed.

A restrained healthcare image set with a reliable clinical-lead cutout

Palewell needs photography that feels credible together, even though most of the set will be licensed and only one frame is owned. Please prioritise compatible camera scale, neutral balance and depth over a collection of individually attractive stock photographs.

The clinical lead will appear on a deep-colour header. Hair and shoulder edges need to be checked there, at the real placement size.

Commissioned outputs:

The licensed frames plus the one owned frame brought to a single house neutral: one white point, one black point, one warmth and one depth of field character, so that laid side by side the way a site lays them they read as one world rather than as six purchases. Delivered at camera-scale with a per-frame parameter log naming what was applied and why that frame differed from its neighbours. Nothing generative tech, nothing enlarged.

The clinical lead isolated from the corridor as a genuinely transparent asset with real edge quality along the shoulder and the hairline, plus a plate of her composited onto the brand's deep ground, both judged at the size the header actually reproduces rather than at preview scale. This is one cutout with one edge logic in two carriers, not one picture at two sizes.

The commission is budgeted at $1,800-$4,500 fixed. We have allowed 2 to 4 weeks, including one direction checkpoint and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

price_band_and_audience: Subscription digital health at fifteen to forty dollars a month, plus employer plans sold to benefits leads; members are thirty to fifty five, the decision maker is often a benefits or HR lead reading for risk. The band is load-bearing. At this price the work has to read calm, credible and human: real rooms, ordinary daylight, restrained type, generous air, faces that are present rather than beaming. Push it up into a two hundred dollar concierge medicine look (near black grounds, sparse editorial styling, cosmetic gloss) and a benefits lead reads it as a perk their staff cannot use. Push it down into a high saturation, benefit stacked, promotional treatment and it reads as a supplement funnel, which in a health category actively destroys the trust the purchase requires. There is a third wrong answer specific to this vertical: a cold, sterile, blue clinical look that photographs well and feels like a hospital, which fails because the product is something people use at home. An agent that ships any of the three has misread the commission even if every technical gate passes. A real posted job of this shape runs 1,400 to 3,200 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.tagline: Care that meets you at home
brand_identity.sector: Direct to consumer digital health platform with a growing employer benefits channel, sold to members and to the benefits leads who choose on their behalf
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2019 in Portland, Oregon; an eleven person team, clinician led, still owner run
brand_identity.about: Palewell is a subscription digital health platform for people managing ordinary, everyday conditions from home. Members pay a modest monthly fee for clinician backed guidance, and about half our growth now comes through employer benefits teams who offer us to their staff. We exist so that steady, unglamorous care feels reachable rather than clinical.
brand_identity.audience: Members aged thirty to fifty five who want reassurance without a hospital, plus benefits and HR leads who evaluate us for risk and coverage before putting us in front of their people
brand_identity.price_positioning: Fifteen to forty dollars a month, plus employer plans. Mid market and accessible: above a free wellness app, well below concierge medicine. The read must never feel like a two hundred dollar boutique practice or a supplement funnel.
brand_identity.typography: A humanist serif for headlines that reads as considered and trustworthy, paired with a clean humanist sans for body and interface. Generous air, restrained scale, nothing shouting. The type should feel like a careful letter, not a brochure.
brand_identity.voice: Plain, warm and unhurried; we speak to a person, not a patient. We avoid hype, superlatives and clinical jargon. Example line the brand would write: "Manage the everyday stuff with someone in your corner, from home."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: There is no formal brand book. What exists is an internal notes file describing the palette in words (a deep slate, a warm chalk, a single muted signal colour), the tone of voice, and what the founders mean by calm. We have never run a photo shoot: every image on the current site came free with the template, and we own exactly one photograph outright, of our clinical lead, cleared for use.
brand_identity.values: Credibility and warmth held together: real people in real rooms, honest about what we are, calm enough that a benefits lead trusts us with their staff.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the licensed frames actually look like once they are beside each other at full resolution and graded. The founders' shortlist exists only as small content delivery thumbnails, and a thumbnail is a proxy that flattens colour: two of the frames carry a strong practical light cast that the thumbnail simply does not carry, and one that reads as the warmest candidate in the grab turns out to be the most neutral file on disk. None of this is visible until the frames are downloaded at full size and laid against the set that has already been brought to the house neutral.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering does not dodge it, because there is no route to the true file except licensing and downloading it, and licensing is the commitment. Nothing states it: the brief says the founders keep picking six pictures that do not sit together, which is the symptom they are hiring someone to solve, not a disclosure that the thumbnails misreport. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is either a confined correction that a whole frame move cannot reach or a decision to drop a licensed frame and go back to search with a different direction, which is a different route rather than the same one again.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-judge every licensed frame against the graded set rather than against its own thumbnail, confine corrections on the frames whose cast is regional rather than global, and where a frame cannot be brought to the set, return to search and license a replacement, updating the manifest for both.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A site and ad set that still reads as bought, which is the exact failure the client described and the exact thing they are paying to stop, delivered with the licensing paperwork proving they paid for it.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the clinical lead's cutout actually holds. Her pale scrub top runs at almost the luminance of the corridor wall across her right shoulder and upper arm, so subject detection has nothing to work with there and gives back a cutout that is clean, complete and entirely convincing against white and against a transparency preview, having quietly bitten into the shoulder line. The bite is only visible on the deep house ground at the size the header actually reproduces, which is the one place the asset is going to live.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No ordering avoids it: the knockout has to happen before it can be placed, and there is no parameter that controls where detection finds contrast. Doing it right the first time presumes knowing in advance which of her edges has no contrast against the wall, which is a property of this photograph and not readable from it. Nothing states it: the brief says only that the header sits on the deep slate and she must sit on it cleanly, which is the client's art direction. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is a different chain entirely, selecting the wall as a material by its own visual properties, inverting that selection and filling to the house ground so the edge is decided by the ground rather than by subject detection.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Abandon the one call knockout for this frame, rebuild the cutout through a material named selection of the corridor wall, inverted, then re-derive both the transparent variant and the house ground plate from the new route and re-judge the shoulder and the hairline on the deep ground at header size.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A header whose only real human, the clinical lead the whole trust claim rests on, has a shoulder eaten out of her, shipped on the front page of a health brand and invisible in every check that was run against white.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the employer press PDF actually becomes. The printed page shows four clearly separate visual blocks, and the conversion's frame granularity is not under anyone's control: the name, plan tier, body and contact may arrive as one continuous story rather than four mappable frames, and the photograph panel may or may not survive as a linkable frame depending on how the vendor placed it. On top of that, the structure readout of the story is lossy in a way that preserves line breaks while dropping a run, so the string looks well formed while every offset past the omission is short, and the mapping built from it validates cleanly and prepares cleanly.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering cannot dodge it because the conversion is the first thing that can be done and its result is the thing in question. Doing it right the first time presumes knowing which of several possible structures this particular vendor's PDF collapses into, which no response reports and no inspection of the printed page reveals. Nothing states it: the client says only that the printer made them a one page leave behind. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is a different mapping strategy altogether, offsets computed against the reconstructed story rather than the readout, and the per partner logo routed to whichever frame actually exists rather than to the one the printed page implies.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Reconstruct the true story text from the exported document's own runs, recompute every offset against that string, rebuild the mapping around the frames that genuinely exist, re-prepare the template, and confirm every placeholder by re-exporting the structure rather than by reading the success message.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Fourteen pages that print, look right in a thumbnail, and are missing two of the five personalised fields on every single one, handed to a print shop and then to fourteen employer partners.

client_brief:
Recover three apparel graphics and prove they survive small reproduction

Cordwain has lost the working artwork for three overland graphics. We need a vector specialist who can recover what is actually in the references and make a useful garment-ready family, not deliver an unchecked automatic trace.

Our acceptance point is the small reproduction. Counters, closures and fine contours need to be visible in the evidence, with any remaining supplier decisions called out.

Artwork
All three graphics as placeable, scalable vector geometry with a real viewBox present, no opaque full canvas rectangle underneath and a transparent ground, recovered by whichever route each one's surviving material actually allows, and each holding together at the size it genuinely prints on the garment colour it prints on. Do not treat a trace alone as production approval: deliver transparent SVG, rendered small-size proofs, and an inspectable geometry report. Any unverified contour or fabrication tolerance must be labeled for supplier review.

Proof package
An inspectable proof of Cordwain master graphics, three recovered marks at every claimed reproduction size and on light/dark grounds, with open-path, closure, transparency, contour, and unsupported-feature findings stated plainly.

Garment presentation photography
The licensed blank garment photography brought to one lookbook target, one white point, one fabric warmth and one shadow character, so that three shots from three contributors read as one shoot behind the store page. Delivered at camera-scale with a per-frame parameter log and with the licence state and contributor recorded per-frame. Nothing generative tech, nothing enlarged.

The licensed blank garments should look like one shoot and should not introduce invented product details. Please keep their licensing records with the final files.

Reference pack: cordwain_flat_exports/ (3 PNGs: ridgeline_back.png 2400px, compass_chest.png 1800px, overland_badge.png 600px); cordwain_sample_photos/ (2 JPEGs, 4000 x 3000); cordwain_printer_submission.pdf; cordwain_store_grabs/ (4 PNGs).

Also in the archive, for background only: cordwain_printer_inkbook.txt; cordwain_brand_sheet.md. These do not add deliverables to this commission.

The final package should contain a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports and a short production and exceptions note, with every source file accounted for, including references and rejected or superseded material. Use the approved information without inventing missing facts. Only the stated stock or concept exceptions permit substitution; document every omission, replacement, reconciliation and material quality compromise. Include inspectable paths and small-size proofs; unverified fabrication tolerances remain subject to supplier review.

Budget: $5,000-$10,000 fixed. Target: 4 to 6 weeks. Reviews: Direction approval, first-production proof, and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

source_provenance.original_anchor: Primary anchor, VERBATIM from a real Upwork post: "recreate and refine several existing t-shirt concepts into professional, production-ready vector artwork for screen printing"; "We already have concept artwork and direction established"; "Recreate existing shirt concepts as clean vector artwork"; "Create front chest and full-back designs"; "Prepare artwork for screen printing"; "Follow provided brand guidelines and color standards"; "Convert all fonts to outlines"; "No gradients, halftones". Co-anchor, adapted from a second real Upwork brief in which a team had mocked up its graphics with a general purpose image tool and needed the messy raster art refined into production formats "for screen printing, social media, creating my own print graphics, etc.", delivered "both vector based with separate layers and rasterized" with "spot color info", in a muted palette. Third anchor, adapted from the Freelancer.com brief "Travel-Themed T-Shirt Design", which asked for "layered vector files (AI or EPS) plus high-resolution PNGs with transparent backgrounds", to "keep text editable", and for artwork "sized and pre-flighted for screen print or DTG". None of the posts names a client, so the label is laundered to the coined fictional Cordwain Overland. Two things are held out of scope deliberately: the Freelancer post's from scratch art creation, which is not connector work, and the earlier version of this slot's inversion into a report only audit whose every finding required measurement the agent cannot perform. The verdict is STRENGTHEN, so the concept and the collateral set are kept: three recovered vector graphics, per graphic spot colour separation sheets, a one colour reduction of each for dark garments, a garment mockup board on licensed apparel shots, a printer spec sheet naming plates, inks, placement and maximum print width, and a square teaser set for the store page. price_band_and_audience: Mid tier outdoor apparel, tees at thirty four dollars and hoodies at seventy eight, buyers twenty four to forty who screenshot the print detail before they buy and who can tell a discharge print from a thick plastisol slab. The band is load-bearing in a way that shows in the plates themselves. At this price a tight two or three ink separation with visible texture and honest registration reads as craft, and the customer pays for it. Ship the same three graphics as a six or seven colour simulated process job and the print reads heavy and cheap on the garment, the printer's per screen charge doubles, and a thirty four dollar tee is suddenly priced like a forty five dollar one that looks worse. Push the other way into a single thin one ink line on every garment and the line stops being a graphics led brand at all, which is the only reason these customers buy. The one colour reduction is therefore a deliberate reduction for dark garments and cost, not a default, and treating it as the master is as wrong as shipping seven plates. A real posted job of this shape runs 900 to 2,400 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.tagline: Made for the long way round
brand_identity.sector: Mid tier overland and hiking apparel label selling graphic tees and hoodies through its own store and four independent outfitters
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2016 in Bend, Oregon; a small independent label, a handful of people, direct to consumer plus four stockists
brand_identity.about: Cordwain Overland makes graphic apparel for people who drive the back roads and walk the ridgelines. Our graphics are the reason people buy: customers zoom in on the print detail before they add to cart. Every drop is a small set of designs printed with care on garments meant to be worn hard.
brand_identity.audience: Buyers aged twenty four to forty who care how a print is made, can tell a discharge print from a thick plastisol slab, and screenshot the print detail before they buy
brand_identity.price_positioning: Tees at thirty four dollars, hoodies at seventy eight. Mid tier: a clear step above a bargain blank, priced on print quality rather than logo. Two or three tight inks with a bit of texture read as the craft they pay for.
brand_identity.typography: A sturdy condensed sans for badge and display work, paired with a plain workhorse sans for spec sheets and store copy. Type inside the graphics is treated as drawn lettering, outlined to print. The feel is field manual, not fashion label.
brand_identity.voice: Direct, plainspoken and a little dry; we talk about how a thing is made, not how it will change your life. Example line the brand would write: "Three tight inks, printed to last the season."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The brand sheet is two pages of internal notes: the palette in words, the placement rules we have always used, our maximum print widths for chest and full back, and a paragraph on what we mean by a tight print. Our old designer worked off site and we never got the layered files; for three of our best selling graphics all that survives is a few flat web exports and two printed samples we photographed on the bench.
brand_identity.values: The print is the product. We would rather run two or three honest inks with real texture than a muddy multi colour job, and we never price the line out of its own customers.

assets_supplied.name: cordwain_flat_exports/ (3 PNGs: ridgeline_back.png 2400px, compass_chest.png 1800px, overland_badge.png 600px)
assets_supplied.kind: Flat web exports of the three graphics, all on white, saved by the previous designer at whatever size was to hand.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The three graphics as we last exported them. Ridgeline is the full back one, compass is the chest print, badge is the one on the hoodies."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The compass export was round-tripped through JPEG at some point before it was saved back out, so its ink fields carry compression mottling that is completely invisible on white at web scale but that a trace resolves into dozens of near identical fills instead of two clean plates, and the trace tool takes no options at all so there is no threshold or colour count to tune it with. The badge export is only 600 pixels, far below anything a hoodie chest print can be built from, and all three sit on an opaque white ground that the trace will carry through as a full canvas rectangle underneath the artwork.

assets_supplied.name: cordwain_sample_photos/ (2 JPEGs, 4000 x 3000)
assets_supplied.kind: Photographs of two printed samples taken on the studio bench in daylight: a light tee carrying the compass print, and a dark hoodie carrying the overland badge.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The printed samples. These are the only record of what the inks actually looked like once they were on fabric."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The badge on the hoodie is a compound lockup, a type ring set around an enclosed centre with a hairline rule between them, so background removal returns a solid opaque disc with the enclosed centre still filled by the garment, and a prompt naming the garment or the sample pulls the selection to the hoodie rather than to the ink. On the tee, the compass lettering is disjoint, so subject detection keeps only a couple of letters and drops the rest while reporting success.

assets_supplied.name: cordwain_printer_submission.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The printer's blank artwork submission sheet as a press PDF, one page: an artwork window, a graphic name and garment colour block, an ink name list, and a placement and maximum print width footer.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "His form. He will not accept artwork any other way, and he wants one page per graphic per garment colour."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The ink name list is a fixed measure frame that does not spill: a stocked ink name longer than the measure simply stops rendering at the trim edge, silently, so the printer receives a truncated ink name that still looks like a complete one, and the merge reports success throughout. What the printed form shows as four separate blocks is also not necessarily what the conversion exposes as separate frames.

assets_supplied.name: cordwain_printer_inkbook.txt
assets_supplied.kind: The printer's stocked ink list: ink names, whether each is available as discharge or plastisol, and a garment colour compatibility column.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "What he actually keeps on the shelf. He will substitute if we ask for something he does not stock, and we would rather he did not."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Several of the stocked names run long enough to matter downstream, and the compatibility column, which only pays off if it is cross read against garment colour rather than read down, shows that two of the hues recovered from the samples have no discharge equivalent on dark garments at all, which is precisely where the one ink reduction is needed.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether each flat export is actually flat at pixel level. The compass export was round-tripped through JPEG at some point before it was saved back out, so its two ink fields carry compression mottling that is completely invisible on white at web scale and completely invisible in a preview, and the trace resolves it into dozens of near identical fills instead of two clean plates. The trace tool takes no options at all, no colour count, no threshold, no path simplification, so there is no parameter that would have prevented it and no reading of the file that would have predicted it. The other export traces cleanly on exactly the same call.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering does not dodge it, because tracing the export is the first and correct thing to do with a file the client calls a flat export, and there is nothing to trace against beforehand. Doing it right the first time would mean flattening the ink fields of every export before tracing any of them, which is work with no reason on a genuinely flat file and which would additionally destroy the three ink structure of the back print graphic if done blind. Nothing states it: the brief says only that the exports were saved at whatever size was to hand. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is a different chain, selecting each ink field by its own visual properties, inverting and filling it to a single flat ink, and only then tracing.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Take the affected graphic off the direct trace route, isolate each of its ink fields and flatten each to a single ink in the raster before tracing, then re-apply the hygiene to the new result and re-derive its plates and its one ink reduction from the rebuilt master rather than from the first trace.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A separation sheet the printer cannot burn screens from: dozens of near identical fills presented as two plates, which either comes back as a rejected submission or, worse, gets separated by the printer's own operator into something nobody at the label chose.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the recovered marks still hold at the size they actually print, on the ground they actually print on. All three traces look correct at canvas size on white. At a three and a half inch chest print on a dark hoodie, the badge's hairline rule between its type ring and its enclosed centre and the counters inside its smallest letters close up into solid ink, and the compass graphic's finest bearing lines thicken until the rose reads as a blob. Which strokes close is a property of what the trace produced from that particular input, and it is only visible once the mark is placed at true relative size on a real garment photograph and rendered.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No ordering avoids it, because the mark has to exist and be placed before it can be judged at reproduction size, and the authoring surface is the only place a mark can be put on a garment at true relative scale. Doing it right the first time presumes knowing in advance which strokes a trace will render thin enough to close, which no response reports. Nothing states it: the brief asks for a tight print and gives maximum print widths, which is the client's own art direction and their standing spec, not a warning that a recovered stroke will close. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is upstream and different, a thickened or removed rule and a redrawn counter treatment in the raster prep before re-tracing, or a decision that the affected element belongs only in the light garment version.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Go back into the raster prep for the affected marks, adjust the elements that close so the trace produces geometry that survives at print size, re-trace, re-apply hygiene, re-derive the affected plates and reductions, then re-author and re-export the mockup and separation canvases and judge them again at true relative size rather than at canvas size.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A drop that prints as a blob on the exact detail these customers zoom in on before they buy, on a label whose entire premium over a bargain tee is the quality of the print.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the submission pages say what they appear to say. The ink name list on the printer's form is a fixed measure frame that does not spill: a stocked ink name longer than the measure simply stops rendering at the trim edge. The merge reports success, the page count is right, the pages are in order, and the truncated name still reads as a complete, plausible ink name, so nothing anywhere flags it. Which rows are affected depends on which stocked names the substitution decision landed on and which garment colour each row is for, so it cannot be predicted from either the form or the ink list alone.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering does not dodge it: the frame measure is a property of the supplied press PDF and the names are a property of the printer's stocked list, and the two only meet on the merged page. There is no parameter that reflows or shrinks the text, and nothing in any response reports an overset. Nothing states it: the client says only that the printer will not accept artwork any other way. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is a different mapping, moving the stocked ink name into the wider notes frame and putting the printer's short code into the constrained one, which means recomputing offsets against the true story text and preparing the template again rather than merging the same template again.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-map the affected field to a frame that can carry it, recompute every offset against the reconstructed story text, re-prepare the template, confirm the placeholders again by inspection, re-merge the whole run and read every page at trim to its final character rather than reading the first page and the page count.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A submission the printer accepts and works from in which the ink named on some pages is not the ink the label chose, discovered on press, on a drop with three weeks of lead time and no second run.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns three attractive outdoor t-shirt graphics. IDENTITY: these are this label's three best selling graphics, the ones its customers already own and recognise, and a regenerated mountain and compass is a different label's artwork; the whole commission exists because the layered files were lost, so recovery is the job and reinvention is the failure. SPEC: a screen printer needs one plate per ink as a flat single ink field, a plate count the pricing can carry, ink names from his own stocked list checked against garment colour, and a submission on his own form at one page per graphic per garment colour, none of which a generated picture is or can be checked to be. EDITABILITY: the anchor briefs ask explicitly for layered vector with spot colour information and for artwork sized and pre-flighted for screen print, and a flat raster satisfies none of it. And the middle of this engagement is verification against material reality: did this export trace into two plates or into dozens of fills, does this hairline survive at three and a half inches on a hoodie, does this ink name fit the frame it lands in.

client_brief:
Restore a machineworks identity from a catalogue and an etched plate

Redecker's mark has a long history, but the source artwork has not survived. We have a 1974 catalogue and an etched plate to work from. We want the identity recovered carefully, not replaced with something that merely looks industrial.

Please use the evidence in the captures to distinguish the original geometry from the effects of print, metal and photography. The counters and hairlines must still work when the mark is reduced.

redecker_catalogue_1974_cover.tif (4200 x 5600); redecker_nameplate_rebuild.jpg (4032 x 3024); redecker_proving_stamp_coupon.jpg (4032 x 3024); redecker_frame_casting_1919.jpg (4032 x 3024); redecker_plate_2024.pdf; redecker_works_standards.txt.

Also in the archive, for background only: redecker_machines_november.csv (14 rows). These do not add deliverables to this commission.

The agreed delivery has two parts:

The 1919 lockup recovered from physical artefacts as placeable scalable geometry with a transparent ground: a real viewBox, no opaque full canvas rectangle riding along, counters and hairline rule open at reproduction size. Do not treat a trace alone as production approval: deliver transparent SVG, rendered small-size proofs, and an inspectable geometry report. Any unverified contour or fabrication tolerance must be labeled for supplier review.

The straightened catalogue cover, the nameplate frame, the levelled proving stamp coupon and cast frame photographs, and one licensed camera-scale shop floor frame brought to one works target with a per-frame parameter log, plus the transparent nameplate plate the usage sheet places. No output exceeding its source dimensions and every reported resize recorded.

Please include useful small-size renderings, transparent vector files and a geometry report. We need to know what is ready to place and what still requires a supplier's tolerance check.

This is a fixed-price commission at $2,500-$6,000, with a target of 2 to 4 weeks. The agreed review allowance is one direction checkpoint and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

Alongside the finished work, we need a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports and a short production and exceptions note. Keep a clear record of the supplied files used, retained for reference, superseded and rejected. Approved source information remains authoritative. Record omissions, substitutions, reconciliations and quality limits, and do not use an undeclared replacement or invented fact to conceal a source problem. Include inspectable paths and small-size proofs; unverified fabrication tolerances remain subject to supplier review.
